'od zer bstan pa'i le'u/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u las bam po bdun cu rtsa drug pa nas brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa yan/ca par/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u las gong gi 'phros bam po gcig dang sdong pos brgyan pa'i le'u las bam po brgyad cu rtsa drug pa nas brgya yan/cha par/ gong gi 'phros bam po brgya gcig nas brgya bcu bzhi pas rdzogs pa yan// //mdo sde'i gras/ ka par/ 'phags pa bskal ba bzang po/kha par/ rgya cher rol pa/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin rlabs sems can la gzigs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa/ga par/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che mtha' yas pa mthar phyin pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan gyi mdo/nga par/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo/ zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs / dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ca par/ dgongs pa nges 'grel/ lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo ji snyed pa/lang kur gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po'i le'u/ ga ya go ri'i mdo/cha par/ rgyan stug po bkod pa ji snyed pa/ snying rje chen po padma dkar po/111—54

snying rje pad dkar/ja par/ dam chos pad dkar/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa/ za ma tog bkod pa/ dkon mchog gi za ma tog /rin po che'i mtha' zhes bya ba/nya par/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po las lha dang mi la sogs pas zhus pa'i le'u/ 'da' ka ye shes/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi mdzod ces bya ba / dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ gser gyi mdo dang / gser gyi bye ma lta bu'i mdo/ta par/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo/ chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las mi g.yo ba'i mdo/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul ting nge 'dzin/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin/dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/tha par/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/bsod nams thams cad sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ting 'dzin mchog dam pa/ 'dus pa rin po che'i tog gi gzungs/ rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/ sgo mtha' yas par sgrub pa'i gzungs/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/da par/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i bzungs/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu sgom pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul thabs kyis yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa/ byams pas zhus pa'i mdo/186—55

spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa chos bdun pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa/na par/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa che 'bring chung gsum/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa/pa par/ tshangs pas zhus pa/ tshangs byin gyis zhus pa/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa/ lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa/ dpal dbyig gis zhus pa/ rin chen dra bas zhus pa/ rin chen zla bas zhus pa/ bde byed kyis zhus pa/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa/ rnam par 'phrul ba'i rgyal pos zhus pa/ lha mo dri med 'od kyis zhus pa/ theg chen man ngag bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa/ bram ze ma dpal ldan gyis zhus pa/ bgres mos zhus pa/pha par/ 'jam dpal gyis dris pa/ bdag med pas dris pa/ 'jig rten 'dzin gyis dris pa/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa/ 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa / kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa/ cib par/ sbyin sogs phar phyin lnga bstan pa/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin bstan pa/sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug par bstan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab par bstan pa/ mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa/ tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa/ bud med 'gyur 106—56

ba lung bstan pa/ bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa/ bde ldan ma lung bstan pa/lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/ rgyal ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo/ 'jam dpal gnas pa/ bdud rtsi brjod pa/ byams pa 'jug pa/ chos kyi rjes su mthun par 'jug pa/ma par/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i phyag rgya/ nges pa dang ma nges pa las 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa/ chos kyi phyag rgya/ mar me 'bul ba / grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba/ zas kyi 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa/ glang po che'i rtsal lta bu'i mdo/ sgra chen/ seng ge'i sgra bsgrags pa/ sa lu ljang pa'i mdo/rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i mdo/ sor ma'i 'phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa/ bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa / ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba/ dpal sbas kyi mdo/ las sgrib rnam par dag pa/ las sgrib rgyun gcod pa/tsa par/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa/ rgyal po gsal rgyal la gdams pa/ rnga bo che chen po'i mdo/ sum cu rtsa bdun pa'i le'u / lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo/ srid pa 'pho ba/ rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas bgro ba/de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig citsha par/ dkon cog sprin/ sprin chen po'i mdo/ sprin chen po las phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la 186—57

rnam par rtse ba'i le'u/ sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor las char dbab pa'i le'u cho ga dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba bsgrub pa/bdud kyi nyi tshe 'byung ba/dza par/ chos yang dag par sdud pa/ sa snying 'khor lo bcu pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo/ ting 'dzin 'khor lo'i mdo/ yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo/wa par/ chos kyi tshul/ chos kyi phung po/ don dam par chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba/ chos dang don rnam par 'byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i so thar chos bzhi sgrub pa/ chos bzhi bstan pa/ chos bzhi bstan pa shlau ka bcu pa/chos bzhi mi gtong ba/ bzhi sgrub pa/ chos gsum pa'i mdo/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi mdo/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ chos kyi rgya mo/ mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo/ yi ge med pa'i za ma tog /rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo/zha par/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ yang dag par spyod tshul nam mkha'i mdog gi 'dul ba'i bzod pa bstan pa/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshang gi sdig pa sbyangs ste sangs rgyas yongs su sgrub pa rnam par bkod pa/ 'phags pa rtog pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las phyag 'tshal cho ga mtshan nas brjod pa'i gleng gzhi/ me tog gi tshogs kyi mdo/za par/ spang skong phyag rgya pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po/ phyogs bcu'i mun sel/ sangs rgyas bdun pa/ sangs rgyas brgyad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan/ sangs rgyas 186—58

mi spang ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sa/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ bkra shis brgyad pa/dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo/ bslab pa gsum gyi mdo/ sku gsum gyi mdo/ phung po gsum gyi mdo/ bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i bsngo ba/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa'i bsngo ba/ mdo dran pa nyer bzhaga' par/ gong gi 'phros bam po zhe lnga yan/ya par/ bam po zhe drug nas 'thab bral gyi lha rnams kyi sa las rtag tu bde ba'i sa ste brgyad pa yan/ra par/ gong gi 'phros dran pa nyer bzhag ji tsam 'gyur ba rdzogs pa yan/mdo chen po sgyu ma'i dra ba/ mdo chen po gzugs can snying pos bsu ba/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po/ mdo rgyal mtshan mchog /mdo rgyal mtshan dam pa/ mdo chen po lnga gsum pa/ rdo 'phangs pa'i mdo/ gzhon nu dpe'i mdo/ khams mang po'i mdo/ gaṇḍi'i mdo/gaṇḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo/la par/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo / tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo/ ltung ba sde lnga'i dge mi dge'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i mdo/ mchog tu gdags pa'i mdo/ rnam grol lam las sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstan pa'i mdo/ tshe'i mtha'i mdo/ 'chi 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba bstan pa'i mdo/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ yang mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo / 'du shes bcu bstan pa/ 'du shes bcu gcig bstan pa/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ mtshan mo bzang po'i mdo/ mun pa'i nags 111—59

tshal gyi sgo'i mdo/ pha ma'i mdo/ bden bzhi'i mdo/ don rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ don rgyas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ rmad du byung ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon yang dag pa bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs bcad / gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs su bcad pa/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ skyes bu dam pa'i mdo/ dga' bo rab tu byung ba'i mdo/lha'i mdo/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu / zla ba'i mdo/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo/gnas 'jog gi mdo/ dga' ba can gyi mdo/ 'khar gsil gyi mdo/ 'khar gsil 'chang ba'i kun tu spyod pa ston pa'i cho ga /chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdo/las kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i mdo/ las rnam 'byed/ rnam 'byed chung ba/ las rnam par 'gyur ba/sha par/ mdo sde las brgya pa bam po nyer drug yan dang sdom gyi tshigs su bcad pa bdun pa'i gtam rgyud dang po yan/sa par/ gong gi 'phros yongs rdzogs dang / 'dzangs blun/ kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa/ byams pa'i mdo/ byams pa lung bstan pa/ha par/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod shes ldan gyi mdo/ phag mo'i rtogs brjod/ ma ga dha bzang mo'i rtogs brjod/a par/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs pa brjod pa/ zla 'od kyi rtogs brjod / dpal gyi sde'i rtogs brjod/ gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba bstan 186—60

pa / rgyal bu don 'grub gyi mdo/ thams cad sgrol gyi skyes rabs mdo tshangs pa'i dra ba/ thabs mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas drin lan bsab pa/ legs nyes kyi rgyu 'bras bstan pa/ dge mi dge'i las kyi rnam smin bstan pa/ zla ba'i snying pos zhus pa'i mdo las bstan pa'i gnas 'jig lung bstan pa/ glang ru lung bstan pa/ stag sna'i rtogs brjod/ mig bcu gnyis pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes rabs kyi gleng gzhi'i mdo/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ byams pa'i mdo/ byams pa sgom pa'i mdo/ tshul khrims lnga'i phan yon bstan pa'i mdo/ tshe dang ldan pa ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' btul ba'i mdo/gnas bstan 'od sungs chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i mdo/ bkra shis chen po'i mdo bcas rdzogs pa yan/ki par/ gtsug tor dpa' bar 'gro ba/myang 'das/ ka par/ bam po nyer brgyad yan/kha par/ gong gi 'phros yongs rdzogs mu stegs kyi rgyal po ba la shas gdung ma thob pa yan gyi rdzogs pa// //rgyud kyi gras/ ka par/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu/ dbang mdor bstan/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i snying po phyi ma/ dbang gi rab byed/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba'i rtsa rgyud/ de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma/ kyai rdor rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ rdo rje gur zhes bya ba/ de'i rgyud phyi ma phyag chen thig le/ phyi ma'i phyi ma ye shes snying po/ bshad rgyud ye shes thig le/186—61

'bras rgyud de kho na nyid/kha par/ bde mchog rgyud 'bum las nyung ngur grags pa/ bde mchog nges brjod rgyud bla ma/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi rgyud/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ga par/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ bde mchog khrag 'thung mngon 'byung / bshad rgyud phag mo mngon 'byung / rnal 'byor kun spyod rgyud/rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gyi brtag bdun/ dpal yang dag sbyor rgyud brtag pa bcu pa dang / de'i rgyud phyi ma/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud/nga par/ ra li so gnyis rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ ma hā ma ya'i rgyud/ badzra a ra li'i rgyud/ a ra li'i rgyud/ dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud rab byed bcu drug /de'i bshad rgyud sngags kyi cha/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog rgyud/ khro bo'i rgyal po thams cad gsang ba mi g.yo ba'i rgyud/ khro bo'i rgyal po gsang ba mi g.yo ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rgyud/ sgrol ma ku ru kulle'i rgyud/ sgrol ma mngon 'byung gi rgyud las byung ba phyag 'tshal nyer gcig phan yon dang bcas pa/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud/ nag po chen po'i rgyud/ca par/ gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ de'i rgyud phyi ma/ bshad rgyud rdo rje 'phreng ba/ dgongs pa lung bstan / ye shes rdo rje kun las btus/ lha mo bzhis zhus/cha par/ lag na rdo rje gos sngon can drag po gsum 'dul/ bshad rgyud drag po gsum 'dul/ gos sngon can gyi cho ga rdo rje be con gyi rgyud/ rdo rje gdengs pa'i rgyud/ khams gsum rnam rgyal/ gtum po gsang ba'i rgyud/de'i rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rmi lam mthong ba'i bzungs/ phyag rdor drag 106—62

po me lce'i rgyud dang / rgyud rdo rje snying po/ rdo rje dbab pa/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud/ja par/ gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud/ gshed nag las sgrub 'khor lo'i rgyud/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rtog bdun/ rtogs pa bzhi pa/ gsum pa/gnyis pa/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa/ las mkhan te'u lo ba chu byi'i rtog pa/gshed dmar gyi rgyud/ dpal ral pa gcig pa'i rtog rgyud/ rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rgyud/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa/de'i rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud nye bar bsdu ba/nya par/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo rtog bcu/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud/'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba'i rtog pa/ rgyud phyi ma/ rab gnas mdor bsdus / dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po sogs dpal mchog yongs rdzogs/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa/ sku gsung thugs gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i rgyud/ta par/ ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po brtag pa gnyis pa/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid rgyal po'i brtag pa phyogs gcig pa/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ sher phyin sgo nyer lnga pa/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le'i rgyud/ rnam snang mngon byang dang gsang ba mchog /gos sngon can rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud/tha par/ mi g.yo ba stobs dpag tu med pa/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje sa gsum du rgyu ba'i rtog pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyud / sman mdo brgyad brgya pa/ sman mdo chung ba/ beeḍū rya'i 'od ces bya 186—63

ba'i bzungs/da par/ nor bu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang gi cho ga zhib mo/ byang chub rgyan 'bum gyi bzungs/ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog /yangs grong du 'jug pa'i mdo/ shāka thub snying po'i bzungs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzungs / rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs/ bde ldan snying po'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas bdun pa zhes bya ba'i mdo/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ zla 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ dri ma med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ khyad par can gyi gzungs/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu / shes rab snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig sgrub/ 'jam dpal rnon po la sangs rgyas kyis bstod pa/'jam dpal la bu mo brgyad kyis bstod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gyi smod btsugs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan/shes rab blo 'phel/ 'jam dpal gyi dam bcas pa/ yi ge 'bru gcig pa/sher phyin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sher phyin ko'u shi kan par/ 'phags pa gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam rgyal/ gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po/106—64

pa par/ stong chen rab 'joms sogs gzungs grwa lnga/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs / paṇḍa sha wa ri'i mdo/ lo gyon ma'i gzungs/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud ma'i rtog pa/ lha mo bskul byed ma'i gzungs/ dug sel ba'i rig sngags/ dbyig ldan gyi gzungs/ grags ldan ma'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can / rma bya'i yang snying / sgrol ma mchog gi gzungs/ lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs / gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs rtog bcas/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal / gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rtog bcas che chung gnyis/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal thar los bsgyur ba/ gdugs dkar phyir bzlog chen mo/ gdugs dkar mchog grub/ gdugs dkar lha yul ma chung ba/ gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs / nad thams cad zhi ba'i gzungs/ rims nad thams cad zhi ba'i gzungs / rims nad rab tu zhi ba'i gzungs/ mig nad rab tu zhi ba/gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi ba/ mi rgod rnam 'joms/ bu mang po rton pa'i gzungs / stong 'gyur gyi gzungs/ ye shes tā la'i gzungs/ 'od zer dri med kyi gzungs/ shes pas mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten gyi gzungs/rten 'brel snying po'i cho ga dang / mdo dang / gzungs/ rin po che brdar ba'i gzungs/ gtsug tor 'bar ba/ sman la sngags gdab pa/ bskor ba'i gzungs le tshan gnyis/ yon sbyong ba'i gzungs le tshan gnyis/ thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs/ shes rab skyed pa'i gzungs/ shlau ka brgya lobs pa/ stong lobs pa/ sum stong lobs pa/ mi brjed pa'i gzungs/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs / yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa'i gzungs/ chos thams cad kyi yum gyi gzungs/ phyir bzlog stobs chen/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa'i 106—65

gzungs / khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i gsang rgyud rtsa ba'i rtog pa/ rtog pa phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ tsan dan gyi yan lag gi gzungs/ phyir zlog rnam rgyal/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa'i gzungs / gzhan gyi mi thub pa/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i gzungs/ gdon mi za ba'i gzungs le tshan gnyis/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i gzungs/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs/ mig rnam par sbyong ba'i rig sngags / bar du gcod pa thams cad sel ba'i gzungs/ bar gcod sel ba/'gro lding ba'i rig sngags/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ sa'i dbang po'i gzungs / be con chen po'i gzungs/ sgo bzang po'i gzungs/ chos kyi rgya mtsho'i gzungs/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs / yi ge drug ma'i rig sngags/ gser can gyi gzungs/ snying rje mchog gi gzungs/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ gzungs chen mo/pha par/ mi g.yo ba'i rgyud/ khro bo'i rgyal po'i rtog pa bsdus pa/ nye sras brgyad kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ byams pas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ gnod sbyin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ mdo chen po kun tu rgyu dang kun tu rgyu ma yin pa/sprin chen po las char dbab khol du phyung ba cho ga dang bcas pa/ sprin chen las klu thams cad kyi snying po/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyi zhus pa'i gzungs/ tshogs bdag gi rgyud/ tshogs bdag gi snying po/ gza' yum le tshan gnyis/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs/ de'i rtog pa le tshan gnyis/ nag po chen po'i rgyud/de'i gzungs/ lha mo nag mo'i gzungs/ nag po chen po'i gzungs/ rims 186—66

nad thams cad las thar byed/ lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa'i rgyud/ de'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad/ ro langs bdun pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ su rū pa'i/ ye shes skar mda'i snying po/ kha 'bar ma dbugs dbyung ba'i gzungs/ de la skyabs mdzad pa'i gzungs/ 'jur bgegs sel ba'i gzungs/ tshe mdo che chung gnyis/ tshe dpag med kyi snying po/ rtsa rgyud padma dra ba/ don zhags par phyin drug rdzogs par byed pa'i gzungs/ phyag stong spyan stong gi cho ga zhib mo sprul pa'i gzungs/ phyag stong spyan stong thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i gzungs cho ga dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa ye shes 'khor lo'i snying po'i gzungs/ bcu gcig zhal gyi gzungs / spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po dang gzungs/ padma cod paṇa gyi rgyud/'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i gzungs / ha ya gri ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa / gnod sbyin chu dbang snying rje can gyi gzungs bde byed ces bya ba/ lus dbyibs mdzes pa'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra'i rgyud/ seng ge sgra'i gzungs/ seng ge sgra'i dam bcas pa/ snying rje mi gshol ba'i gzungs/spyan ras gzigs kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs 'byung ba'i rgyud/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya'i mdo/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgrol ma mchog ces bya ba'i gzungs cho ga dang bcas pa/ sgrol ma'i gzungs/ sgrol ma rang gi dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ba par/ don zhags snying po/ sgra dbyangs lha mo la bstod sngags bcas/lha mo dpal lung bstan pa'i mdo/ dpal chen mo'i mdo/ dpal lha mo'i 186—67

mtshan bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul gyi rgyud/rim par bye ba gnyis pa las le'u dgu pa dang bco lnga pa gnyis/ba 'og mar/ spyan ras gzigs kyi don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo/ma par/ las sgrib thams cad sbyong ba mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/ phyag rdor rig pa mchog gi rgyud/ phyag rdor gos sngon can gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi gzungs/ rnam 'joms bshad rgyud ri rab rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ rdo rje mi 'pham pa me ltar rmongs byed lag na rdo rje bcu'i snying po/ rdo rje mchu zhes bya ba/ klu'i dam tshig sogs mchu sde lnga/bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi mdo'i snying po/ stobs po che/ bgegs sel ba'i gzungs / gar mkhan mchog gi brtag pa snga phyi gnyis/ gnod sbyin dpal zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ gnod gnas dpa' bo ji ltar 'byung ba'i rtog pa/tsa par/ sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rtog pa/tsha par/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/ de'i rtog pa/ me kha la'i gzungs / rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ rin po che brdar ba'i gzungs / bskor ba bya ba'i gzungs/ mchod rten bskor ba'i gzungs/yon yongs su sbyong ba'i gzungs le tshan gnyis/ phyag bya ba'i gzungs/ gos brgya thob pa'i gzungs/ mi dga' bar byed pa/ spyan rnam par dag pa'i gzungs / ngan song sbyong ba'i gzungs/ skran zhi ba/ ma zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba / snang ba thams cad zhi bar byed pa/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ khros pa zhi ba/ khros pa zhi bar byed pa/ tshig btsan pa/ bdag bsrung ba/ yid du 'ong ba/ mgrin pa snyan pa/ don thams cad 'grub pa/106—68

las 'grub pa/ dug sel ba/ bcings pa las grol ba/ bdud skrag par byed pa/ rma sbyor bar byed pa/ rma'i zug rngu zhi bar byed pa/ mkhris pa'i nad sel ba/ bad kun gyi nad sel ba/ kṣa ya'i nad sel ba/ rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa/ brgyad stong pa/ phar phyin drug gi snying po/ phar phyin drug thob par 'gyur ba/ phar phyin bcu thob par 'gyur ba/ tshad med bzhi thob par 'gyur ba/ sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa gzung bar 'gyur ba/ phal chen / sdong po bkod pa/ ting 'dzin rgyal po/ rma bya chen mo so sor 'brang ma rnams bzung bar 'gyur ba/ lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo thams cad klags par 'gyur ba/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa/ gsang ba spyi rgyud/ bsam gtan phyi ma/ las sgrub/ dgongs pa'i rgyud kyi 'phreng ba'i yongs su bsngo ba/yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po sngags dang bcas pa/ las grub las byung ba'i smon lam le tshan lnga/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo las byung ba'i bde legs kyi tshigs su bcad pa sogs shis brjod bcu gnyis/dza par/ chos thams cad rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po / gsang ba ye shes don gyi snying po/ rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyud ces bya ba sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa bsdus pa'i pa'i mdo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod chen po mi zad pa gter gyi sgron ma brtul zhugs chen po sgrub pa'i rgyud ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo zhes bya ba theg pa chen ngo/'i mdo rnams/wa par/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba'i ye shes don gyi snying po khro bo rdo rje'i rigs kun 'dus rigs pa'i mdo/ gsang ba snying po de 106—69

kho na nyid kyi nges pa las le'u nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rdor sems sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud / gsang ba snying po de kho na nyid nges pa las le'u brgyad cu/ thabs kyi zhags pa padmo'i 'phreng ba las sgrub pa'i phan yon le'u bzhi bcu/zha par/ lha mo sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud/ gsang ba snying po'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal las bzhi'i 'khor lo gsang ba'i rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud/ snying rje rol pa'i rgyud/ gsang mdzod chen po/ bdud rtsi bam brgyad kyi ming can mkha' 'gro ma me lce 'bar ba'i rgyud/ drag sngags bsdus pa rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud/ 'jig rten mchod bstod rtsa ba'i rgyud rdzogs pa yan// //sarba maṅgal// //

gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta'i dkar chag ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs/༄pha /bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta'i dkar chag ngo mtshar bkod pa rgya mtsho'i lde mig ces bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa'i zhabs la rnam pa thams cad du gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid zhi kun khyab zab zhi 'dus ma byas/ /gang las bkod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin 'phro ba/ /'od gsal snying po kun byed rdo rje'i sems / /bla ma'i bla ma mchog gis shis pa stsol/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba kun dang ro gcig kyang / /'dren pa gzhan gyis spangs pa'i zhing khams 'dir/ /pad dkar lta bur bsngags pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /dus gsum kun mkhyen shākya'i rgyal por 'dud/ /gcig las du mar shar ba'i sprul pa'i gar mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i bka' yi bsdu ba po/ /gtad rabs bdun dang rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /'dzam gling mdzes byed rnams la snying nas gus/ /rab 106 —71

'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul las/ /cir yang shar ba'i rnam 'gyur 'byam klas pa/ /mkhan slob chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang / /lo paṇa rim byon thams cad phyag gi yul/ /spangs rtogs bstan pa'i bdag po dang mnyam kyang / /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir mdo sngags snying po'i srog /'khrul med 'dzin skyong spel ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /lhag por gyur pa 'jam dpal snying por phul/ /dza ti'i me tog bkra ba'i zhing khams nas/ /zab dar thags su bskrun pa'i yul gru'i bar/ /dga' ldan pho brang chos srid zung 'jug gis/ /khyab mdzad rdo rje thogs med rtsal der 'dud/ /ngo bo gcig kyang rnam 'gyur tha dad pas/ /grangs med zhing du yab dang sras kyi tshul/ /ston mdzad gsung gi rdo rje 'od dpag med/ /paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po gtsug na bsten/ /bgrang yas sprul pa'i rol gar rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /ngur smrig zol gyis spa ba'i rnam 'dren bdun/ /'byon par bsngags pa'i phyi ma pad dkar 'chang / /kun mkhyen bskal bzang rgya mtshor phyag bgyi'o/ /tshad med skye dgu'i khams dang bsam pa bzhin/ /'dul byed grub mtha'i bkod pa sna tshogs pas/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad ris su ma chad pa'i/ /mkhas grub phyag byar 'os pa kun la dad/ /dus dgra'i dbang po 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ /mi yi rje bor shar ba sa'i dbang phyug /ka ba med pa'i mthongs nas dbang bskur ba/ /'jam dbyangs gong ma rim byon rnams la mos/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i gsung gi sgyu 'phrul las/ /yam shud dmar po shar ba'i sprul pa'i sku/ /bsod nams stobs rgyas gangs can mig gcig pur/ /gcam bu'i zol sbyor min pas nges par 'dud / /gang dang ro gcig rnam pa tha dad pa'i/ /bka' skyong dam can rgya 106—72

mtsho kun gyi rje/ /'dod khams dbang phyug nyi ma gzhon nu yis/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du grogs mdzod cig /sngon chad grags kyang 'phags pa'i sgo du mas / /srid gsum kun na dkon pa'i rgyan gcig pu/ /bya sla tshegs chung rdzu 'phrul gnade gsange gis/ /thub gsung 'odren 4byed shing rta gsar du grub/ ོ/gange gi dkar chag thog mtha' bar gsum gyi/ /ngo sgomacher bkod pa rgya mtsho'i gnas tshulo kunang/ /bklags shes tha ram 'grol ba'i sgo'aphrule po tsho'i/ 4 4/lde mig deng 'dir 'chad par kho bo spro/ /spangs rtogs yon tan khur gyi phung po deng byu/ /bsod nams stobs kyis lci ba'i mi'i bdag po/ /kun gyis yun ring dus nas bsgrub gyur kyang / /ngal ba tsam las bzhed pa mthar ma phyin/ /sdig dang ma 'dres g.yo sgyu'i zol bral zhing / /yun thung dus kyi myur bar tshegs med pas/ /rlabs chen bzhed pa'i don kun 'grub pa 'di/ /'phags chen kho na'i mdzad par sus mi 'dzin/ /grags skams tsam gyis mtho bar chos rgyal zhes/ /bsngags par byed na dpyad gsum dag pa yis/ /bstan pa'i bdag po nyid dang mi gnyis par/ /sgrub nus chos rgyal 'di la su mi gus/ /de phyir gang gi rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /'phros pa'i dkar chag ji ltar spobs pa bzhin/ /yi ge'i rigs su bskrun te spel 'dod na/ /'dzam gling skye dgu thams cad rna ba nyon/ /de la 'dir brjod par bya ba'i dngos po gtan la 'bebs pa la sgo bzhi ste/dgos pa brjod pa/ spyir bstan pa/ bye brag tu bshad pa/ mjug bsdu ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ ji skad du/ mdo don che ba nyid mthong nas/ /nyan pa dang ni 'dzin pa la/ /nyan pa po de gus 'gyur bas/ /thog mar dgos pa brjod par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gsung par rin po che 'di nyid 186—73

bzhengs pa dang / de'i gnas tshul rnams yi ger bkod pa'i dgos pa khong du chud na de la brten te rnam dkar rlabs po che'i bya ba la/ ngang gis 'jug pa'i gnad mchis pas 'di 'chad par bya'o/ /de la mdo sdud pa las/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing / /me tog 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal bskyed byed pa/ /ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag brten gnas te / /de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / /'chad dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ /zhes 'dzam bu'i gling gi chu klung me tog 'bras bu sman nags tshal la sogs pa'i yon tan ji snyed cig yod pa/ de dag thams cad ma dros pa'i mtsho ste da lta yongs grags ma pham g.yu mtshor 'bod pa'i klu'i rgyal po'i mthu la brten nas 'byung ba bzhin du/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i cha thams cad sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje kho nar rag lus par gsungs / de yang ji skad du/ khyod kyi gang las 'gro ba dang / /ma drangs rgyad pa de gang mchis/ /'jig rten dag dang ma skrad pa'i/ /phun tshogs de yang gang zhig mchis/ /zhes gsungs pas/ bde legs kyi cha gang yin pa thams cad dge ba dang / mi 'dod pa'i cha phra mo tsam yang mi dge ba la brten nas 'grub cing sdig spong dge sgrub kyi bya ba gang yin pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan par/ mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes pas bstan/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de 186 —74

la 'jug pa yang rgyal ba'i gsung gi 'phrin las la nges par ltos dgos te/mdo las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi bkru shing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min yang / /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs shing / sdig pa chus bkru ba dang sdug bsngal phyag gis sel ba sogs ma yin par/ rgyal bas blang dor gyi gnas phyin ci ma log par bstan cing / gdul byas de'i rjes su zhugs pa las mngon mtho nges legs kyi go 'phang rnams sgrub dgos pa yin no/ /don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal pos/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang ni/ /'di nyid yin phyir mkhas pa yis / /'di las sangs rgyas rjes dran byos/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar yang gser 'od las/ bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang la la zhig yul skyong zhing rtag par bde ba'i longs spyod myong bar 'tshal ba dang / skye bo mang po rnams bde ba la dgod par 'tshal ba dang / pas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar bkums nas rang gi yul khams gtan du rgyas shing dar bar 'tshal ba dang/ yang dag pa'i bstan pa 'jig rten du gnas nas sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa dang / sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos rnams nye bar zhi bar 'tshal na/ bcom ldan 'das yul gyi bdag po de dag gis gdon mi 'tshal bar/ mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 'di mnyan nas yongs su bzung bar bgyi zhing / mdo sde 'di klog pa dang / gdon pa dang / nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dag la'ang bsnyen bkur ba dang / rim gro dang mchod par bgyid na bdag cag dang / tshad ma mchis pa'i lha'i 'khor gzhan rnams chos mnyan pa'i dge ba'i byin rlabs kyi mthus bla na ma mchis pa'i 186—75

bdud rtsi'i chos kyi ro myong bar 'gyur bas/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la sman par 'gyur zhing / lha gzhan rnams kyang sman yon mchog thob par 'gyur lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar mi'i rgyal po des sems rtse gcig tu mdo sde 'di mnyan nas yongs su 'dud pa'i slad du'o/ /zhes pa dang /shes rab khri pa las/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de de bzhin te / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de tshes brgyad dang tshes bcu bzhi dang tshes bco lnga la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du byed pa dang / 'chad par byed pa na bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med grangs med tshad med/bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med pa mang po dag bskyed par 'gyur zhing /de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du byed pa dang / 'chad par byed pa na lha'i 'khor mdun du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud las kyang / /bsam gtan bsams pa tsam gyis sam/ /bklag cing kha ton bgyis pa yis/ /mtho ris longs spyod thob 'gyur ba'am/ /yang na 'khor los bsgyur ba thob/ /ces pa dang / rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho tshe dpal / /khrag 'thung sogs dpa' rnal 'byor ma/ /las na me tog sna tshogs dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang / /rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang / /glu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis/ /mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par byed/ /ces gsungs shing de'i 'grel par 'jam mgon bla mas/ rtsa rgyud kyi glegs bam klog cing kha ton du byed pa dang / glegs bam bris pa yis kyang sdig pa dag nas mtho ris te bde 'gro'i rten dang longs spyod kyi 'byor pa thob par 'gyur ba'am yang na 'khor los bsgyur ba thob par 'gyur/ zhes pa dang / gal te g.yeng bas 186—76

tshe 'dir dngos grub ma grub na 'chi ba'i tshe phan yon ni/ lam 'di'i rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma rnams/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu 'pho ba'i tshe ni dpal khrag 'thung he ru ka dang sogs kyis bsdus pa rje btsun ma phag mo la sogs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma lag na me tog dang bdug spos sna tshogs pa dang / rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sna tshogs pa dang / rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs pa dang / yid du 'ong ba'i glu'i mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mkha' spyod kyi gnas su khrid par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i rgyu'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i rgyud sde sogs / blang dor gyi gnad phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che bstan 'gro thams cad kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag gcig pur gyur pa yin pas na/ 'dri klog 'chad nyan bgyis pa la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don rlabs po che nges par 'grub pa rgyal ba rang nyid kyis zhal gyis 'ches shing gsungs pa don la slu ba med pa/ de'i nang nas kyang 'byong pa dman pa dang le lo dang snyoms las kyi dbang du gyur pas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog 'dri klog 'chad nyan bgyid par mi nus pa rnams la par gyi 'phrul la brten pa ni/ 'grub par dka' ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dka' tshegs med par bsod nams kyi bgo skal du 'dren par sla ba yin zhing / de nyid ji tsam 'phel ba tsam gyis 'jig rten gyi rgyad pa rnams ngang gis zhi zhing bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs rnams 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / de'i dbang gis tshogs rlabs po che bde blag tu rdzogs par 'gyur zhing / gnas skabs su yang tshe ring ba dang nad med pa dang /longs spyod phyug pa dang grags pa thob pa dang / dgra bgegs kyi nyer 'tshe zhi ba 186—77

sogs mdor na 'phral yun gyi don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba ni/ gsung par rin po che 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i dgos pa yin no/ /ji ltar bzhengs pa'i dkar chag yi ger bkod pa la brten nas sngon byung gi rnam thar la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob cing / rjes su yi rang gi dga' ba khyad par can 'dren pa dang / gnas skabs su blang dor gyi gnas la mi rmongs shing gsung rab rin po che'i bkur ste dang / 'dri klog thos bsam gyi bya ba la 'jug par sla ba dang /rgyu des mchog thun gyi dngos grub bde blag tu thob par 'gyur ba yin no//gnyis pa la bde bar gshegs pa'i mdzad pa che long tsam brjod pa dang /bstan pa rin po che ji ltar dar ba'i tshul bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ klung dag sa yi 'og tu ma song ba/ /gnas kyang tha dad chu yang tha dad la/ /chu yang chung zhing bya ba tha dad byed/ /chur gnas srog chags phra mo'i nyer spyad 'gyur/ /rgya mtshor song bar gyur na thams cad kyang / /gnas rnams gcig cing chu yang che la gcig /bya ba gcig cing chu la gnas pa yi/ /srog chags mang po'i rtag tu nyer spyad che/ /sangs rgyas nyid du ma zhugs brtan pa rnams/ /rten kyang tha dad blo gros tha dad cing / /rtogs chung rang gi bya ba tha dad la/ /sems can nyung don rtag tu nyer spyad 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas nyid du zhugs na de dag kun/ /rten kyang gcig cing rtogs pa che la gcig /mdzad pa gcig tu 'dres shing rtag par yang / /sems can tshogs che'i nye bar spyad pa che/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sangs rgyas thams cad slob lam gyi gnas skabs su rgyud tha dad kyang / gang mngon par byang chub pa na dgongs pa chos kyi 186—78

dbyings su ro gcig par 'gyur ba las/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba kun dang ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pa'i bdag nyid can gyi rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal po de nyid/dam pa'i chos padma dkar po las/ bskal pa bye stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /de yi tshad ni nam yang med pa nas/ /byang chub mchog rab de ni nges brnyes te/ /ngas ni rtag tu chos kyang rab bshad do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas zin na'ang / mdo sde rgyan las/de ni cig car la lar sgo mang brgya nas chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /la lar skye ba mi snang la lar skye ba'i spyod pa sna tshogs dang / /la lar byang chub thams cad la lar de ni mya ngan 'das ston kyang / /de ni gnas de las kyang rnam par g.yo mi mnga' la thams cad mdzad/ /ces pa dang / rgyud bla ma las/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs pas/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes/ nam mkha' ji srid kyi bar du mdzad pa bcu gnyis la sogs nga/'i bkod nga/ rim dang cig car ba du ma'i tshul du ston par mdzad pa las/ bskal bzang du/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub chen la/ /'jam gang zhig nis dbul bar byas nas ni/ /dang ngo/ra byang chub mchos tu sems 186 —79

bskyed do/ /zhes bya ba sogs theg pa che chung gi sde snod rnams su thugs bskyed tshul mi 'dra ba du ma dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba phrag stong dang / /de las lhag pa gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed/ /kun kyang bya rgod phung po 'dir bzhugs te/ /mi dbang de kun nga yis bkur ster byas/ /zhes bya rgod phung po'i ri bo gcig por yang sangs rgyas de tsam la bkur sti mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas dag ni bye ba phrag stong dang / /de las lhag par gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed/ /gang dag bya rgod phung po 'dir bzhugs nas/ /ting 'dzin zhi mchog 'di ston ngas dran te/ /de kun mtshan kyang shākya khyu mchog yin/ /kun gyi sras kyang sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya/ /zham 'bring ba yi ming ni kun dga' bo/ /ser skya'i drung nas thams cad rab tu byung / /phrug mchog shā ri'i bu dang pang nas skyes/ /skyob pa kun kyang mtshan ni mthun par gyur/ /ces ston pa shākya thub pa/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ 'khor kun dga' bo mchog zung dang bcas pa bye ba phrag stong dang gaṅgā'i bye ma snyed la ting nge 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo gsan pa dang / rgya che rol pa las/ gnas der nga yi mchod sbyin stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig bzhi bcu spyad/ /der ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag drug cu de dag mchod / /wa ra ṇa si dam pa de ni sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyi gnas/ /zhes wa ra ṇa si gcig pur yang / mchod sbyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa de lta bu sogs bya dka' ba'i spyod pa rlabs po che dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas slar yang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya pa'i mdzad pa ston par bzhed de/ skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su dga' ldan du lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar gyi tshul bzung ste gzigs pa lngas gzigs nas/ glang chen thal kur gyi rnam pas gshegs te zas gtsang gi 106—80

btsun mo sgyu 'phrul ma'i lhums su zhugs te lcags pho spre'u'i lo sku bltams/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa dgu'i bar du sgyu rtsal 'gran pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyis dgyes dgur rol pa sogs srid skyong gi mdzad pa bstan/ khab nas byung ste lo drug gi bar du dka' ba spyad nas/ shing rta lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i srod la bdud btul/ gung la mnyam par bzhag tho rangs skya rengs 'char ma'i tshe mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan/ 'di la bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang yang / 'dir ni kun mkhyen nor bu'i zhabs kyi bzhed pa bzhin du bkod de 'grel chen dri med 'od rgyan du/ sa byi dang por byas pa'i rgyal ba shing rta ni sa yos nas yar bgrangs pa'i lo zhe drug pa yin pas/ rgyal ba shing rta de'i sa ga zla ba dpyid zla tha chung gi nya'i mtshan mo'i thun tha ma'i skya rengs 'char ba'i mtshams rnga brdung du nye ba na mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin te/rgya che rol pa las/ dge slong dag /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' nam gyi cha smad skya rengs 'char ba'i dus kyi tshe rnga brdung ba'i nam tshod tsam na/ zhes pa dang —/ dbang po'i mdor bsdus dang po las/ sa ga'i nya'i skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/ de nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing theg pa gsum bstan par mdzad nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa nag po'i nya la shrīsto n+ya ka ṭa kur zhes sa ga'i nya'i skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su sangs rgyas par bshad pas so/ /zhes gsungs/ 'di nyid shin tu 'thad pa yin te/ ston pa sangs rgyas pa dang dus mnyam du zla ba sgra gcan gyis bzung / de'i tshe grags 'dzin mar khye'u btsas pas mtshan yang sgra gcan 'dzin zhes btags par/ 'dul ba lung las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bla na med 186—81

pa'i ye shes brnyes pa na/ grags 'dzin ma la yang khye'u zhig btsas so/ /zla ba yang sgra gcan gyis zin to/ /zhes pa dang / 'di btsas pa na zla ba yang sgra gcan gyis zin pa de bas na khye'u'i ming yang sgra gcan zin zhes btags so/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /thun mong ba'i snang ngor/ zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed/ /su la bstan yang go bar mi nus pas/ /mi smra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya/ /zhes chos mi ston pa'i tshul mdzad pa na/ tshangs pas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul te gsol ba btab kyang chos kyi 'khor lo ma bskor bas/ brgya byin rogs su sbran pa na des gser gyi maṇḍal dpag tshad lnga bcu pa dang dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil pa phyag tu phul te gsol ba btab pas/ yul wa ra ṇa si drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nags su 'khor lnga sde bzang por dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor / rim gyis dgung lo nga brgyad par bya rgod phung po'i rir 'khor rnam bzhi byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab par yum sras bcu bdun la sogs pa'i bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor bskor zhing /ma la ya dang yangs pa can sogs gnas tha dad pa du mar byang chub sems dpa' don dam yang dag 'phags la sogs par tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos 'khor gsungs/ dgung lo gya gcig bzhes pa lcags 'brug nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten chen po'i 'og tu chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor dang / steng du dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor spros te/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po sogs shambha la'i yul chen po dgu bcu rtsa drug gi rgyal po dgu bcu rtsa drug sogs/ 'khor tshogs dpag tu med 106—82

par dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa las zla ba bzang pos lo gsum gyi bar du/ skal ldan rnams la rgyud bstan cing dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos bslangs sngon med gsar du bskrun nas gshegs/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i zla ba phyi ma sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i thun tha ma'am nam gung la rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das te gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdu ba'i tshul bstan/ de lta bu'i bcom ldan 'das des rim dang cig car ba'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas/dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor bzhengs te/ rang las tha mi dad pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams la rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ ma hā tsi na'i yul gru ri bo rtse lngar/ dzam bu tri sha'i lba ba las 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i skur bzhengs nas shing pho byi ba'i lo tshangs pa dang lha mo rnam rgyal sogs zhu ba po bzhi dang / 'phrul gyi mi bzhi la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'khor la gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs/ sprul pa'i grong khyer lta na sdug tu sman gyi bla bee ḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po'i skur bzhengs nas/ thugs sprul drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ sku sprul drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ yon sprul drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ 'phrin las kyi sprul pa drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ zhu ba po gsung sprul drang srong rig pa'i ye shes/ lha mo bdud rtsi yid 'phrog ma la sogs te phyi nang gi 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par gso dpyad rtsa bshad phyi ma man ngag rgyud dang bcas pa gsungs/ 'di'i sman bla dang bde gshegs brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi sman bla ngo bo gcig kyang rnam pa tha dad de 'di'i rgyud gsung ba po ni 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ston pa sman bla'i skur bzhengs pa yin la/ bde gshegs brgyad kyi nang tshan gyi sman bla ni/ mdo las/ 'jam dpal shar phyogs logs 106—83

su sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gaṅgā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams bai ḍūrya'i snang ba zhes bya ba yod/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzoṭa pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu gdul ba'i kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sman gyi bla bai ḍūrya'i 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pa de nyid yin no//gnyis pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su/ kun dga' bos mdo sde'i sde snod/ nye bar 'khor gyis 'dul ba'i sde snod/ 'od srungs chen pos mngon pa'i sde snod bsdus te/bka' bsdu dang po mdzad de sbyin bdag rgyal po ma skyes dgas byas so/ /'od srungs chen pos/ bdag gis sde snod gsum bsdus pa na/ tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa dag sus kyang ma bzlog par mthun par bkas gnang bas/ 'di ni chos so/ /'di ni 'dul ba'o/ /'di ni ston pa'i bstan pa'o dgongs te lo du mar bstan pa la phyag ris rgya chen mdzad pa'i mthar kun dga' bo la ston pas nga la bstan pa gtad pa yin gyi/ da ni nga mya ngan las 'da' bas khyod kyis bstan pa bzung zhig /ces gsungs nas mya ngan las 'das/ kun dga' bos bstan pa bzung ste mya ngan las 'da' khar sha na'i gos can la gtad/ nyer sbas/dhi dhi ku nag po/ legs mthong rnams la snga ma snga mas phyi ma phyi mar bstan pa gtad cing bzung bas de dag la gtad rabs bdun ces grags so/ /ston pa 186—84

mya ngan las 'das te lo brgya dang bcu na/ rgyal po mya ngan med kyis sbyin bdag bgyis te dgra bcom pa grags pas bka' bsdu gnyis pa mdzad/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo grangs sum brgya song ba'i rjes su nyan thos sde pa bco brgyad du gyes par phan tshun 'khrug cing rtsod pa las/ kha che'i yul du dgra bcom dang byang sems brgya phrag re/ so skye'i paṇḍi ta chen po khri drug stong 'dus te rgyal po/ ka ni skas sbyin bdag bgyis te sde pa bco brgyad po thams cad kyang ston pa'i bstan par bsdus te bka' bsdu gsum pa mdzad/ 'di dag ni theg pa thun mong ba'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /theg pa chen po'i bka' bsdu ni/ byams pa/ 'jam dbyangs / phyag na rdo rje gsum gyis bsdus shing / de'i nang nas khyad par du gyur pa 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i skor rnams sangs rgyas rang nyid las mi zhan pa'i 'khor zhu ba po dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bsdus te/ skyon rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing khams la sogs par bzhugs so/ /kun dga' bo la sogs pa sprul pa'i nyan thos chen po de dag dang / ston pas bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i dus kyi 'khor thun mong ma yin pa nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la sogs pa rnams ni/ rnam 'gyur tha dad du shar ba las rdo rje 'chang rang nyid dang ngo bo gcig tu gyur pa sha stag yin te/ sgron gsal las/ gsol pa/ 'o na btsun pa kun dga' bo la sogs pa sdud par byed par ci'i phyir 'jig rten du grags/ smras pa/ kun dga' bo ni 'dir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po ste phyag na rdo rje yin la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po yang de nyid las gzhan ma yin te/gzhan du na mdo sde la sogs pa'i chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong po 'di dag de bzhin gshegs pa las phyag na rdo rjes thos nas/ lhag chad med par lan cig 186—85

gis 'dzin par ga la nus/ zhes gsungs nas/ de'i shes byed du thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba zhes bya ba'i bla med kyi rgyud las/ de nas gzhan yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'khor phun sum tshogs pa bshad par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/'jam dpal ni rgyal po chen po zas gtsang mar gyur to/ /zhes sogs drangs nas / bcom ldan 'das kyis bla med kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i dus kyi ston sdud nyan pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa ston pa nyid dang / rgyud gcig pa bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi rnam 'phrul dang thun mong gi 'khor gyi rnam par bstan pa'i kun dga' bo dang rgyal po zas gtsang ma sogs kyang ston pa nyid kyi rnam 'phrul rgyud sdud pa po sogs dang rgyud gcig tu bshad cing / brtag gnyis las kyang / 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan po nga / /'jig rten ston pa bsgrub bya nga / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa nga / /zhes gsungs so/ /khungs 'di dag la brten nas 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa chen po/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po sogs ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas grub rtsod pa dang bral ba mang po zhig dang / 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas sogs kyang / don du bstan pa'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang nyid dang thugs rgyud gcig tu nges par 'grub cing khungs dang 'brel ba yin no/ /gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs las/ de yang rigs gsum mgon po las/ /tha dad nyid du ga la 'gyur/ /sems can kun la spyan ras gzigs/ /'di ni snying rje byams pa'i rigs/ /nga la spyan ras gzigs zhes grags/ /lus ngag yid gsum zhi 'jam pas/ /'jam dpal dbyangs su 'gal ba med/ /kun mkhyen 106wa 86

shes rab che ba'i rigs/ /phyag stong re na mi rtog pa'i/ /rdo rje dpa' bor re bzung ste/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba nga yin na/ /phyag na rdo rjer 'gal ba med//de ni dpa' bo drag po'i rigs/ /de gsum rigs gsum mgon po nyid/ /phyogs su ma zad dngos yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas gnad 'di dag rtogs na dam pa rnams la mos gus kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa'i gnad gal che shos gcig tu mchis pas rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar theg pa thun mong ba'i bstan pa ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas 'phel 'grib sna tshogs las rgyun chad pa med par 'phags pa'i yul du yongs su grags par dar la/ theg pa chen po ni/ laṅkar gshegs pa las/ lho phyogs be ta'i yul du ni/ /dge slong dad ldan zhes grags pa/ /de ming klu zhes bod pa ste/ /yod dang med pa'i phyogs 'jig pa/ /nga yi bstan pa 'jig rten du/ /bla med theg chen rab bshad nas/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa bsgrubs te/ /bde ba can du de 'gro'o/ /zhes pa dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/ /lo ni bzhi brgya lon pa na/ /dge slong klu zhes de 'bod 'byung / /bstan pa la ni dad cing phan/ /rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob pa/ /lo ni drug brgya dag tu 'tsho/ /rig pa rma bya chen mo ni//bdag nyid chen po des kyang 'grub/ /bstan bcos sna tshogs don dang ni/ /dngos po med pa'i don de rig /gang tshe lus de bor ba na/ /bde ba can du sbyar bar 'gyur/ /de ni mthar gyi sangs rgyas nyid/ /nges pa kho nar yang dag thob/ /ces pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma las/ dge slong slob dpon klu sgrub ces bya ma lus yon tan 'byung khungs sems can kun la phan 'dogs pa/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar rgya gar lho phyogs bai dhasgo'i yul grur bram 106—87

ze'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/ sa ra ha las rdo rje theg pa'i man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa gsan/ rig pa'i gnas yod do cog la gzigs pa yangs por gyur te/bstan bcos kyang dpag tu med pa mdzad/ 'jam dpal dbyangs las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i dngos bstan zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba legs par gsan te/ rigs tshogs drug la sogs pa mtha' bral dbu ma'i bstan bcos rgya cher mdzad de 'phags pa'i yul du dbu ma pa zhes pa'i srol yongs grags btod/dgung lo drug brgyar bzhugs/ de'i rjes su slob dpon legs ldan 'byed kyis/mdo sde spyod pa'i rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol phye/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa yan chad du dbu ma thal 'gyur ba zhes yongs su ma grags pa la slob dpon 'dis thal 'gyur 'thad/ rang rgyud mi 'thad ces thal rang so sor phye nas/ thal 'gyur ba'i shing rta'i srol yongs grags btod pa yin te/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i legs bshad snying po las/ rang sde'i gzhung 'gyur ba dag las/rang rgyud 'dod mi 'dod brtags nas thal 'gyur 'thad/ rang rgyud mi 'thad ces pa ni/ dngos su zla ba'i zhabs rjes 'brang dang bcas pa min pa ma byung la/byung tshul ni sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis/ bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis don bkral ba la/ legs ldan 'byed kyis skyon bzung ba mi 'jug par ston pa'i skabs su/ tshig gsal las/ dbu ma pas / rang rgyud bya mi rigs pa'i sgrub byed dang ldog phyogs la gnod byed mang du bstan nas srol phye la/ zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang slob dpon 'phags pa lha/dpa' bo/ sangs rgyas bskyangs/ klu byang / tsand+ra go mi/ ye shes snying po/dpal sbas la sogs pa mang pos slob dpon klu sgrub kyi lugs bzung ste dar rgyas 186—88

su mdzad/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rang rgyud pa'i shing rta'i srol ni/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos phye ba yin te/ 'jam mgon bla mas/ des na sngar 'di 'dra ba'i lugs re re tsam byung mod kyang / gzhung rgyas par brtsams nas tha snyad du phyi rol 'gog pa'i grub mtha'i srol ni slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos phye bar/ slob dpon ye shes sde bzhed pa ltar legs so zhes gsungs/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/thogs med ces bya'i dge slong ni/ /bstan bcos kyi ni don la mkhas/ /mdo sde nges don drang ba'i don/ /rnam pa mang por rab tu 'byed/ /'jig rten rig pa ston bdag nyid/ /gzhung 'byed ngang tshul can du 'gyur/ /zhes sogs rgya cher lung bstan pa'i slob dpon chen po des/ lo bcu gnyis su byams pa bsgrubs te zhal gzigs/ byams pa'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas dga' ldan du byon / mi lo lnga bcu'i bar du rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i gsung gi bdud rtsi legs par gsan te/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa thugs su chud par mdzad/ byams chos sde lnga la sogs pa'i skyes bsnams te/'dzam bu'i gling du byon/ mdo sde dgongs pa nges 'grel la brten nas sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol phye/ sa sde lnga/ sdoms rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa bstan bcos rgya cher mdzad de/ rgya chen spyod rgyud kyi bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ de'i gcung po slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis rnam bden pa'i shing rta'i srol phye/ pra ka ra ṇa sde brgyad la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mtha' yas pa mdzad/ de la rang mkhas kyi slob ma bzhi las/ mngon pa rang las mkhas pa blo gros brtan pa/ phar phyin rang las mkhas pa rnam grol sde/ 'dul ba rang las mkhas pa yon tan 'od/ tshad ma rang las mkhas pa phyogs kyi glang 186—89

po / de'i slob ma dbang phyug sde/ de'i slob ma slob dpon chos kyi grags pa la sogs pa byung ste/ phyogs kyi glang pos rnam rdzun pa'i shing rta'i srol phye/ phyogs glang yab sras la brten nas tshad ma'i bstan bcos mtha' yas pa byung ste bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ gzhan yang rgyal ba'i sras po zhi ba lha/shākya 'od sogs mdor na 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis la sogs pa gnam gyi skar ma dang sa'i dreg pa lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis rgyu'i theg pa dang / grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa rnams kyis 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg pa phyogs thams cad du khyab par mdzad do/ /de yang lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las/ yul dbus nas lho phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro / /byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs shing /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las kyang / nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ /kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /sā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i gangs can gyi ljongs 'di thog mar chus gang ba las rim gyis chu bri ste/ stod g.ya' dang gangs la glang po che dang ri dwags/ bar brag dang spang ljongs la ri dwags dang spre'u/ smad rtsi shing nags tshal la spre'u dang brag srin gyis gang bar gyur / de la rgyal po bka' thang las/ bod yul gangs ri rtse dgu'i ljongs 'di ru: phur rgyal gong du mnga' mdzad drug tu byung : dang po gnod sbyin nag pos dbang byas te: yul ming bdud yul kha rag mgo dgur brtags: snga 106—90

rtags gnyen po btsan pa de nas byung : de nas bdud dang srin mos dbang byas te: ming yang lha srin gnyis kyi ming du btags: snga rtags sha za gdong pa dmar ba byung : de nas klu dang btsan gyis dbang byas te: yul gyi ming la bod khams gling dgur btags: snga rtags dkar bu chu la spyod pa byung :de nas ma sangs spun dgus dbang byas te: yul ming bod khams g.ya' drug bya bar btags: snga rtags mda' mdung mtshon cha de nas byung : de nas za ram skyes drug dbang byas te: yul ming stong sde bco brgyad bya bar btags:snga rtags rta zhon rna cha 'dogs pa byung : de nas rgyal phran bcu gnyis dbang byas te: yul gyi ming ni swa kha brgyad du btags: snga rtags phyag dang zhe sa de nas byung : gzhug tu pur rgyal btsan pos dbang byas te: ming yang bod khams ru bzhi bya bar btags: bod kyi btsan po 'o de spur rgyal de: gnam gyi lha las mi yi rje ru gshegs: zhes 'byung zhing dang por gnod sbyin gyis bzung bas ming bzang yul rgyan med du grags/ de nas bdud kyis bzung bas bdud yul kha rag mgo dgu/ srin pos bzung bas srin po nag po dgu yul/lhas bzung bas lha yul gung thang / dmus bzung bas 'phreng tsa 'phrang /'dres bzung bas lang thang ling thang / ma sangs kyis bzung bas bod kha nya drug /klus bzung bas bod khams gling dgu/ rgyal pos bzung bas dam po tse/'gong po spun dgus bzung bas stong sde bco brgyad du grags pa las nam zhig gi tshe thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs dang / sgrol ma'i sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin 'dus pa las sprel phrug drug byung ba 'phel ba las rim gyis mir gyur/ khag bzhir bgos pas se/ dmu/ ldong / stong ste mi'u rigs bzhi byung / rim 186wa 91

gyis mi'i rgyal khams su gyur/ de'i tshe mi rnams la rje med pa la gsang bdag las kyi rdo rje'i ye shes kyi gzigs ngor shar ba'i rdo rje'i bka' ltar na/ steng lha'i yul nas rje gnya' khri btsan po/ dmu thag la 'jus te sprin gyi shul phul nas byon pas 'od gsal lha'i gdung rim par byon par gsungs shing / slob dpon chen pos kyang / rigs mtho khungs btsun 'od gsal lha yi brgyud: mu khri btsan po gdung brgyud ma chad par: zhes gsungs/ yongs grags ltar na mang bkur rgyal po'i brgyud las/ rgyal po dmag brgya par sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sprul pa/ sras dung so g.yu'i smin ma can 'khrungs pa ltas ngan du dogs te spyugs pas 'phags pa'i thugs rjes yar klungs lha ri gyang tho'i rtser babs pa rim gyis lha ri rol po'i lha skas las babs te gshegs pa las/ bon po sogs yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis kyis gnya' bar btegs nas rjer bkur bas gnya' khri btsan por grags/ de nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa drug par kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi sku thog la pho brang yum bu gla sgang gi yang thog tu spang skong phyag brgya pa dang / gser gyi mchod rten/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo sogs babs te dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas gdung rabs lnga na 'jam dpal rtsa brgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas par/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa bī rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyi don bsgrubs te/ /longs spyod che dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod che ldan zhes/ /mi yi bdag po de yang 'grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid 186—92

byed / /des ni rkun ma rnam par spangs/ /rgyal po de yis srog spangs nas/ /de yis sngags ni myur bsgrubs te/ /zhi dang rgyas pa'i las byed pa'o/ /'jig rten sgrol ma zhes bya dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ /dkar mo chen mo gzhan don brtson/ /rtag tu yid ni mi skyo ba'o/ /zhes rgyal ba rang nyid kyis gsal bor lung gis bstan cing / bka' gdams glegs bam las kyang /bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ /mi dbang mdzod la der ni rgyal srid skyongs / /zhes gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mi dbang chos rgyal chen po'i tshul mdzad de/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul spyi dang khyad par du/ nga 'jig rten sgron ma zag med la/ /mi kho yi btsun mo byed do skad/ /ces pa dang / rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ /ces pa sogs rgya bal gyi btsun mo gnyis dang / lha sa ra mo che'i jo bo zung gdan 'dren tshul sogs gsal por lung gis bstan pa bzhin du 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sku bltams/ rgya bal gyi btsun mo gnyis dang lhan cig par jo bo shākya mu ne dang mi bskyod rdo rje gnyis spyan drangs/mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang dang / bcas pa gsar du bzhengs / thu mi sasto ṭas tog gzungs/ sher phyin 'bum pa/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig rnams bsgyur zhing / yi ge dang bstan pa'i srol btod / rgyal pos las can mang por man ngag lkog chos kyi tshul du gsungs te grub pa'i rig 'dzin mang du byung / de nas srong btsan gyi zhal chems su/ nga 'das gdung rabs lnga pa na/ /nga yi ming la lde btags pa/ /chos skyong ba yi rgyal po 'byung / /'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa ste/ /de yis dam chos rgyas 106—93

par byed/ /tha mar mngon par 'tshung yang rgya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lha sa btab nas lo dgu bcu go dgu pa/ lcags rtar 'jam dpal rdo rje'i sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams/ rim gyis mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs/ pho brang rlung tshubs su kha che a nandas lo tsā byas nas dge ba bcu/ khams bco brgyad rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi chos gsungs par/ bod kyi lha srin rnams 'khrugs te/ shastos yar klung phang thang gi gtsug lag khang chu la bskur/ thang lhas dmar po ri'i rtser thog phab/ brtan mas mi phyugs kyi nad yams mang po btang ste dam pa'i chos bsgyur du ma bcug /bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang bzheng bar bzhed pa la/ lha srin rnams kyis brtsig tu ma ster bas/ mkhan pos lung bstan pa bzhin 'dzam gling na che ba'i brtul zhugs grub pa slob dpon padma sam bha wa spyan drangs/ lha srin thams cad dam la btags/ bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa gegs med du grub/ dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs te rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su mdzad / khri srong gi sras mu tig btsan po ni/ rgyal po bka' thang las/mjing yon mu tig btsan po'i sku ring la: dpal gyi bsam yas shar sgo'i mtshams su ni: dam pa'i rgya mkhar rtse dgu bzhengs su gsol: skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs: yab mes gtsug lag lha khang kun rnams mchod: bka' khrims thang khrims sngar bas bzang bar bskyangs: chos skyong rgyal po'i rnam thar rtags bzung nas: gsang sngags 'bras bu'i chos rnams nyams su blangs: spyi bor slob dpon rang lus yi dam lha: ngag tu gsang sngags rdo rje'i bzlas pa mdzad: dam chos bstan pa khri gdugs brdal ba 106—94

'dra: bshad grwa sgom grwa'i bstan pa btsugs nas ni: rdo rje slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang : lo tsā bai ro tsa na la sogs kyis: gsang sngags theg chen 'bras bu dar bar mdzad: slob dpon mtshan gsol mu tig btsan po zhes:yab kyis mtshan gsol khri lde srong btsan zhes: nang blon mtshan gsol mjing yon sad na legs: rgya yis mtshan gsol mu tig btsan po zhes: 'dzam gling sum gnyis dbang du bsdus nas ni: khra yi gdong can 'dzam gling shar phyogs kyi: shud pu'i yul khams mngar bsdus bran du bkol: lho phyogs bong rkang grul bum tshe spong yul: kun kyang mngar bsdus bran dang g.yog tu bkol:nub phyogs gtsang mi byi la'i mjug ma can: sbal gnon yul khams mngar bsdus bran du bkol: byang phyogs sna rnams ri bong rna ba can: bran du byas te mngar bsdus bran du bkol: rgyal po'i mnga' thang dag ni dgung bas mtho: 'bangs kyi chab srid chu bo'i bzhung bas ring : dang po chab srid bzhes ma khad du ni: mtha' bzhi phyogs brgyad bka' btsan chab srid la:phyogs bzhir rgyal po sde bzhi gnas pa yang : bar du bka' khon byung nas dgra ru bsdoḥ srin po gdong dmar bod kyi dmag dpung g.yos: chab srid bod dmag kha tsho brgya chas te: dmag dpon rgyal po 'dul ba'i dus su ni: sngon gyi bshul sel gyad mi rta zhon brgya: g.yas kyi ru 'dren dpa' bo stag chas brgya: g.yon gyi ru 'dren sngags mkhan phur thogs brgya: slad kyi rjes myul zhub chen mdung thogs brgya: rgya yul gshog pa'i phyogs su dmag gis phul:khyad kyi dpa' bo dmag gi sna la bskos: pha rol dpung 'joms mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor: chab srid mnga' thang do zla med par byas: lho phyogs rgya 186—95

gar rgyal po bzhugs pa yang : rā dza dharma dpal dang dre'u dpon gnyis:dmag sgo gcod pa bka' yis sa bsgugs nas: rgya gar rgyal srid bod kyi bran du byas: rgya gar yul gyi nor rdzas rin po che: kha zas bzang dgu dus las ma 'das phul: rgya gar stod smad rgyal po chen po gnyis: rang la mnyan cing bka' la gces spras byed: nub phyogs ta zig rgyal po bzhugs pa yang / /rgyal po la mer mu dang hab gdal gyis: bod kyi bka' la gces par bzung nas ni: rin chen nor dang sman gyi lnga dos dang : kha zas gces pa dus las ma yol phul: byang phyogs ge sar gru gu bzhugs pa yang : bar du bka' khon byung nas bsdo ba la: srin po gdong dmar bod kyi dmag g.yos nas:gru gu yul gyi yong du yan chod du: bod kyi dmag dpung sbra nag phab nas ni: yul brlag mi rnams mon gyi sa la bskyal: khyim mkhar mon gyi sa la btod nas kyang : yul du mi ngan bsten pa sun phyung ste: spa bkong ded dpon yul 'khor 'tsho bar bzhag: gru gu ge sar bod kyi bran du byas: bod kyi dmag dpung li yi yul du phab: li yul lcang ra smug po bran du spyad:bod dmag shar phyogs rgya nag yul du phab: rgya nag be chu'i rgyal po chen po yis: rang gi chab srid mnga' thang bod la phul: dar zab lnga dos rin chen mang po dang : kha zas gces pa dus las ma 'das phul: bsam yas mthil du bstan pa'i gzhi ma btsugs: bla mchod rab byung zhabs 'og rnge'u bton:mchims phu yer par sgom grwa'i bstan pa btsugs: bsam yas lha sar bshad grwa'i bstan pa btsugs: zhes gsungs pa ltar chos srid gnyis ka nas stobs 'byor gyi dpal gyis mngon par mtho zhing / bshad sgrub gnyis ku'i bstan par 101—96

sri zhu bla na med pa'i sgo nas/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'di'i khor yug thams cad dge legs kyi snang bas khyab par mdzad pa'i byed po gcig tu byung ba zhig go/ /srong btsan zhal chems las/ de nas mi rabs gnyis pa la/ /phyag na rdo rje'i sprul ba ste/ /rgyal po khri zhes bya ba 'byung / /des kyang dam chos rgyas par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ mnga' bdag khri lde srong btsan ral pa can gyis 'on ljang rdo'i lha khang bzhengs/ bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/rjes su glang dar gyis bstan pa bsnubs te nyams chag tu gyur pa la/ dmar g.yo gtsang gsum mdo smad dan tig tu bros te bzhugs pa la bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyis bsnyen par rdzogs te rim gyis bstan pa'i me ro gsos/ lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang byang chub 'od kyis pā la spyan drangs te/ pā la rnam gsum bsnyen par rdzogs pas snga ma la smad 'dul dang phyi ma la stod 'dul du grags/khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis/ kha che'i bsod snyoms pa chen po paṇa chen shākya shrīr/ ma gha dha sogs rig 'byung gnas ni sdig to yi/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcoms o rgyan kha che bal yul kyang / /log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs bskyod zhu/ /zhes sogs kyi zhu 'phrin skyes bzang po dang bcas pa phul te spyan drangs pa las bsnyen par rdzogs pa/ paṇa chen sdom rgyun du grags pa 'phel zhing mdo sngags kyi bstan pa mchog tu gsal bar mdzad/ lhag par gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa dri bcas su gyur pa na/ lha btsun sku mched kyis jo bo rje dpal ldan mar me mdzad gdan drangs/ jo 'brom yab sras kyi bka' drin las/bka' gdams rin po che'i rnam thar gtsang ma'i bstan pa bla na med pa phyogs 186—97

thams cad du dar zhing bka' babs gnyis ldan gyi gdams pa gsung rab thams cad kyi dgongs bcud gcig tu dril ba/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i rnam gzhag byang chub lam sgron du grags pa mdzad cing 'phel bas/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur/ zangs mkhar lo tsā ba/ rā lo/ gnyan lo/ rga lo / dpyal lo/ glo bo lo tsā ba/ 'byo lo la sogs kyi lo paṇa du mas mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ mdor na zhi byed/ spyod yul/ sa rnying / bka' brgyud nang gses las so sor phye ba/ kur 'brug sogs tshad ma mchis pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'khrul med 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas/'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la ngal bsor mdzad pa'i mkhas grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon te gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad do/ /de lta na'ang / slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis ji ltar bzhed pa'i zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba dri ma med pa dang / tshul gnyis kyi mdo'i drang nges kyi rnam par dbye ba shin tu zab cing gting mi dpogs pa dag dang / 'dus ba'i sgyu lus kyi zab gnad mkhas grub phal mo che'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa dag gsal bar bya ba dang /stod dza ti rgyug pas brdungs pa nas/ smad chen po hor gyi rgyal khams kyi bar gyi 'jig rten thams cad du/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa dri ma med pa lhag par gsal bar mdzad pa'i byed pa po ni 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal yin pas/ 'di ni 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las / yi ge ba zhes sdom brtson grags/ /de las gzhan pa dang yig ra/ /dang po'i yi ge pa grags pa/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan don yang byed/ /blo ldan dang po yi ge ma/ /de bzhin sdom brtson dad pa 'byung / /rnam pa du mar 186—98

sdom brtson gsungs/ /de tshe mtha' yas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /sdom brtson thams cad bsgrags pa yang / /ston pa'i bstan pa gsal bar byed/ /bstan pa de tshe sa steng du/ /rnam par nyams shing snang med la/ /ston pa'i gzugs brnyan yid du 'ong / /byed par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /ces pa nas grags pa 'dzin par shes par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mtshan sgra/ jo bo rin po che longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam pa can du zhal bsgyur dang / 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyams par gso bar mdzad pa'i bya ba sogs sgo thams cad nas gsal por lung gis bstan cing / rgyud de nyid las/ de tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ kha ba can nang yod pa yi/ /zhes pas dga' ldan gyi dgon pa'i mtshan zur gsal por bstan/ padma bka' chems las/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa gdul bya bstan pa'i bdag: mdo sngags bstan 'dzin blo bzang grags pa zhes: mi rabs brgyad du gsang sngags rgyas par ston: zhing 'di 'das nas byams pa'i drung du 'gro: de yi rgyud 'dzin tshe gcig sangs rgyas yin: zhes pa dang / ratna'i spyi lung chen mo las/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa gsang sngags bstan 'dzin pa:blo gros stobs ldan grags pa'i ming can 'byung : zhes pa sogs bka' gter du ma nas/ 'jam dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul rtsod med du lung gis zin pa yongs grags dang 'das pa'i dus su de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rigs mchog tu mngon par byang chub pa sogs kyi bshad pa'ang khungs dang 'brel mod/ 'dir ni gong du bshad pa bzhin mdor hril gyis dril na 'phags pa 'jam dpal shākya'i rgyal po nyid kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas 'gro ba kun gyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po shākya'i rgyal po nyid zhing 'dir 'jam mgon bla ma blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi 185wa 99

skur bzhengs par 'dod cing lung dang rigs pa gnyis gas 'grub pas de ltar khas blangs par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i bdag nyid chen po 'di mdo khams tsong kha'i yul du sku bltams/ kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rje/ chos rje don 'grub rin chen/'bri gung spyan snga rin chen/ bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gdan sa thel spyan snga chos kyi grags pa/ kun mkhyen red mda' pa/ grub chen dpa' bo rdo rje/ gsang bdag las kyi rdo rje sogs mkhas grub du ma las/ zab rgyas kyi gdams pa'i chos ris su ma chad pa gsan cing / mdo rgyud thams cad la mkhyen pa'i cha shas yongs su rdzogs pas skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i gnad thams cad phyin ci ma log par ston pa bklags pas kun shes byang chub lam gyi rim pa che chung du grags pa dang /snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ kun mkhyen bu la sogs pa'i 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyis kyang / ma dgongs pa ltar snang ba'i drang nges kyi mdo rnam dbye legs par 'byed pa'i gsung rab rin po che legs bshad snying po/ zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba 'khrul med du ston pa'i legs bshad rig pa'i rgya mtsho dang dgongs pa rab gsal/ rgyud sde bzhi'i rnam dbye thams cad gsal bar byed pa sngags rim chen mo/ rim pa lnga'i gnad sngon chad gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir yongs su ma grags pa gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad rim lnga gsal sgron sogs mdor na gsung gi gsang ba gsung rab thams cad kyi gnad lhag par ston pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rlabs po che'i phyag rjes su 'jog par gnang ba ni/ gzu bor gnas pa'i blos brtags na/ 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub thams cad las kyang lhag por gyur pa nyid du 'khums te/ 'phags yul gyi gzhung chen mo rnams ni rang res 106—100

rtogs par dka' ba dang / gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir thub pa'i gsung dri ma med pa khungs su bzung zhing / shing rta chen po gnyis la sogs pa'i 'phags yul gyi gzhung chen mo rnams kyis legs par brgyan/ dgos don gyi dka' gnad che sa thams cad lhug par bkral/ dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la phab nas legs par brtags pa bzhin gyi tshig don rnams yid la 'char bde zhing 'khrul pa'i go skabs mi 'jug pa gong du bshad pa'i gsung rab de lta bu sus kyang ma bkral ba dang / 'dul bar dka' ba'i snyigs ma lnga bdo mthar thug pa'i nang nas/rgya hor gyi skye dgu mtha' dag 'dul ba'i mdzad pa dam pa gzhan rnams las lhag par stobs che ba dang / rdzing che'i zhig gso/ gnyal lung ra chen mo gsar 'dzugs sogs mdzad chen bzhi'i nang nas khyad du 'phags pa mnyan yod mchod pa'i dus ston lha sa smon lam du grags pa blos mi 'byung ba'i ston pa'i dus mchod da lta'i bar du yar rgyas su gyur te mchis pa dang / shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang lha sa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa zhig gso dang / thub pa'i dbang po'i zhal skyin longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam par bsgyur ba'i sgo nas jo bo klu yul du gshegs pa'i gnas skabs ring por bsrings shing / rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa phyogs dus su/ rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo khyad par can bsgrigs par mdzad pa dang / 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i kun mkhyen za hor bzhad pa da lta'i mi'i dbang po sogs kyi mdzad pa bla na med pa 'gro kun bde skyid kyi dpal la 'god par mdzad pa'i byed po rnams kyang / mgon po 'di'i thugs bskyed kyi mthu sha stag las byung ba yin pas/ de bas na mgon po 'di ni phyi ltar du 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra rags thams cad las cung zad nyams pa mi mnga' ba'i rten gyi 106—101

sgo nas/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug padma sam bha wa sogs las kyang khyad par du 'phags shing / thub pa'i nyi ma dgung du gshegs shing / mkhas grub dam pa gzhan gyis yal bar dor ba'i dus su snying stobs kyi go cha btsan po bzhes te gshegs pas/ bstan pa'i bdag po rang nyid las kyang bka' drin mchog tu gyur pa'i sgo nas 'phags pa dang / gong du bshad pa bzhin bdag nyid chen po 'di dang sku thog mnyam pa dang / phyis su byon pa'i mkhas grub bsam las 'das kyang gsung gi mdzad pa dang 'phrin las mtha' mi 'gog pa'i sgo nas dam pa 'di nyid lhag por gyur pa yin no/ /'jam dpal dbyangs la sogs pa'i rgyal ba zhi khro dang bgro ba mdzad pa'i lo rgyus rnam thar phyi nang rnams su yongs su grags mod/ 'ol dwags kyi mtshams/ rgyal sog dgon du sgrub pa mdzad dus gzims phug gi mdun ri'i rtser gshin rje gshed kyi zhal gzigs dus ling gas rdo bu thal byung du phug pa'i rjes dang / brag la phyag zhabs kyi rjes 'dam la btab pa lta bur gsal ba mthun grub tu mjal rgyu yod pa de bzhin la 'di dag gis mtshon te thun mong ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa yang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan / paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa/ rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / rje btsun shes rab seng ge ste 'gran zla med pa'i sras kyi thu bo bzhi/ rtogs ldan 'jam dkar ba/ bzang skyong ba/ rin rgyal ba/ byang se ba/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/ shes rab grags pa/ 'jam dpal bkra shis/ dpal skyong ba ste 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ byang sems shākya bsod nams/ byang sems kun dga' bzang po/ byang sems blo gros rgyal mtshan / byang sems tshul khrims dpal bzang / byang sems gzhon nu rgyal 186—102

mchog /byang sems rgyal mtshan grags bzang ste sems dpa' chen po drug /'gos lo gzhon nu dpal/ stag lung lo tsā ba/ spyan snga dpal ldan bzang po/spyan snga bsod nams bzang po/ spyan snga byang chub rdo rje/ spyan snga bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs thel pa dang / 'bri gung rin chen don grub rgyal po/ stag lung rin chen bkra shis dpal 'od sogs gdung dang gdan sa mkhyen spyod kyis mngon par mtho ba'i mkhas grub rnams dang / 'phrin las mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bstan pa'i sgron me lta bu bcu/ snga tshar ba bzhi/ rang skya thub pa'i paṇa grub brgya dang bzhi bcu sogs slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar 'dus shing so sos kyang mdo rgyud kyi don legs par bkral te/ dri ma med pa'i bstan pas bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams thams cad khyab par mdzad do/ /de bas na bstan pa'i bdag po shākya'i rgyal po nas bzung ste/ da lta'i bar gyi mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug bstan pa rin po che'i sgron me spangs rtogs kyi yon tan gyis mngon par mtho ba phal mo che bdag nyid chen po 'di'i rnam par 'phrul pa sha stag tu nges pas zhwa ser gyi rang lugs 'dzin pa gcig pu'i ston par mi bzung gi/bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi mgon po sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba yin no/ /blon po bka' thang las/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan nyid: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las lnga: 'phrul lnga bsgyur ba'i stobs su 'gyur: 'dra min gcig dang ma nor na: gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'gro don mdzad: byang ming 'dul skyong gnam sa'i bdag: za hor cham la 'bebs pa 'byung : zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi sku'i sprul pa paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa ni/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/186—103

nga khrims ldan mkhan po'i sku ston kyang / /gang thugs rje chen por su yis shes/ /zhes pa dang / mtho bkra shis brtan pa lhun po'i bdag /zhes bkra shis lhun po'i dgon pa gsar du bskrun pa'i mtshan sgra bcas gsal bar lung gis bstan/nga gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta/ /chos gang la gang yin der ston kyang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gsung sprul thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/mi nga yi sprul pa phyogs ris med/ /chos lam du song na bsgrub bya yin/ /zhes dang / bod byang gi phyogs nas byang phyogs su/ /'bangs mgon med mang po 'dul du 'gro/ /zhes sog yul du chibs bsgyur bar bstan pa ltar gyi thugs sprul thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ mi nga yi bstan pa bshig pa rnams / /tshe de la tshe srog thung na yang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar yon tan gyi sprul pa thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho sogs rim par byon te/ bstan pa'i gsal byed bla na med pa mdzad/ bod kha ba can gyi gdul bya rnams/ /bu snying med pha la gshe ba bzhin/ /nga phan bde'i 'byung gnas rin chen la/ /sems rtogs pa che zhes smod par byed/ /ces pa'i 'phrin las kyi sprul pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dang / sku 'phreng phyi ma rgyal ba drug pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho bstan pa las/ dang po thams cad mkhyen pa gong sa lnga pa chen po ni/ ratna'i spyi lung las/ de nas sngon gyi thugs bskyed rgyal po ni: thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa dbus su 'byung : blo gros stobs ldan bzang po'i 'od zer can: sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro ba'i kha lo bsgyur: chos kyi rgyal po dpung dang bcas pa 'byung : bya yi mgo bo phag gi mjug ma can:gung gi tshang 'cha' sa yi zas za zhing : mig bzhi gyen thur dag la blta bar 106—104

byed: lce gnyis bden rdzun gnyis kyi shan stangs byed: dbus gtsang thams cad sku yi chab 'og 'dus: rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan bstan pa'i bdag po 'byung : lha sa dmar po ri dang chu bo ri: has po ri dang dbus ri de gsum la:pho brang bcas nas dbu g.yor mtha' gsum sdud: gtsang gi ngam ru ri dang ri bo che: la stod rdo rje'i ri dang de gsum la: pho brang bcas nas gtsang gi ru gnyis dang : mnga' ris bal po'i sar rnams dbang du sdud: dbus gtsang rnams su chos grwa bcu gsum 'cha': gzhan gyi rdzong rnams rtsig rmang tsam yang med: la 'jam lung 'jam thams cad gser khur lam: nor yod gnyer 'tsho mi dgos gang yod phan: med rnams btsal 'gro mi dgos kun kyang skyid: dbu zlum mdo yi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas: lcang lo sngags pa'i bstan pas grub thob khengs: pha ma'i drin glon nad pa legs par srel: bla ma slob dpon rje 'bangs dpon g.yog sogs: che chung bzang ngan steng 'og shan yang 'byed: ngan byed mthar 'don mi ngan mthor mi 'jug: bzang 'dren ya rabs kun la bya dga' byed: pho mo na gzhon thams cad nyan bshad byed:bsam rdzogs rgan pa thams cad don la bsgom: rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing lci la sbram: chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'jam la dam: nad mtshon mu ge'i sdug bsngal ming yang med: kun kyang bde skyid lha yul lta bur 'tsho:zhes mtshan sgra/ dus rtags/ mdzad tshul sogs gsal por lung gis bstan pa bzhin gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po'i skur bzhengs te sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis dbus gtsang khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i rgyal khams mtha' dag chab 'og tu bsdus te dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i bstan pa khyab 106—105
