gdal gcig tu mdzad pa po ni kun mkhyen chen po 'di nyid yin pas/ zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs la chos srid gnyis ka nas mtshungs pa med pa'i bka' drin gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed pa po 'di las gzhan du med pas/ rjes 'brangs rnams kyi bka' drin bskal pa'i bar du yang gzhal bar dka'o/ /rgya bod hor gsum gyi yul gru thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la bkod/ bstan pa rin po che lhag par gsal bar mdzad de/ nub par nye ba'i bstan pa rin po che thams cad kyang srog mthud/ zab rgyas kyi chos 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor te skal ldan rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa rlabs po che'i sgo nas gzhan gyis 'gran par mi nus pa'i mdzad bzang gi srol snga na med pas khor yug tu khyab par mdzad de/ da lta'i bar du dga' ldan pho brang gi sde srid 'dzin pa thams cad rgyal ba 'di nyid kyi rjes su zhugs te/ 'tsho bar byed pa yin no/ /gong du drangs pa'i bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i lung dang slob dpon chen pos kyang / lho mon shing lo'i tshal zhes bya ba ru: rgyal po'i tshul gyis sems can don mdzad pa: dge slong rin chen btsan po zhes bya ni: lnga ldan dus kyi snyigs ma'i mtha' la 'byung : zhes bstan pa ltar gyi kun mkhyen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos thabs mkhas kyi sgyu 'phrul sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ lhag par 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i gsung par srid gsum rgyan gcig khyad par can 'di nyid kyi dbu 'dzugs dang / shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi khor yug gser sbyangs kyi snang ba 'bum du 'dzag pa'i mda' yab kyis khyab par mdzad/ de nas mong gol gyi rgyal po ju rig tu hong tha'i jis 186 —106

gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dmag drangs/ sngags rnying ma'i gtsug lag khang thams cad bshig sku gsung thugs rten rnams chu la sbyangs/ skye bo mang po khrims mun du btsud/ dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyang nyung shas su gyur pas bod khams dar cig mun pa'i gling lta bur gyur pa la/ yang gsang rgya can las/me tog padma'i kha ni zla bas 'byed/ /ces pa dang / gnam stong mun pa'i smag tu nyi ma 'char/ /'dam khrod nor bu rgyal mtshan tog tu 'god/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ padma dang 'dra ba'i rgyal ba'i dbang po kun mkhyen bskal bzang rgya mtsho/ zla zer dang mtshungs pa'i ldog phyogs hor tha'i ji'i byed pas rkyen byas gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir byon zhing/ bod yul gnam stong gi mun pa'i smag rum lta bur gyur pa la gnam bskos/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i 'phrin las kyi mthu las/ rgyal ba'i dbang po'i mdzes zhal gyi nyin byed gsar du shar te/ mtha' 'khob kyi yul nas gru 'dzin gyi pho brang chen po'i gser khrir gshegs pa 'dam khrod kyi nor bu rgyal mtshan gyi tog tu bkod pa lta bu ste/ ngo mtshar gyi snang bas phyogs dus thams cad khyab par mdzad pas lung don thog tu khel bas da lta'i bar du bstan pa rin po che'i dpal yon du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa yin no/ /gangs can mgon po 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang ngo bo gcig kyang ldog pa tha dad pa'i tshul gyis rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhugs pa mgon po 'od mi 'gyur ba las 'od dpag med dang / gar gyi dbang po'i mtshan gyis bsnyad pa'i bde bar gshegs pa de nyid bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa'i dus su 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug sras kyi thu bo mig mi 'dzum zhes bya bar gyur pa'i yab 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud ces bya 186—107

bar gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che snying po'i drung du lhan cig par thugs bskyed pa'i tshul mdzad/ khye'u rin chen mchog tu gyur pa'i tshe rgyal po dpal gyi gzi brjid du gyur nas yab sras kyi tshul dang / rgyal bu 'jig rten dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs rgyal por gyur dus sangs rgyas 'od mdzad ye shes tog tu gyur nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdzad pa dang / bram ze'i khye'u gsal ba'i dus su blo gros 'jigs med / rgyal po dkon mchog 'bangs kyi dus su bla ma dri ma med pa mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje/ dad pa brtan pa'i dus su mya ngan bral/ khri srong lde btsan gyi dus su padma sam bha wa/ 'brom gyi dus su jo bo rje/ dge 'dun grub kyi dus su 'jam mgon bla ma tsong khang chen po dang mkhas grub rje/ rgya can las/ 'gro don spyod pa'i skye ba bdun/ /rim byung khyod nyid lnga pa ste/ /zhes pa dang /dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung las/ skye ba bdun du 'gro don legs byas nas/ /zag med chos kyi dbyings su sdud par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi ngur smrig 'chang ba'i zlos gar bdun pa chen po/ rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho 'di nyid kyi dus su/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i ma hā paṇḍi ta thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes dang / rnam pa thams cad du bde ba can gyi zhing khams su phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba dang / 'dren pa 'od dpag med pa yab sras 'du 'bral med pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa sogs/mdor na glegs bam rin po che las/ bla ma mya ngan bral gyi zhal nas/ khyod kyi bsams pa tsam gyis kyang / /nga ni thogs pa med par 'ong / /skye ba dpag tu med pa yi/ /khyod kyi bshes gnyen nga yin mod/ /ces pa dang / bskal pa bye 186—108

ba bsam yas su/ /yab sras tsanda dri bzhin du/ /'bral med 'gro ba'i phan bde 'byung / /zhes thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar du 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang tshul gyis/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug dang lhan cig par 'tsho zhing gzhes la tha mi dad pa'i rnam 'dren gyi snying por dril na/ gong du bshad pa bzhin bstan pa'i bdag po shākya'i rgyal po nyid/ paṇḍi ta'i rnam par bzhengs pa paṇa chen rin po che rim par byon pa rnams kyis/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum mtha' klas pa'i sgo nas skal ldan du ma smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ dag pa'i zhing khams thams cad dog por mdzad/ da lta'i bar du 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po'i 'phrin las kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i thugs rjes rgya hor bod gsum la khyab ste/bstan pa rin po che'i sgron mer gyur pa 'di ste/ de ltar bstan pa'i gsal byed du gyur pa rnams kyis bstan pa dar bar mdzad tshul cha tsam smos pa las/ zhib par ni 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyis kyang / bskal pa nas bskal pa'i bar du brjod par dka' ba yin no//gsum pa bye brag tu bshad pa la lnga ste/ da lta gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bka' 'gyur rin po che zhes phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa 'di ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / skabs don gsung par rin po che srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta 'di nyid gang gis rdzogs par bzhengs pa'i chos kyi rgyal po chen po'i rtogs pa brjod pa dang / byung ba dngos brjod pa dang / phan yon gyis mjug bsdu ba dang / smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sprin chen po'i mdo las / mdo sde rnams ni re re la/ /gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /bsgyur ba'i 106—109

don ni mang yod ces/ /chos gsungs pas ni nges par bstan/ /gzungs kyi 'bab chu'i ming rnams kyang / /re re nas ni rab dbye na/ /don mang dri ba mang yod ces/ /chos gsungs pas ni nges par bstan/ /kun dga' bo dang 'dra ba'i mi/ /dkrigs phrag bye ba snyed yod la/ /mdo las gcig gi tshad bzung phyir/ /skyes bu dam pa byung gyur te/ /skyes bu dam pa de kun las/ /skyes bu khyu mchog re re yang / /lha yi lo mang bye brgyar thub/ /skyes bu brtan po re re yang / /rang rang gi ni lce tshogs rnams/ /mdo sde dag gi ming gi phyir/ /byin gyis brlabs par byas pa dang / /de dag gi ni thabs tshul gyis/ /skyes bu skyes mchog de dag gis/ /mdo sde rnams ni re re yi/ /ming tsam dag kyang bslab pa'i phyir/ /lo mang bye ba brgya pa yi/ /skyes bu de 'dra de kun gyis/ /'bab chu 'dra ba'i ming bzung yang / /tha mar phyin par mi nus te/ /bcom ldan mdo ni bsam mi khyab/ /ting 'dzin grangs kyang de bzhin te/ /gsang ba bshad pa bsam mi khyab/ /ces pa dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ lha'i bu de bzhin gshegs pas chos ji snyed mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i chos 'dul ba de las/ bye ba'i cha'am bye ba stong gi cha'am bye ba brgya stong gi cha shas kyang ngas ma bshad do/ /gang ngas bshad pa de las bye ba brgya stong gi cha shas kyang / dge slong kun dga' bos ma bzung ngo zhes bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la tshad med pa dang / de dag las bstan pa'i bdag pos yongs grags la gsungs pa ni ches nyung zhing / de bas kyang kun dga' bos bzung ba nyung bar gsungs la/ kun dga' bos bzung ba'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi chos kyi phung po de dag 'bri ba la yang / dpag tshad bdun 186—110

yod pa'i lus can gi glang po che sa la rab brtan des/ ji ltar 'khur nus pa'i khal rgyab tu longs pa'i snag tsha dgos par phar phyin don gsal gyi rgya 'grel las/theg pa bla na med pa'i dbang du byas te/ dbang po'i glang po che rab brtan gyis 'khur bar 'os pa'i snag tshas ni chos kyi phung po gcig 'bri bar nus so/ /zhes gsungs mod/ 'on kyang spyi tsam du yongs su grags pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi ni tshad/ /bye ba phrag ni drug nges te/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs/ /bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grags/ /theg chen las gzhan mdo sde rnams/ /dung phyur phrag brgyad gsungs pa yin/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /sa ya dang ni dung phyur lnga/ /'di dag thams cad thub dbang po / /sku gsum bdag nyid can gyis gsungs/ /zhes pa dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan las/ gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig /rdo rje 'phreng ba 'bum phrag gsum / /dgongs pa lung ston stong phrag bzhi/ /lha mo bzhis zhus brgya bdun cu / /phyi ma'i rgyud la nyis brgya brgyad/ /de yi nye bar bshad pa'i rgyud/ /dam tshig chen po lnga bcu lnga/ /rdo rje lnga 'dus stong phrag gcig /kun las btus pa 'bum phrag gcig /mnyam nyid rnam rgyal nyis brgya bcu/ /zla gsang thig le stong phrag bdun/ /rdo rje sa 'og brgya nyi shu/ /cod pan rdo rje bdun brgya lnga/ /khro zla thig le 'bum phrag lnga/ /rdo rje rnam rgyal brgya dgu brgya/ /mnyam nyid gsang ba stong phrag lnga/ /rdo rje gsang rgyan stong phrag lnga/ /rdo rje gsang mdzod stong phrag bdun/ /nor bu gsang thig 'bum phrag bcu/ /snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul stong dang brgya/ /rdo rje snying rgyan stong phrag gcig /rdo rje thod pa nyis brgya brgyad / /de nyid brgya stong brgya stong bdun/ /dam tshig mngon rgyan stong phrag 186—111

gsum / /'jam dpal dpa' bo 'bum phrag gcig /gsang chen bsdus pa brgya lnga bcu/ /rin chen sdong po dgu brgya bdun/ /dus kyi thig le brgya brgyad cu/ /lha mo bstan bcos lnga brgya bdun/ /'di rnams dgongs pa'i bye brag gis/ /nga yis yang dag bstan par bya/ /zhes rgyud gcig pur yang bsam las 'das pa gsungs shing / de yang mdo sde rnam par spyod pa'i sa chen po lha yul/ sher phyin rgyas pa bye ba phrag brgya pa dri za'i yul/ 'bring 'bum phrag brgya pa lha'i dbang po'i gnas/ kye rdo rje 'bum phrag lnga pa dang / gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ bde mchog mngon par brjod pa chen po le'u 'bum dang / /rgyud phyi ma sho lo ka 'bum pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo stong phrag bcu gnyis pa/ rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa sum khri drug stong / sgyu 'phrul dra ba stong phrag bcu drug /ma hā ma ya stong phrag brtswa brgyad/ gshin rje dmar po'i rgyud 'bum phrag gsum pa / sgrol ma mngon 'byung le'u bdun brgya/ rta mgrin gyi rtog pa bdun brgya pa/don yod zhags pa'i rgyud 'bum phrag bdun pa rnams pa 'dar byed gling dang /lha'i yul/ shambha la/ u rgyan gyi yul rnams su bzhugs pas 'phags yul du yang med par bu ston chos 'byung las gsungs/ de ltar 'phags yul du dar ba rnams las kyang gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir/ lo paṇa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gdan drangs shing bsgyur ba ches nyung mod/ de dag las 'jam dpal rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul mi rje khri srong lde btsan gyi lha sras mu tig btsan po'am/ sad na legs mjing yon gyi dus su lo tsā ba ka ba dpal brtsegs/ chos kyi snying po/de leṇḍa/ dpal gyi lhun po sogs kyis 'phang thang ka ba med pa'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la/ mtshan dang bam grangs le'u shlau ka 106—112

rnams zhib par gtan la phab ste them byang bkod par dkar chag 'phang thang ma zhes bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu sgril ba'i thog ma yin/ 'ga' zhig 'di las ldan dkar ma snga bar bzhed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ de rjes ska ba dpal brtsegs dang 'khon klu'i dbang po sogs kyis stong thang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams bsgrigs nas dkar chag ldan dkar ma mdzad/ dkar chag 'di dag tu gsang sngags phyi'i rgyud rnams zhib mor bkod/ rjes gsang sngags nang gi rgyud rnams chos gnyan pas re zhig 'dir ma bkod/ ces pa'i shugs la nang gi rgyud sems phyogs mdo sgyu/ sgrub sde brgyad sogs snga 'gyur gyi rgyud phal cher 'gyur bar bstan pa dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi dus rlangs khams pa go chas 'bum thugs la bzung ste bsgyur bas thugs 'gyur ma dang / rgyal po'i mtshal khrag dang / ra dkar gyi 'o ma sbyar nas bzhengs pa dum pa bzhi pa la reg zig dmar po/ dbu skra'i gzhob rams la bsres te ra dkar gyi 'o ma dang sbyar nas bris pa'i reg zig sngon po dum pa bzhi pa de la lcags thur brgyus pas lcags thur ma ste/ reg zig sngo dmar gnyis po 'dir rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi yab yob tu bsgyur bas ming der thogs/ bla 'gyur chung ba zer/ sbas mañdzu shri dang / nyang ind+ra wa ro gnyis kyis bslangs pa'i —rgya dpe'i steng nas yo byad rnams 'bangs la bsdus te bsgyur bas dpya 'bum du grags/ reg zig sngo dmar rnams ha cang bsdus drags pas bee ros rgya dpe dang bstun nas zhus dag mdzad / dum pa drug pa glegs shing la par bkab bcos pa las par bkab can du grags/ gsung rab kyi bar du pha wang gi tshang bcas par pha wang can du thogs shing / bla 'gyur 'bring po zer/ 'brom bza' byang chub sman gyis ke ru 106—113

gling du gnyer tshang bgyis te/ dge 'dun sum brgyar zas sna bcu gsum res mchod pa sogs bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa bgyis te/ gdugs tshod thon pa dang / yum rgyas pa las bam po re la shog dril re byas pa'i steng nas tshar re sgrogs te shog dril rnams sha sgro zhig gi nang du bsdu bar byed pa las sha sgro can du grags / mu tig btsan po'i sras mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa las/ rta'i lo la btsan po khri lde srong btsan pho brang skyi smad 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag gsar rnying brje ba dang / rkun chen btul/gar log gi pho nyas phyag 'tshal/ blon chen bzhang khri/ zur ram shag dang mang rje lta 'dod la sogs pas rgya las srid gcig mang po bcad de rnga rta dang ba mar phal mo che phyag tu phul/ zhang blon chen po man chad so sor bya dga' stsal ba'i lan la/ nyi 'og gi mkhan po a tsārya dzi na mi tra sogs zhes gsungs pa ltar 'phags yul gyi paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra su rend+ra bo dhi/ shrī lend+ra bo dhi/ dā na shī la/bo dhi mi tra rnams dang / bod kyi mkhan po ratna rakṣi ta/ dharma tā shī la/ lo tsā ba dzñā na se na/ dza ya rakṣi ta/ mañdzu shrī warma rnams la/ rgyal pos bka' bsgyur te sngon yab mes kyi dus bod kyi skad la ma grags pa'i ming du btags pa'i khrod nas ming bcos su mi rung ba rnams kyang / bcos skad kyi ming gces so 'tshal gyis kyang bsnan te theg pa che chung gi gzhung las ji ltar 'byung ba dang /byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang yang bstun te 'jal dka' ba rnams tshig so sor 'phral nas gtan tshigs kyis bshad de gzhung du bris/ skad rkyang pa bshad mi 'tshal ba sgra ji bzhin du bsgyur bar rigs pa rnams kyang / sgra btsan par bgyis te ming btags / skad kha cig don bzhin du gdags par rigs pa rnams kyang /186—114

don btsan par bgyis te ming du btags nas/ lo paṇa rnams kyis rgyal blon gdan 'dzom pa la zhus te skad gsar bcad che 'bring chung gsum gyis gtan la legs par phab/ phan yul gyi smad ka ba na mo cher 'gyur bcos bgyis te 'bum dum pa bcu drug tu bzhengs/ snod sha lpags kyis bstums pas 'di la yang sha sgro can du grags/ bla 'gyur chen mo zer/ de skabs yum chen mo bzheng ba rgyal po ma gtogs 'bangs kyis mi nus pas khri lde gtsug gi bla 'bum skya bo / mjing yon gyi sbug 'bum/ gtsang ma'i bye 'bum/ ral pa can gyi drug 'bum / gnam lde lha'i zhal dmar can/ dar ma'i shog ser can te drug tsam las ma 'phel/ rjes su 'bangs kyis bzhengs pas 'bum tshar bcu dgu tsam byung / de nas mi ring bar du mtshams kyi lcang rdo rje tshul khrims kyis/ 'bum bcu dgu po thams cad la gtugs nas bzhengs pas shin tu dag pa zhig byung /de las mched pas 'bum tshar drug cu skor 'phel/ de'i rgyun las phyi dus yar klung jo bo chos rje pas bzhengs pa'i bla 'bum gyi bu phyi/ glegs bam dum bu bcu gnyis / bam po sum brgya dang gsum/ le'u don lnga/ sho lo ka 'bum tshig stong yod pa shin tu dag par grags shing / 'di dag pa'i tshul yang 'bum phal cher la ting 'dzin brgya dgu bcu/ rngog 'gyur la brgya nyer gcig /reg zig gnyis su mdor bstan la brgya dang nyi shu/ rgyas bshad du brgya dang bcu gcig las ma byung zer la/ dge bshes chen po sha ra bas khungs thub btsal bas chad pa na kha bskang ba'i tshe yang zla ba sgron ma dang / gdung ba med pa'i glog gi 'od gnyis kyi rgyas bshad ma rnyed/ 'dir grog gi shog ser can dang / lha lung dpal rdor gyi zhal gser can dang / lan pa'i zhal dmar can sogs la 186—115

gtugs te bsabs pas le'u drug par chos mchog gi dmigs rnam gyi skabs su chos thams cad skye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsnan na brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi/le'u brgyad pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdor bstan dang / dgu pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyas bshad gnyis shar brgya dang drug cu rtsa gsum re chad lhag med par yod cing /yang mi mnyam pa'i chos nyid rtag tu btang snyoms kyi rnam par dpyod pa ste/ zhes sogs su stong nyid bco brgyad dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi bar du dran nye nas smon med kyi bar chad pa dang / yang chos dbyings nas bsam mi khyab kyi bar mkhyen gsum dang theg gsum dang / 'phags bzhi la sbyor ba'i skabs su mig nas rga shi'i bar gyi 'grel shog bu gsum tsam chad pa sogs kyang gsos pas shin tu dag pa'o / /bcom ldan ral gri'i slob ma 'jam dgag pa shis rgya nag nas yo byad mang po rnyed pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bzheng ba'i cha rkyen du bskur nas 'bad rtsol chen po gnang ba la brten/ 'dul ba lung gi ma dpe mchims nam mkha' grags kyis bzhengs pa dang / mdo sde'i skor la 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i thugs dam lha mi'i rgyan mchog /'dar 'phyar pas bzhengs pa'i mdo mang gtsang chu mig ring mor bzhugs pa dang / gru spang rtsa'i thugs dam 'dzam gling rgyan/ zha lu gser khang du bzhugs pa'i mdo mang / mchims kyi thugs dam gser gzhungs ma/ phyug rgyal ma/ dgon gsar ma le tshan/ spun gsum gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i mdo mang sogs bsdus/ sher phyogs rgyud gsum dang bcas pa dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs mkhas pa mang po sgo bstun te/go rim 'khrul pa med par/ snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs par bcom 106—116

ldan rig pa'i ral gris dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad/ de las ma phyi bgyis te si tu thams cad mkhyen pa zhes grags pa/ tshal pa dge ba'i blo gros kyis tshal gung thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs shing / ma phyir med pa'i snon ma yang bsnan pas tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhes shin tu khungs btsun zhing grags che/bu ston rin po ches bka' 'gyur rab gnas su phebs/ si tu dang lhan cig par dpyad pa gsum gyi sgo nas zhus dag mdzad pas bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag gcig tu gyur/ dus phyis zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa dang rje ye bzang rtse pa sogs kyis slar yang zhus dag mdzad pas shin tu dag cing zla med pa lta bu yin gsung / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas chos 'byung gsung rab rin po che'i bang mdzod bka' 'gyur ro cog gi dkar chag dpyad pa gsum gyis rnam par dag par mdzad/ de dang mthun par rgyal rtser bdag po rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis/ bka' 'gyur rin po che rgyal rtse them spangs mar grags pa bzhengs zhes grags na'ang / bu ston chos 'byung dang sgrig rtsoms mi mthun pas rgyal rtse them spangs ma'i dkar chag mdzad pa po skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang phyug lo chen thugs rje dpal yin zhes mang du gzigs pa dag gsung /rgyal ba'i dbang po khams gsum zil gnon za hor bzhad pa rtsal gyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ji snyed cig bzheng ba gnang ba'i ma dpe yang / 'di nyid la mdzad cing —/ lhag par khungs thub tu bzhed/ dus phyis lha sras sprul pa'i zlos gar mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtshos pho brang chen po gru 'dzin du bzhugs pa'i rin chen sna lnga'i bka' 'gyur rin po che khyad du 'phags pa sogs/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bka' 'gyur rin po che ji snyed cig bskrun pa dang / mchog dman 186—117

par pa gzhan dag gis kyang / rang rang gi bsod nams kyi zhing du bka' 'gyur rin po che gsar du bzhengs pas stod smad bar gsum du khyab che zhing / lhag par gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal khab chen por/ tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang khrigs mthun pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che par du gsar bzhengs sogs chos sbyin rlabs po che'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa mang por 'phel te bzhugs so//gnyis pa gsung par rin po che srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta 'di nyid bskrun par mdzad pa'i byed po mi dbang chos rgyal chen po'i rtogs pa brjod pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa'i mdo las/ bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal 'di lta ste dper na zla ba yar gyi ngo'i dkyil 'khor nam phyed kyi dus na/ dzambu'i gling gi sems can thams cad kyis so so'i mdun na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dug par shes kyang / zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sems can de dag gis bdag ci'i phyir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du shes par 'gyur bar/ bdag sems can de dag gi mdun na 'dug par bya'o snyam du mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog mod kyi 'on kyang 'jam dpal/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni ma 'dres pa'i chos dang ldan pas lhun gyis grub cing rnam par mi rtog par de lta bu'i bya ba 'di 'byung ngo / /'jam dpal de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'khor dpag tu med/ grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med/ gzhal du med / tshad med/ brjod pa'i sgras brjod du med pa'i dbus na de dag thams cad kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs par mthong mod kyis/186—118

'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs par shes par 'gyur bar/ bdag sems can de dag gi mdun du 'dug par bya'o snyam du mi rtog /rnam par mi rtog ste/ 'on kyang sems can rnams kyis mthong ba de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa mdun na bzhugs so/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gser gyi kha dog tu mthong bas gdul bar bya ba yin na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang gser gyi kha dog du snang ngo / /de bzhin du bai ḍūrya dang / anda rnyil dang / spug dang / mu tig dmar po'i kha dog gis gdul bar bya ba yin na de dag gi kha dog tu bzhugs so/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten skyong ba dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang /dbang phyug dang / lha ma yin dang / mi dang / dud 'gro dang / dmyal ba dang gshin rje'i 'jig rten pas gdul bar bya ba yin na de dag gi gzugs su bzhugs nas chos ston no/ /zhes dang / dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa' sa bcu pa'i spyod pa'am rnam par 'phrul pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs drung du skad cig gis lus ston pa dang / mig yor lta bu'i lus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pa dang / skye ba'i gnas thams cad du ci rigs par byed par ston pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba shes pa la mkhas pa dang / bskal pa gcig tu bskal pa grangs med pa 'jug pa dang /bskal pa grangs med pa la bskal pa gcig 'jug pa dang / zhing thams cad du zhing gcig yang dag par 'du zhing 'jug pa dang zhing gcig la zhing thams cad ston pa shes pa dang / skra'i khyon gcig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsam gyis mi khyab 186—119

pa'i 'du shes su gyur pa 'jug pa shes pa dang / sems can gcig gi lus la sems can thams cad kyi lus yang dag par 'du zhing 'jug pa shes pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang /rang gi lus la sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa thams cad/ rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / rang gi lus lus thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / thabs thams cad la mkhas pa dang / rang gi lus kyi smon lam gyi sems can 'dzin pa'i spyod pa'i gnas rgyun ma chad pa kun tu ston pa dang / rtsa ba dang / dga' ba dang /longs spyod pa thams cad kun tu ston pa dang / 'jig rten gyi bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rjes su 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis mi gos pa dang / bskal pa grangs med pa snga dro gcig tu byin gyis brlabs shing chos 'chad pa dang / spyod lam thams cad lkugs pa dang / grum po dang / rna ba mi gsang ba dang / glen pa dang / 'on pa dang / long ba ston cing sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dang / che'i tshad bskal pa tshad med pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du byin gyis rlob pa dang / zhes dang / phal po che las/ ting 'dzin brgya dang sangs rgyas brgya rnams mthong byed cing / /zhing brgya bskyod cing rab tu snang byed kun tu 'gro/ /sems can brgya sbyong chos kyi sgo la 'god par byed / /bskal pa brgyar 'jug lus brgya rab tu ston par byed/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyang brgya yi grangs tshad rab tu ston/ /de yi gong na smon mchog stobs ldan tshad kyang med/ /ces pa dang / rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar tshangs pa tshangs pa yi / /gnas las 'pho ba med bzhin du/ /lha yi gnas ni thams cad du/ /snang ba 'bad med ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin thub pa chos sku las/ /bskyod pa 186—120

med par khams kun tu/ /skal ldan rnams la 'bad med par/ /sprul pa dag ni ston par mdzad/ /ji ltar tshangs rtag gzhal yas khang na mi g.yo 'dod khams bzhugs pa ste/ /lha rnams kyis mthong de mthong de yang yul la dga' ba spong byed ltar/ /de bzhin bde gshegs chos kyi sku las mi bskyod 'jig rten khams kun tu/ /skal ldan gyis mthong de mthong de yang rtag tu dri ma kun gsal byed / /sngon gyi rang nyid smon lam dang / /lha rnams kyis ni dge ba'i mthus/ /ji ltar tshangs pa 'bad med snang / /rang byung sprul sku de bzhin no/ /zhes rgyal ba rnams ni chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du/ gang na gdul bya'i yul las skal ba dang ldan zhing smon lam gyis 'brel ba'i phyogs der phrin las kyi bgrod pa ngang gis 'jug pa chos nyid de/ rgyud las/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu'i nyams kyis du ma'i snang ba ston/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro / /gcig gi rang bzhin las ma 'das pas nam mkha' las char gyi rgyun gcig phab pa bzang ngan la khyad par med kyang 'bab sa'i yul gyi snod bcud kyi bye brag de dang des mchog dman bar pa'i rnam pa can du 'char ba ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ ji ltar bsil dang zhim dang 'jam pa dang / /yang ba'i chu ni sprin de las 'thon pa/ /sa la ba tsha la sogs gnas 'brel bas/ /shin tu mang po'i ror ni 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad chu'i char/ /rab yangs brtse sprin snying po las 'thon pa/ /'gro ba'i rgyud kyi gnas kyi dbye ba las / /rnam pa mang po'i ro dang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la / nam mkhar zla ba gcig nyid shar ba chu snod dwangs snyigs kyi bye brag gis zla ba'i gzugs brnyan yang de snyed du 'char ba bzhin du/ gzugs sku gcig gis 186—121

nyer len bgyis pa las phan par snang ba'i sku dang / gnod par snang ba'i sku sogs dag pa dang ma dag pa'i rang bzhin ji snyed par 'char ba yin la/dper na brlan zhing gsher ba phor pa gang la lha mi yi dwags kyi mig shes tshad ma gsum gyis dus gcig tu bltas dus/ gzhi brlan cing gsher ba gcig pu des nyer len bgyis pas/ chu/ bdud rtsi/ rnag khrag phor pa re bston med du grub ste/ phan gnod byed pa bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa rgya mtsho yang de dang de lta bur 'char ba yin no/ /de ltar yang bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i dam bzhag gi skabs su/ 'di ni dam tshig bdud rtsi ste / /ma bsrungs sreg par byed pa'i dug /bsrungs na dngos grub myur ba ste/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /ces pa dang / 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu / /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster / /zhes gsungs pa ltar nges pa'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i snang ngor rgyal ba'i sras bo/ lus can kun gyi snang ngor mi dbang chos rgyal chen por shar ba bsod nams stobs rgyas 'di nyid/ rnam par ma brtags pa'i skye bo dang / skal ba dman pa dang / sngon nas las smon 'brel pa log par grub pa dag gi snang ngor ni 'gong po dang / dam sri dang bdud la sogs pa'i rnam par 'char zhing / de lta bu'i mdzad pa la brten te gnod pa'i rang bzhin du yang 'gyur ba rgyal ba'i chos nyid yin la/ don du snyigs ma lngas ches cher sbags shing / gdul bar dka' ba ma rungs pa'i skye bos phyogs thams cad khyab par gyur pa'i dus 'dir/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i tshul gyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i skyes bu chen po yin te/ mdo sde rgyan las/ byang 786—122

chub sems dpa' rtag tu ni/ khyim pa 'khor los bsgyur rnams su/ /gyur nas skye ba thams cad du/ /sems can rnams kyi don byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid 'phags chen dam pa yin par gang las shes zhe na/ 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i rnam par thar pa dag las kyang rtogs par nus te/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chur shes ltar/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyi/ /rigs ni tshad ma dag las shes / /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge ma zhes gzhon nu zhes/ /zhes sogs kyis kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa chen po lung bstan pa'i rjes der/ yi ge gzhal ga zhes nu zhes/ /yi ge pa zhes chos sems byed/ /yi ge a ming bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed / /blo ldan yon tan kun gyis bskur/ /dang po yi ge la zhes bstan/ /zhes pas gsal por bstan te/ yi ge ga zhes gzhon nu zhes 'byung ba ni/'di nyid gzhon nu'i dus kyi mtshan zur la mgon po zhes pa mchis pas yi ge'i ngo bo ga dang / dus gzhon nu'i dus su mtshan der 'byung ba'i don yin la/ yi ge pa zhes chos sems byed/ ces pa ni bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi mtshan zur bsod nams kyi skad dod purgya'i ming yig dang po pa yig bstan nas chos sems byed ces pa ni/ rgyal po bka' thang las/ bka' khrims thang khrims sngar bas bzang bar bskyangs: chos skyong rgyal po'i rnam thar rtags bzung nas:gsang sngags 'bras bu'i chos rnams nyams su blangs: spyi bor slob dpon rang lus yi dam lha: ngag tu gsang sngags rdo rje'i bzlas pa mdzad: ces gsungs pa ltar/ khrims gnyis kyi bya ba drang por srong zhing ya rabs chos rgyal chen po'i 186—123

rnam thar las nam yang mi 'da' ba dang / de yang klu sgrub kyis/ mi yi chos lugs legs spyad na/ /lha yul bgrod par thag mi ring / /lha dang mi yi them skas la/ /'dzeg na thar pa gam na 'dug /ces mi chos kyi mdzad bzang thar pa'i 'bab stegs su gsungs shing / rje sa paṇa gyis/ legs bshad rin po che'i gter las/ 'jig rten bya ba legs shes pa/ /de yi dam pa'i chos lugs 'grub/ /des na chos lugs spyod pa de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / rnam pa thams cad du rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po che las mi 'da' ba dang / nang don nyams bzhes kyi rim bzhin 'chad par 'gyur ba dag gis/ chos rgyal rig pa 'dzin pa chen po'i khyad par du byas te 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i don dang / yi ge a ming bdag nyid che zhes pa ni/ sprul gzhi'i cha nas bstan srung kun gyi dbang po yam shud dmar po'i sgyu 'phrul dang / ngo bo'i cha nas dbus na dbu ru dang g.yo ru/ gtsang na g.yas ru dang ru lag ste/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi'am g.yas g.yon sprul gung gi ru bzhis bsdus pa'i rgyal khab sa skya yig tshang las/ stod kyi mnga' ris skor gsum dang / /lho sde gzhung pa la sogs pa/ /khri stong gseb tu mi the ba'i/ /bod 'brog gang yod zung bzhag nas/ /dbus gtsang khri skor so so yi/ /dud grangs brtsi ba 'di ltar ro/ /la stod lho pa'i dud kyi grangs/ /stong dang dgu brgya dgu bcu yin/ /la stod byang pa nyis stong dang / /nyis brgya lnga bcu tham par rtsis/ /chu mig khri skor hor dud grangs/ /sum stong nyag gsum yod par byed / /zha lu khri skor sum stong dang / /brgyad brgya dgu bcu rtsa gnyis yod/ /byang 'brog khri skor rting la byung / /yar 'brog khri skor khyad chos la/ /leb ni 186—124

bcu drug zer ba de/ /hor dud phyed dang brgyad brgya bo/ /dbus phyogs tsam du dbyer lugs ni/ /'bri gung bod 'brog gnyis po la/ /sum stong drug brgya sum cu yod/ /tshal pa sum stong bdun brgya yin/ /phag mo gru pa nyis stong dang ske/ /bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa brgyad do/ /g.ya' bzang ba la sum stong dbang / /rgya ma pa dang byang yul pa/ /lnga stong dgu brgya phyed phyed yin/ /stag lung pa la lnga brgya dang / /de rting lha 'brug la sogs pa'i/ /kha thor stong dang bzhi brgya yod / /ces pa ltar gtsang khri drug /dbus khri drug /hor dud khri gcig ste khri bskor bcu gsum gyi bod yul le lag dang bcas pa dbang mdzad pa'i mi'i bdag po chen por gyur pa dang / mtshan gyi cha nas mi'i dbang po zhes lha mi kun gyis mgrin gcig tu gleng bas na/ dbang po'i skad dod ind+ra zhes pa'i tshig zur gyis a yig gsal por bstan/ ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed/ ces pa ni/ rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa thams cad kyi brjod bya lam gyi snying por gyur pa ni/skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa yin la/ de lta bu'i man ngag gi gnad thams cad shing rta chen po gnyis las brgyud de 'ongs pa'i gdams pa zab mo lta rgyud dang / rgya chen spyod rgyud zung du 'jug pa'i bstan pa rin po che rgyal ba'i gsung rab kun gyi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa dag dang / rgyud dang grub chen gyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa legs par bkral te/ nyams su bstar ba'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs gdan sa las ming gras te dge lugs sam/ zhwa'i khyad par las btags te zhwa ser gyi bstan pa zhes phyogs lhung gi bsam pas ris su phye lta/ khol bu nyi tshe ba'i bstan par phud cing / bzung ba ma gtogs nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa kun gyi spyi nor 186—125

du gyur pa 'di nyid yin pas de gtso bor bzung ste/ de 'dzin gyi skyes bu dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa bkur sti/ zhabs tog /mnga' gsol/ gzengs bstod / nyams pa tshar gcod/ blo gsal rjes 'dzin/ bstan pa'i srog mthud sogs thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum la brtson pa dang / skye dgu thams cad kyi bde skyid dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i bstan pa 'di la rag lus shing de'i rgyu mtshan/ dga' ldan pho brang gi mtshan jus khyab gdal du ma brgyugs kyi bar la/ sde rigs 'dzin pa'i skye bo thams cad 'khrug cing brtsod pas dus 'da' ba la/ sngar ratna'i spyi lung du bshad pa bzhin kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po'i thugs rjes/ dga' ldan pa'i mtshan jus dar ba nas bzung rgan mo gser khur gyi lam du gyur pas/ dbus gtsang rnams bde zhing / gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i chen po hor gyi rgyal khams 'dzin pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po stobs 'byor gyis mtho ba rnams kyang / bstan pa rin ngo/ che 'di nyid la mchog tu mos pas de'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i bde skyid kyi srog gcig tu gyur pa mngon sum gyi rigs pas grub la/ de'i phyir chos srid zung 'jug gi bstan pa 'di nyid 'dzin pa'i phyir du rgyal khab chen po'i zhi drag gi bya ba rlabs po che thams cad la nyin mtshan khor yug tu/ ngal ba med pa'i sgo nas thugs brtson zhing sngon dus btsad po du ma lhan cig par 'dzom nas/ brtsam dgos pa'i bya ba las kyi 'khor lo thams cad deng dus mi'i dbang po kho na'i mdzad pa nyag gcig la brten nas 'jug ldog gi bgyi bar bkri ba'i 'phrul dang / 'di snang phun tshogs kyi dngos po yod do cog thams cad bde thabs kyi rim gro sogs kyis mtshon te don ldan gyi bgyi ba 'ba' 706—126

zhig tu 'gyur ba mdzad pa dang / skye bo ma rungs pa'i byed pa la brten nas mtha' dbus 'khrug cing / rtsod pa la sogs pa byung na 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog pas de sel dgos la/ 'thab rtsod kyi rigs gang gis bzlog pa la drag po g.yul gyi las shin tu gces shing / de'i phyir g.yul gyi 'khrul 'khor la brten nas ma rungs pa tshar gcod cing / chab 'bangs rnams bde skyid kyi dpal la 'god pa sngon gyi dus kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs te chos rgyal chen po rnams dang / da ltar gyi dus kyi gnam ka ba med pa'i mthongs nas dbang bskur ba'i stobs kyi rgyal po chen po 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos gong ma bdag po rim par byon pa rnams dang / ma 'ongs shambha la'i rigs ldan chen po drag po 'khor lo can la sogs pa'i brtul zhugs sam rnam par thar pa yin pas na/ de dag la rjes su zhugs te 'gro kun rnams bde skyid la 'god pa'i g.yul gyi las la 'bangs rnams spro bar 'gyur ba dang / dzambu'i gling pa bde srid kyi rtsa ba gong ma bdag po chen po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa bskang ba sogs kyi ched du sngar gong mas legs skyes su stsal ba'i dngul srang khri phrag tu longs pa sogs zang zing gi dngos po rgya cher stsal ba rnams kyang / dbus gtsang mnga' ris kyi dmag mi rnams la phangs pa med par stsal te tshim par mdzad nas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel ba'i ched du lus srog la phangs pa med par gyis shig ces bskul ba'i thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che gzhan gyis 'gran mi bzod pa dag mdzad/ sngon dus kyi chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa'/ mes dbon rnam gsum la sogs pa 'ga' tsam ma gtogs pa dus phyis srid skyong gi rgyal po thams cad bstan pa ris med la gus pa mi lhod pas/ phyogs med du 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa cher ma byung 106—127

mod / bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni snga dus rgyal ba lnga pa chen po'i sku thog kurma pa yab sras phyogs gtogs dang bcas par/ bkur sti zhabs tog gshegs bzhud gang gi gnas skabs su yang yangs po mi spyod pa'i bka' khrims kyis lci shing dog pas thugs byung zhing sku ngal bar mchis pa la/ gang gis srid skyong mdzad nas bzung ste gus 'dud mtshungs pa med pa'i sgo nas dgyes dgur spyod pa'i sri zhu bla na med pa bstabs/ mdor na sa rnying kur 'brug sogs grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa thams cad rang rang gi chos lugs la bde bar spyod cing / de dag gi 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bskul ma tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi sgo nas zhabs tog bsgrubs pa sogs/ mdor na bstan pa rin po che 'khrul pa med pa thams cad la bsti stang du bgyis te/ bkur ba'i rma med pa'i mdzad pa 'di lta bu bstan pa'i gces spras sam zhabs tog tu ma song na/ su zhig gis bstan pa'i zhabs tog 'grub snyam du sems pas/ de bas na rgyud nas ji ltar gsungs pa dang /mi'i dbang po'i mdzad pa ni legs par 'byong ba yin pas gzu bor gnas pa'i dpyod ldan kun gyis soms shig /blo ldan yon tan kun gyis bkur/ /zhes pas / nges pa'i don du mkhyen brtse'i cha shas thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas go 'phang mthon por gshegs pa'i don dang / thun mong dag pa'i snang ngor rgyal sras sa bcu'i dbang phyug gi ngo bor grub pa dang / ma dag pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi snang ngor yang dpa' la sran tshugs pa/ mdzangs la blo 'gyur/ kha gsal zhing gting mi rtogs pa ste/ yid kyi rtsal gsum zhes grags pa thams cad ma tshang ba med par mi'i dbang po 'di la tshang ba yin te/ lha mi'i chos lugs kyi gnad thams cad rig cing gzhan gyis 'gran par mi bzod pa'i blo gros kyi thul che bas 186—128

mdzangs pa dang / gzhan gyis dran pa'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i blang dor gyi gnad 'gag thams cad myur bar rig pa'i blo 'gyu ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba gang la yang nyam nga ba med pa'i dpa' ba dang / las su bya ba gang la 'jug kyang khur du bzod pa'i snying stobs chen por gyur pas sran tshugs pa dang /'jig rten ltar snang du thugs chung zhing yon gsang ba'i kha gsal ba dang /zhib tu brtags na lo zlar sbrel te zham ring du bcar ba rnams kyis kyang dgongs pa rtsa ba nas mi rtogs pa'i gting mi rtogs pa ste/ sngar sku na phra mo'i dus nyid nas da lta'i bar du/ mchog dman bar pa thams cad mgrin gcig tu gleng zhing spyod yul du gyur pa yin/ yon tan zhes pas gong du blo dang ldan par gsungs pa'i de ma thag tu lus ngag gi yon tan khyad par can dang ldan par bstan pa/nges don gyi bshad pa ni 'phags chen dam pa'i bsgrubs pa'i shugs kyis shes la/thun mong ltar snang du'ang mtheb kyis sha non pa/ rkyal gyis chu chen chod pa/yang rtsal bya lta bu ste lus rtsal gsum/ lo rgyus kyis dge thon pa/ gtam gyis bzhad gad thon pa/ gshags kyis pha rol gnon pa ste ngag rtsal gsum yongs su rdzogs pa yin no/ /de la dang po ni/ mi dbang 'di nyid sku na phra mo'i dus nas bzung ste/ sku shed che zhing gzhan gyi bsdo bar mi phod pas chung dus kyi byis pa'i zham ring pa nas bzung ste da lta'i bar gyi sku la bcar ba kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ chu'i rtsal rim ni mtshon byed ste smin grol gling du yi ge'i rig byed mtha' yas pa gsan te lugs brgya'i mdun sa dga' ldan pho brang gi rgyal khab chen po'i yi ge pa kun gyi khrod nas dag mgyogs legs gsum gyi sgo nas phul du byung ba dang / rtsis khang gi rig byed smra ba kun gyi khrod du rtsis rig 106—129

gi gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad do/ /rgyal khab chen po'i bya ba gzhis gnyer pa kur rgya yongs sdud/ rdzong dpon/ drung yig /rtsis dpon/gnyer tshad pa/ 'phrul blon sogs skas kyi gdang bu rim 'dzeg lta bu'i zhi drag gi bya ba thams cad la goms pa mthar phyin pa dang / lha bzang khang gi dus nas bzung ste da lta'i bar gyi bod pa/ rgya hor gyi skye bo sogs gang gis kyang 'gran par mi bzod pa'i nyag phran gyi rtsal ya med du gyur pa ni da lta po ta la'i rdzong rgyab kyi sngar mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rang zhabs kyi mda' bzang pa yod do cog bsdus te/ ya med kyi tshad du mdzad pa'i 'ben tshad las kyang rgyang tshad du brgal ba'i phyogs 'dus kyi skye bo ji tsam 'tshogs kyang / 'gran zla med pa kun gyi mthun grub dang / gsum pa yang rtsal ni chibs kyi rtsal sna thams cad la lhag par byang bas / sngar lha bzang khang gi dus chibs thogs nas ri bong 'dzin pa sogs kyi sgyu rtsal zla med kyi mchog tu gyur pa dang / bzhi pa lo rgyus kyis dge thon pa ni/dbus gtsang nang 'khrug gi dus su mi dbang rang nyid kyi thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul las drang po'i lo rgyus gsungs pa'i byed pas gnam bskos gong ma bdag po chen po dpon blon thams cad thugs yid lhag par ches pa dang / mnga' ris hor sog gi skye dgu rnams kyang rang shugs kyis 'dus pa dang / khal kha'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i mong gol gyi skye bo rnams kyang thog mtha' gsum gyi lo rgyus gsungs pa tsam gyis mgu zhing rang ba'i yid ches kyi nges pa brtan po thob pa dang / mdor na gzu bor mi gnas shing lhag par blun pa'i skye bo dag la ci cha/ gzhan du mi'i dbang pos lo rgyus gang gsungs pa thams cad kun gyi yid du 'bab cing / rgyud 'khul ba zhig nges par 'byung ba mthong bas shes pa nyid do/ /lnga pa gtam gyis 186—130

bzhad thon pa ni/ thugs nang gshin pa'i skye bo phal mo cher sku rtsed la mnyes shing / gsung 'phros rnams 'dra chags la dgod bro ba zhig shugs kyang grub pa nyid do/ drug pa gshags kyis pha rol gnon pa ni/ sku rtsed dang don dam gang yang rung ste/ pha rol pa'i skye bo gzi byin ji tsam che yang mi dbang 'di nyid kyis ji ltar gsungs pa las 'da' bar mi nus shing / lan ldon pa'i spobs pa dang bral ba zhig mchis pas so/ /de bas na gtam yig rtsis gsum/ mda' rdo mchong gsum/ bang rkyal sbe gsum zhes po'i rtsal sna dgur grags pa'i sgyu rtsal thams cad la byang chub pa dang / lhag par du yang drag po g.yul gyi las la dbang bsgyur ba'i rgyal thabs la/ sa skyong 'di nyid las mkhas pa gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir sngon chad ma byung ba lta bu'o/ /der ma zad kun gyi mthun snang du grub par dkon mchog la thugs dad brtan pa/ las 'bras la lhag par yid ches pa/ dman pa rnams la lhag par byams pa/ 'dris par gzhung bzang ba/'gyur ldog dang ltems kyang chung ba/ 'di snang gi phun tshogs la zhen chags med pa / drang zhing srong la brtul zhugs che ba sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa yin no/ /kun gyis bkur/ dang po yi ge la zhes bstan zhes pas ni/ mi dbang 'di nyid la bsngags shing bskur bar byed pa'i spyi dang bye brag gnyis bstan pa yin te/ kun zhes pas gangs ri'i ljongs 'di rgyal ba yab sras la sogs pa'i tshad mar gyur pa'i dam pa/ grub thob/ dge bshes/ rdo rje'i chos srung sogs phal mo ches bkur 'os kyi gnas su 'dzin pa yin la/ rgyang nas mthong na ca co 'byin/ /'thab sar phrad na thal mo sbyor/ /rang khyim sleb na nga rgyal smra/ /zhes pa lta bu'i skye bo rnams kyang / deng sang ni gus pa dang /186—131

'jigs pa dang / yi rang ba sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas thams cad kyang bkur ba po nyag gcig tu gyur pa'o/ /bod tsam du ma zad shar phyogs gnam bskos gong ma bdag po chen po dpon blon 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchog tu bsngags shing gzengs bstod/ lho phyogs kla klo'i grong khyer dang nags rong gi brag la sogs pa'i sa'i bar btsan po bdag gir bgyis te/ sngon chad stobs 'byor gyi dpung gis mtho ba'i sa skya pa gong ma/ sde srid phag mo grub pa/ kur srid/dga' ldan pho brang pa stobs 'byor mnga' thang gra rgyas pa'i mthar thug pa gong ma lnga pa'i skabs su'ang rang zhabs su ma 'dus pa'i 'brug bla dpon 'bangs sder gtogs dang bcas pas mgo btags/ phyag phul/ skyabs su bzung ste rang zhabs su chud/ nub phyogs mnga' ris la thags kyi rgyal po sogs kyis mtshon te mnga' ris pa rnams dang / ne pa la'i skye bo la sogs pa kun gyis btud cing bkur ba dang / byang phyogs mong gol gyi rgyal po rgyal phran sde la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang legs par bkur bar bstan cing / dang po yi ge la yis bstan/ces pa ni/ bye brag mi dbang 'di nyid la dang por mnga' gsol gzengs bstod kyi sgo nas dbugs dbyung bla na med par mdzad pa po ni/ rigs gsum mtshan ma'i rgya can las/ /gnam the'i cho 'phrul ma nges cir yang g.yo/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i gnam the dkar po'i sprul pa bod sbyongs spyod lha bzang khang zhes pa de yang / dri med lhun po'i gter lung du/ badzra pā ṇi'i sprul pa'i rgyal po zhig: bod khams dar cig bde la sbyor ba 'byung : theg pa'i rtsal gyis pha bong nam mkhar theg: byang thang yangs par 'brong chen dbang gis zin: mi gzhon gsum gyi dpa' rtsal de la yod: ces gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo 106—132

rje'i sprul par lung gis zin pa'i bstan 'dzin gu shrī khang gi gdung las son cing /mnga' ris gter ston zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi gter lung las/ de tshe chos rgyal sprul pa mchog: lha mi'i mchod sdong rgya mcho re mtshan: zhes kun mkhyen lnga pa lung bstan pa'i rjes su/ dbung gtsang gdong rgyan bstan 'dzin sogs: chos kyi chab srid skyong ba'i tshe: zhes lung bstan pa'i gdong rgyan ni gdong dmar gyi don te/ mi dbang 'di nyid kyang bstan mod/ phal cher lha bzang khang de nyid la ngos 'dzin mdzad pas/ (ma phyi mi gsal )btsad po mtshan zur gyi la'i mgo can lha bzang gis mchog tu bkur bar bstan pas na/ sgo thams cad nas bston du med cing rigs pas 'grub pa yin no/ /de yang kun mkhyen lnga pa chen pos/thang yig las gsungs pa'i gter ston gyi nang nas/ chos rje gling pa dang chos rje gling pa slad kyis 'byon par gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyal sras lha rje mchog grub rgyal po'i rnam sprul rig 'dzin chos rje gling pa'i gter byon gyi a tsarya (ma phyi mi gsal )las/stobs ldan glo bur gdong me can: sngags kyi spyod pas rgya bod hor gsum 'dul: shar phyogs rgya nag rgyal po shun rtse zhes: sman tse'i ri bor dbang ba'i stobs ldan pa: las dbang mthu che 'dzam gling sum gnyis sdud: btsun mo dam pa tsunda'i sprul pa gnyis: de yis rkyen byas skyes mchog zung gnyis dang: rnam dkar 'brel na rgya bod hor gsum bde: zhes gsungs pa yang mi dbang 'di nyid yin te/ stobs ldan zhes pa ni bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi mtshan zur dang / gong du bshad pa'i phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po thams cad kyis bkur ba'i sgo nas / dpal 'byor gyis mngon par mtho ba'i stobs dang ldan pa dang / sngon dus lan cig tsam ma yin par 'gro ba'i don mdzad par thugs 186—133

bskyed / khyad par (ma phyi mi gsal )sil bur gyur pa'i dus tshod sum cu kha ral la nyi shur nye ba'i skabs kyi 'gro ba rnams/ dar cig bde la 'god pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam gyi dpung btsan po dang ldan pa'i don yin la/ glo bur rgyal po zhes pa ni/ (ma phyi mi gsal ) gong du bshad pa ltar gzhung las kyi bya ba phra mo tsam yang thugs su chud par mdzad de mas 'dzeg gi sgo nas 'phrin las bdo ba yin na'ang 'di nyid bod skyong rgyal por gshegs pa ni glo bur ba yin te/ me lug lor dga' ldan pho brang gi blon po mdzad bzhin pa'i thog /ha cang shes rab che grags pa'i/ /bya ba mang na rang nyid brlag /rgyal po dran rgya ches pa yis/ /rgyal srid nyams pa shin tu mang / /zhes pa dang / 'byor dang shes rab stobs la sogs/ /bsod nams ldan na grogs su 'gyur/ /bsod nams med na de dag kun/ /bdag nyid brlag pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/pas se/ gung la sogs pa'i nang blon rnams tshogs/ btsad po rda'i ching pā thur gyi ru bkums/ mi dbang 'di nyid nyang stod kyi pho lhar bzhugs thog gsang dmag drangs pas rkyen byas dbus gtsang 'khrugs na'ang / khong mdzangs bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ /gcig pu yin kyang kun las rgyal/ /ri dwags rgyal po seng ge dang / /'khor los bsgyur la grogs mi dgos/ /zhes pa ltar/ mi dbang 'di nyid la ltos bcas kyi dpung tshogs nyung shas tsam las med kyang /mkha' lding mthu rtsal chen yang / /gos ser can gyi bzhon par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol gyi/ /bde ba bsgrub pa shes rab yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyi zla sgra gcan las grol ba bzhin du/ gtsang / mnga' ris / hor sog /thams cad shugs kyis 'dum te dpung chen por gyur pas 186—134

thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul la brten nas phyogs mtshams kyi dbus pa'i dpung thams cad gtor/ sa pho spre'u'i lo dga' mo 'phrang brgyud lha sar phyag phebs/ shes rab med pa'i blun po rnams/ /mang yang dgra yi dbang du 'gro/ /glang chen stobs ldan khyur longs pa/ /ri bong blo ldan gcig gis btul/ /zhes pa dang /'phrogs na dgra bas gnyen phyogs 'jigs/ /mtshon cha dgra yis lag char 'phen / /dpung tshogs 'gro na mjug sdud la/ /ldog na de yi sna 'dren byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ nang blon pas se la sogs pa gru 'dzin gyi pho brang du bros te sgo dam por bcad nas 'dug go/ /mi ring bar de thams cad phyag tu son gong ma'i bka' ma phebs par srog gi 'jigs pa las bskyabs/ bod thams cad la dbang bsgyur/ de ma thag skye bo thams cad kyi dril ma bsgrags par mgrin gcig tu mi'i dbang po tha'i ji zhes sgrog cing shin tu gus par byed do/ /chos rgyal 'di ma gtogs pa bod kyi btsad po thams cad la mi dbang zhes shugs 'byung du mtshan gsol ba ci yang med do/ /'di ni nges par phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis dgongs pa gtad cing dbang bsgyur/ de'i mthu las bka' srungs dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / 'jig rten skyong ba'i dregs pa mthu bo che rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bgros te/ gzugs can rnams kyi rgyud bskul ba zhig tu nges par sems te/ mi dbang 'di nyid kyi dpung dbus su phyogs par brtsom pa'i tshe dbus su 'khod pa'i skye bo rnams la 'jigs zil shin tu che zhing la la dag kong po dang / tsa ri dang nyang po la sogs pa'i sar sgong te slad nas dmag 'du'o zer/ la la ni mig 'khrul bas dmag med kyang yod pa lta bur mthong ste 'jigs nas/ da lta rang der 'dug zer ba sogs phyogs bzhi 111—135

mtshams brgyad nas dmag dpung g.yos pa lta bu'i rngam brjid che/ mi dbang 'di nyid kyi sku 'phreng sngon ma mong gol gyi rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang zhes pa de nyid dam can chos rgyal la srung ma'i gtso bor mdzad cing de'i dus kyi kun mkhyen lnga pa chen pos/ (ma phyi mi gsal )'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang mi gnyis pa'i rten thug khyad par can de gsum gyi sna 'dren du gnang bar dpung tshogs thams cad kyis mthong bar rten thug nas me dpung chen po chad de gzhan sde'i phyogs su 'gro ba dang / rgyal rtse sogs su dbus gtsang gi dpung phan tshun du tshogs pa'i tshe gtsang dpung gi phyogs nas 'thon pa'i rlung dmar drag pos dbus dpung gi skor thams cad g.yeng zhing 'tshub pa dang / kha ro la/ dga' mo 'phrang la sogs pa'i dgos gal che ba rnams su/ na bun glo bur du 'khrigs nas dbus dpung gi mel tshe ba dang dpung tshogs rnams kyis mi mthong bar bgyis te drung du slebs pa na/ na bun dengs pa'i gzhan sde bcom par sla ba sogs rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyal por gshegs pas na/ thol byung ngam glo bur du kun gyi rje bor gyur pas glo bur rgyal po zhes bsngags 'os su gyur pa'i don no/ /gdong rme can zhes pa ni btsad po 'di'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor byu ru'i mdog ltar dmar ba'i g.yon phyogs kyi ngogs la me ba chen po gnag cing 'tsher ba ring pos mtshan pa 'phel 'grib kyi cha las legs nyes kyi rtags gsal por ston pa/ drag por khros pa'i tshe me stag phrom phrom du 'phro ba yod pas de'i don yin zhing / sngar drangs pa'i/ dbung dmar gdong rgyan bstan 'dzin sogs: zhes gsungs pa'i dbung dmar gdong rgyan zhes pa 'di nyid la yang 'jug ste/ zhal skyin gyi rme ba de lta bu yod pa dang / lhag par mnyes pa dang / dpa' ba dang / khros 106—136

pa sogs thams cad rgal bas sku lus kyi cha shas thams cad byu ru'i mdog lta bur 'gyur ba dang / lhag par zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ni dmar 'od shin tu 'tsher zhing / zhal rgyan thams cad gyen du gzings pas 'bar zhing 'khrug pa dang thabs kyi spyod pas zhes pa ni/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gang la gang 'tshams pa'i mdzad pa'i don dang / rgya bod hor gsum 'dul zhes pa ni/ dbus gtsang sde gzar byung ba nas bzung gong ma bdag po chen por zhu yig dang mi sna gnang tshad dgongs par mi 'bab pa gcig kyang med pa dang / 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i dpung gi kha lo ba chen po a li khan e pa zhes pa zhib cing phra ba'i rnam dpyod can de nyid dpung chen gyi gdong du bod du byon dus mi dbang 'di nyid kyi mdzad pas yid lhag par 'phrogs te mgu zhing rangs par gyur pa dang / btsad po sngon ma rnams kyi dus su gong ma'i hwa shang sogs yul gnyan pa rnams dang / dam pa khros kyang btud na zhi/ /dman la btud na lhag par rengs/ /gser dngul sra yang bzhu nus kyi/ /khyi lud bzhu na dri ngan 'byung / /zhes pa ltar skye bo ma rungs pa rnams la so so'i babs dang bstun pa'i mthun 'jug gi bgyi ba mi shes pas rje 'bangs tshang ma 'khos su mi phebs la mi rje 'di nyid kyis dbang bsgyur ba nas bzung thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pa gang la gang 'tshams pas 'dul bar mdzad de / phyis kyi hwa shang thams cad ji skad gsung ba'i bka' las mi 'da' ba'i dul ba'i ngang tshul can du gyur pa sogs rgya dang / sngar bod 'dir dge sbyong gi sha tshugs can gyi bla mar khas 'che ba kun tu rgyu mang pos/ mtha' dbus rnams dkrugs / yon mchod rnams kyang sel can du bgyis te/ ngan pa phal cher rang gi skyon/ /gang yin gzhan la 'go bar byed/ /khu tas mi gtsang zos pa'i 186—137

mchu / /sa gtsang gzhan la 'bad nas 'phyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ma rungs pa'i rnam thar la gzhan dag kyang 'god pa lhur len pa'i rigs can shin tu mang ba la de dag thams cad kyang gnod pa med pa'i sgo nas tshar bcad/ lha ldan gyi mnyan yod mchod pa'i dus ston smon lam chen mor grags par/ dge 'dun khri khrag mang po 'du ba dang / tshogs mchod chen mo rgyal dbyar chos chen mo la sogs pa rnams kyi dus su/ gting nas nyes pa'i khrel 'das rnams/ /rang gi gtam ngan ngo sor khyer/ /kun tsi'i yul gyi rgyal rigs 'gas/ /pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga brdungs/ /zhes pa ltar bstan bshig gi sna 'dren bgyis par rang rang gi grwa pa'i zhabs tog bsgrub par rlom pa dang / blo chung rnams kyis phan btags pa/ /'ga' zhig gnod pa chen por 'gyur/ /skya ga'i phrug gus ma yi spu / /'thog pa drin lan yin par bsgom/ /zhes pa ltar 'dus sder drin lan log 'jal gyi zhabs 'dren 'khrug rtsod kyi rigs shin tu mang mod/ phyis de dag thams cad rgyun chad de 'jam por gyur pa dang / bstan srol 'dzin pa'i slob dpon gzhung bskos kyi rigs rnams kyang snga thog lkog brngan dang / ngo brgyud kyi 'phrul la brten nas mi 'os pa mang po mthon po'i go sar 'dzegs te 'gro ba la/de dag kyang deng sang legs par brtags shing dpyad nas 'os pa dang / mi 'os pa'i dbye ba legs par 'byed pa'i srol bzang po btod/ sngon gyi srol bzang po rnams nub ste rgyal khab chen po'i las byed du mngags pa'i skye bo phal mo che ma byin par len pa la ngang gis 'jug pa'i rnam thar la gzhol bar byed kyang mi'i bdag pos bkas bcad de/ de las ldog cing ma rungs pa rnams chad pas bcad pas btul/ chom rkun la sogs pa'i bya bar zhugs pa byung na mig ltos 711—138

la phan pa'i bka' chad phab pas skrag ste rgyun chad/ stobs kyis dregs pa thams cad lam thog tu 'gro ba na/ sa rims dang rta 'ul zhes pa'i 'phrul la brten te/gya ma tshoms su rgyu zhing lam thog gi skye bo thams cad nyam thag par byed pa la/mi'i dbang po nyid kyi bkas rnam par phye ba'i gser yig dang tham ka byung na ma gtogs bya mi rung ba'i bkas bcad/ dgos nges pa'i gtam dang yi ge phan tshun du bskyel ba la zla grangs mang por 'gor ba zhag nyung shas la skyel du bzod pa'i rta zam btsugs pa sogs mdor na rgyal khrims dang chos khrims gnyis ma'i sgo nas/ bya ba ma yin pa thams cad rgyun bcad legs pa'i lam la dkri ba'i sgo nas bod 'bangs rnams 'dul bar mdzad pa 'di dang / hor sog gi skye bo mang po brlang por spyod pa rnams kyang bzang po la bya dga' dang ngan par spyod pa la tshar bcod kyi sgo nas 'dul bar mdzad pas/ thams cad kyang rang rang gi longs spyod kyis mchog shes par spyod cing 'dug la gnod pa med par rgyu ba 'di ste / ma brtags pa'i bab col can rnams ni rgyal po 'di g.yo sgyu can no zhes gleng mod/ rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub na/ /'jam rtsub ji ltar byas kyang rung / /thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa la/ /g.yo sgyur thub pas ma gsungs so//zhes gsungs pas khro bo can ni de skad du smra'o/ /shar phyogs rgya nag rgyal po shun tse zhes: zhes sogs rkang pa gsum gyis bstan pa ltar/ mi'i dbang po'i rje bo mdzad pa'i dus dang phyogs mtshungs par/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma rgyal po da lta khrims gnyis kyi kha lo bsgyur te 'tsho zhing gzhes pa 'di'i gser zhal mngon par mtho ba'i gzi byin gyis/ sngar chab 'og tu ma 'dus pa'i mtsho khri shog rgyal mo'i 'gram gyi mong gol gyi rgyal po rnams dang / mnga' ris nas bzung ste shar 186—139

phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i 'gram la thug pa'i skye dgu thams cad dbang du bsdus nas/dpal 'byor gyi dge mtshan mngon par 'bar bas/ gong ma 'di'i mnga' zhabs su 'dus pa tsam sngon dus kyi ma hā tsi na'i rgyal po ce'u/ tsi na de hwang /han / ang mam/ tsha bo tsha/ 'um/ te'u ching / ching sang / su'i g.yang de yi thang hang ba'o/ phye/ mi nyag /hor/ rta ming / mdzi sogs gang gi dus su yang ma byung bas de'i phyir na lung don thog tu bab cing / des na dus rtags rnam thar sogs gang gi sgo nas kyang gong du bshad pa'i rgyal po gdong rme can ni da lta'i mi dbang 'di nyid la 'phyugs pa med do/ /kun mkhyen lnga pa'i gzigs snang rgya can du/ lcags phyi lo hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin chos rgyal dbang po'i sde dang mjal/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mod la dgongs par shar ba'i spyi lung gsal ba gnad kyi yang tig tu/ yab sher nag po yam shud sprul pa'i mi/ /mdog nag bzhin mi sdug pa dpa' tshul can/ /gdong dmar khro gtum zil ldan rnam gnyis kyis/ /bde sdug dbyar gyi nyi ma lta bur ston/ /zhes lung bstan pa'i yab sher nag po'i rnam 'phrul ni khang chen nas rda'i ching spa thur de yin la/ yam shud dmar po'i sprul pa ni mi dbang 'di nyid yin te/zhal mdangs dmar ba dang / log 'dren rnams kyi khrod du khro zhing gtum pa dang / gzi brjid kyi zil dang ldan zhing / rda'i ching bod kyi btsad por gyur/de nang blon gzhan rnams kyis bkums/ de nas mi dbang 'di nyid la thugs te de'i byed pas/ me lug nas sa spre'i bar du dbus gtsang nang 'khrug gi 'gro ba rnams sdug bsngal bar gyur pa dang / mi ring ba nyid du de dag las grol te bde zhing skyid par gyur pas dbyar dus su sprin dang na bun myur bar 'khrigs kyang /186 —140

de ma thag dengs te nyi ma ston pa'i 'gyur ldog byed pa lta bu'i cho 'phrul ston pa'i don yin no/ /de la yam shud dmar po ni/ ma dag pa'i snang ngor ltogs 'gong yam shud dmar po zhes pa 'gong po'i tshul bzung nas/ 'gong po spun dgu'i khrod du bzhugs te 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ dag pa'i snang ngor gnod sbyin chen po yam shud dmar po zhes rgyal ba'i bka' srung chen po beg tse lcam dral du grags pa de nyid yin/ 'di'i gsang sgrub be'u bum gyi nang du bzhugs pa dbang phyug chen po'i rnam 'gyur gyi gas su yod pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par bshad kyang chog la/ 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i gsung gi sprul par gsungs shing / 'jam dpal nā ka rakta'i rgyud la sogs pa nas ngo bo gcig pa'i bka' sdod du gsungs/ rgyud de dag las/ ti ba tsa ya zhes bya ba/ /klu yi sde dpon nā ga yin/ /bye ba dgu khri zhes bya ba/ /gshen rje'i sde dpon nā ga yin / /ha nu bsna zhes bya ba/ /bdud kyi sde dpon nā ga yin/ /ral pa tshar dgu zhes bya ba/ /'chi bdag sde dpon nā ga yin/ /yakta mgo dgu zhes bya ba/ /srin po'i sde dpon nā ga yin/ /gza' rgod nag po zhes bya ba/ /gza' yi sde dpon nā ga yin/ /tshangs pa shī la ral pa can/ /srid pa'i sde dpon nā ga yin / /gshin bu rje la 'chi ba'i bdag /nag po chen po klu bdag nyid/ /sku gcig sprul pa du mar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas tshangs pa dung thod can/ rgyal po ngal bsos po/ be har/ rdor legs/ khyab 'jug sogs dregs pa'i sde dpon rnams dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i khungs khyad par can yod la/ 'chi bdag gshin rje'i rgyal po dang thugs rgyud gcig pa'i gnad kyis da lta'i dus su yang mi dbang 'di nyid dam can chos kyi rgyal por lhag par mos shing / srung ma'i 106—141

gtso bor mdzad pa dang / lcags phag lo ri bo dga' ldan du phebs/ sems dpa' rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug don yod mkhas grub sogs dang lhan du/ dam can chos rgyal gyi zhal brnyan mjal ba snang dus bdud rtsi (ma phyi mi gsal )bor phebs pa dang / dga' ldan khang gsar gyi nyi 'od sbug gi chos rgyal gyi log bris las/ bdud rtsi rgyun du 'dzag pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags du ma kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa yin no/ /de la yam shud dmar po ni/ 'das pa'i dus su yab rgyal po gser gyi shugs can dang / yum btsun mo utpa la'i rgyan gnyis kyi sras su sku mched gnyis yod pa'i gcen grags ldan gyi bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang / gcung grags skyes ni gnod sbyin yam shud dmar po yin la/ grags ldan nang pa'i chos la dad cing /gcung po phyi rol gyi grub mtha' la mos pa las rtag tu rtsod pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa la/ nam zhig gi tshe bstan pa rgyal du btsugs te cho long rtses gang rgyal ba'i rjes su 'jug par byas so/ /der cho long rtses pas grags ldan rgyal te/ pha'i chos lugs la zhugs shig gsungs pas gcung gis ma gsan par bros so/ /grags ldan gyis bdas te bzung bas grags skyes na re/ bdag bsad kyang nyid kyi chos lugs la mi 'jug pas de bas na bdag ma bsad par thong / khyed rang nam shig sangs rgyas pa'i dus srung ma byas te bstan pa la gnod pa thams cad kyi srog dbugs dbral bar bgyi'o/ /bstan pa bshig pa la chad pas bcad par bgyi'o / /zhes zhal gyis bzhes te dam bcas so/ /der grags ldan gyis grags skyes la dbang bskur te/ nga nam sangs rgyas pa'i dus su khyod bstan srung du gyur cig /de'i bstan pa la gnod pa'i srog gi gshed ma gyis shig /khyod kyis 111—142

nga'i bstan pa spel bar gyis shig /ces bsgos te dpang rtags su zangs kyi rmog dang byu ru'i dbyug pa dang / bse'i mda' gzhu rnams phyag tu gtad nas srog bdag yam shud dmar po zhes mtshan gsol lo/ /de'i dbang gis grags ldan bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas dzambu'i gling du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis gcung grags skyes ni / nyi ma byang shar gyi mtshams mu med pa'i mya ngan gyi thang chen po bdun 'das pa'i pha rol na/ ma ru rtse'i dur khrod ces pa byu ru'i thang dmar po yangs pa'i rdzongs / mchong gi byang ri dmar po khrag gi ral pa can gyi mdun/ khrag mtsho dmar nag (ma phyi mi gsal )byang sprin dmar po 'khrigs pa'i gseb na/ glog 'khyug cing 'brug ldir ba/ sa gzhi thams cad khrag gi na bun dang / zangs kyi rlung 'tshub chen pos gtibs pa na bse mkhar dmar po bso'i kha pad can zangs kyi sgo glegs dang sgo'i nang na zangs kyi chu srin ngur ba/ mi khrag dang rta khrag mtshor 'khyil ba'i dbus thod pa'i gur khang chen po'i nang du/ yab gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can dang / yum srin mo khrag gi ral pa can gnyis 'dus pa las lo gcig song ba dang yum gyi mngal nas byu ru'i sgo nga gcig dang bse'i sgo nga gcig ste gnyis byung / sgo nga de gnyis btsas ma thag tu nam mkhar 'phur bas lha chen brgyad btul/ bar snang du 'phyos pas gza' chen brgyad btul/ sa 'og tu 'dzul bas klu chen brgyad btul/ yab yum gnyis kyang za bar thug pa na yul de'i phu na gnod sbyin gyi phug par dbang phyug chen po ma hā de wa dang e ka dza ṭi gnyis bzhugs pas mkhyen te/ dbang sdud kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs par sgo nga gnyis mdun du byung bar kha ṭwāṃ ka brgyab ste brtol pas byu ru'i 186—143

sgo nga'i nang nas mi dmar po skra ltag par bcings pa zangs kyi beg tse dang ral ka gyon pa/ bse'i mda' gzhu dang zangs kyi ral gri bsnams pa/ mdung dmar po dang dar gyi ru mtshon bsgreng ba/ ra slog dmar po gos su gyon zhing byu ru'i 'khar ba thogs pa zhig byung / de la dbang phyug chen pos khyod su'i sprul pa yin / ming la gang zer/ srog gi snying po gang yin/ zas skar gang yin/bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor gang yin gsung pas/ des smras pa/ kye ma hā de wa lags / bdag ni gshin rje gshed po'i gsung gi sprul pa lags/ bdag gi ming la skyes bu dbang gi mdog can zhes kyang bya/ srog bdag dmar po zhes kyang bya/ yam shud dmar po zhes kyang bya/ bdag gi srog snying ni 'di lags so zhes dri ba dri lan gyi tshul du/ ma ru tse bshan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud gsungs/bse'i sgo nga'i nang nas srid pa'i bu mo mdog mthing zhun ltar sngo ba/ bse dmar po'i gdong pa can/ so dung / smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa la mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan pa/ zangs kyi ral gri dang phur pa thogs pa/ dred mo mi zan la zhon pa zhig byung ngo / de la e ga dza kris srid pa'i bu mo gdong dmar ma khyod kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung dgos/ srog gi snying po gang yin/ gsang ba'i mtshan dang zas skal gang yin smros shig gsungs pas/ smras pa/ ming ni srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma zhes bya/ gsang mtshan padma gar gyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya/ zas skal ni bstan pa la gnod par byed pa rnams kyi srog dbugs lags / zhes sogs dri ba dri lan gyi tshul du dmar mo bshan pa 'jig rten za byed ma'i rgyud gsungs so/ /thub pa'i dbang po'i spyan sngar byon/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes te dam bcas/ rgya bod kyi gtsug lag 106—144

mang po'i srung ma mdzad/ dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i srung mar mnga' gsol/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas bzung ste dga' ldan pho brang gi srung ma'i gtso bo mdzad/ phyis rgyal ba lnga pa'i dus su dga' ldan pho brang gi phyi nang gi gnyer kha thams cad/ 'di nyid la gtod par mdzad pa yang deng sang gi gnas skabs mngon par mkhyen pa'i dgongs gzhi khyad par can du mngon/ de bas na srung ma'i dbang po 'di nyid 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i rnam 'phrul yin pas/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum la sogs pa gshed skor gyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi dbang phyug dang /sngar bshad pa bzhin 'jam dpal nyid shākya'i rgyal po dang thugs rgyud gcig pas des na/ bstan pa'i bdag po rdo rje dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhengs pa'i dus 'khor gsang 'dus bde mchog sogs kyis mtshon te dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad kyi khyab bdag tu bzhugs/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud las/ mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'di/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten gsum/ /'gro ba kun la 'di yis khyab/ /ces pa dang / thams cad bla ma'i gnas la sogs/ /mkha' 'gro mas ni thams cad khyab/ /ces gsungs shing / de'i 'grel par 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal pos/ yul nyer bzhi'i mkha' 'gro mas ni yul thams cad la khyab par gnas so/ /zhes pa dang / phag mo ste de'i khongs su gtogs pa ni mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi dang / khwa gdong ma sogs brgyad do/ /de ltar na rnal 'byor ma so drug po thams cad kyang phag mos bsdus la de nyid kyang bcom ldan 'das las tha dad pa ma yin no/ /zhes pa dang / mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma sa 'og spyod ma yin pas 'di rnams kyis mtho ris dang sa steng dang sa 'og gi 186—145

'jig rten gsum po kun la khyab par bzhugs so/ /zhes gsungs pas na mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo thams cad kyi bdag nyid du bzhugs/ shākya'i rgyal po dang bskal bzang sangs rgyas gzhan rnams kyang spyan ras gzigs kyis sprul par cho ga zhib mo las/ spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong zhes sogs kyis bshad pas / bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong dang / rigs lnga rigs gsum nye sras brgyad sogs dang dgongs pa gcig pa'i bdag nyid du grub/ 'das pa'i dus na de bzhin gshegs pa klu'i rigs mchog tu gyur pa dang / da ltar ba'i dus su 'jig rten gyi khams rtag pa rab tu dga' ba sdug cing mos pa zhes bya ba na/sangs rgyas rab tu dga' ba'i snying po nor bu rin chen brtsegs pa zhes bya bar bstan nas/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin gyi mdo las gsungs/ 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang /ma 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs pa zhes bya bar sangs sor mo'i phreng ba la phan ba'i mdo las gsungs rgya ba'i tshul ston par gsungs/ sangs rgyas 'di'i zhing gi yon tan ni bde ba can gyi zhing las dpes kyang mi mtshon pa'i yon tan gyis / dkon brtsegs las gsungs/ khyad du 'phags par gsungs te/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan gyi bkod pa brjod pa de dang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing / 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can na/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod pa de nyid 'dra 'am 'on te mi 'dra snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems kyi rtog pa thugs kyis thugs su chud nas/ byang chub sems dpa' seṅge'i rtsal gyis mngon par bsgrags pa'i sgra la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu 'di 106 —146

lta ste/ dper na mi la la zhig gis skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshags pa'i chas rgya mtsho chen po las chu'i thigs pa gcig bslangs na rigs kyi bu 'di ji snyam du sems/chu bslangs pa de dang phyi na lus pa de gnyis gang mang bar 'gyur/ gsol pa/bcom ldan 'das bslangs pa ni nyung / phyi na lus pa ni tshad ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ rigs kyi bu mi de'i skra'i rtse mo brgyar gshags pa'i chas rgya mtsho chen po las chu'i thigs pa gcig bslangs pa de tsam du ni 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod par blta'o/ /rgya mtsho chen po na chu'i lhag ma ji snyed cig yod pa de tsam du ni bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan bkod par blta'o/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin gshegs pa 'di'i sku tshe yang bsam gyi mi khyab pa ste/ de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu/ rnam grangs des kyang 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de'i tshe'i tshad ni tshad med grangs med par 'gyur bar rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs/ des na drang srong nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs pa rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul bar mdzad pa'i rigs ldan mi'i dbang po 'jam dpal grags pa zhes bya ba de nyid kyang gzhan du med de dus kyi 'khor lo'i nang le'u mdor bsdus bdun pa'i 'grel chen las/ 'jam dpal grags par nyi ma'i shing rtas phyag byas pa'i tshul 'chad pa na/ nyi ma'i shing rtas bla ma'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal la bstod nas zhabs gnyis spyi bor byas te/slar yang rang gi stan la 'khod do/ /zhes gsungs shing mdor bsdus gsum pa 106 —147

las / 'jam dpal rgyal po grags par gyur te byang chub sems dpa'i seṅge'i khri de las lo brgya'i bar du chos bstan to/ /zhes kyang gsungs so/ /de bas na rgyal ba thams cad dang bdag nyid gcig tu gyur pa'i mi dbang 'di nyid kyi yang dag pa'i yon tan ni sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par mi nus mod/ 'on kyang / rtag tu dam pa'i yon tan rnams/ /skye bo dam pas lhag par sgrog /ma la ya yi tsan dan dri/ /rlung gis phyogs bcur rgyas par byed/ /ces pa dang / dam pa'i yon tan sbas gyur kyang / /'jig rten kun la khyab par gsal/ /sna ma'i me tog legs bkab kyang / /dri zhim kun tu khyab par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/bsngags 'os kyi dam pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu gleng ba dang / gang gi rnam thar bzang po rang gzhan gyi skye bo mang po'i spyod yul du gyur pas bsam gyis mi khyab na mtha' dag ni bshad pas mi lang mod/ 'on kyang rags pa tsam gyi dbang du bgyis na rtsod pa dang bral ba'i skyes chen dam pa rgya mtsho lta bu las zab rgyas kyi gdams pa thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa dag legs par bzhes te thugs nyams su bstar zhing / de'i mthu las ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bla med kyi lung dngos nyams rmi lam gyi tshul du gsal por 'bul ba dang / lung 'bul ba la ma ltos par da lta gzhan gyi bsam pa la ji ltar yod pa dang / phyogs gang nas gang 'ong / 'byung 'gyur gyi don sogs thol byung gsal por gzigs pas / skabs 'gar gzhan nas zhu yig phul bar kha ma phye ba'i gong du bka' lan gnang / de nas dbye ba na gsung lan ji ltar gnang ba dang 'thun pa'i brjod bya mchis pa sogs deng sang gi bar du mchis ste/ sku la bcar ba thams cad kyi 106—148

mngon sum mo/ /mchog gsum la mchod 'bul sogs gnang dus dam tshig gi bris sku rnams zhal mdangs 'gyur ba dang / sngon med kyi dri bzang khyad par can 'thul ba sogs rgyal ba rgya mtsho sprin ltar 'du ba'i rtags gsal zhing gdon bgegs kyis gzir ba sogs la dgongs pa gtad pa dang byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis zhi ba/ thugs la phog cing mi bsrun bar bgyis pa rnams la rgyal khrims kyi chad pas ma bcad kyang / nad gdon drag pos zin pa'am bsad skrad dbye rmongs kyi rim pa ci rigs dus kyi chos nyid du 'gyur ba sogs dam can srung ma bran du bkol ba'i rdzu 'phrul lam/ rang nyid bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i dbang por grub pa'i lag rjes 'gog pa med par ston pa dang / gal gag ji ltar che ba bzhin gyis dkon mchog kho na la thugs yid rton te skyabs su re ba'i gsol 'debs mchod 'bul sogs rnam dkar kho na la sgril par mdzad/ blun po longs spyod gsog rnams la/ /gnyen gyi bsam pa ga la yod/ /sdig stug gtam ngan kho na yis/ /byi ba bzhin du bsags nas 'chi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar / stobs dang ldan pa phal cher sdig pa dang gtam ngan khyad du bsad de sdug bsngal gyi rgyu kho na sgrub pas longs spyod gsog pa mang zhing / shes rab med pa'i longs spyod kyang / /phal cher rang la phan pa nyung / /'dod 'jo ba yi 'o ma yang / /be'us 'thung ba rgya lam yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bar skabs kyi bod kyi btsad po rim byon rnams dang / 'byor pa can bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i longs spyod thams cad gzhan gyi ched du/ bsags pa bzhin gyi rang la spyod pa'i dbang med cing don med 'ba' zhig tu gyur med/ mi gang bsod nams la spyod pa / /btang yang longs spyod char bzhin 'bab/ /bsod nams med pa'i 106—149

longs spyod de/ /bsags kyang su yin za ba soms/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/mi'i dbang po 'di ni ha cang rnam dkar la gtong phod ches pas/ phyag mdzod du dngos po cung zad kyang ma lus par thug kyang de ma thag sor de dpal 'byor gong 'phel du gyur pa ni sngon bsags kyi bsod nams rlabs po che'i 'bras rtags su sems / dus thams cad du bdag ni srog dang bral kyang sla'i/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du/ gang phan pa de nyid bdag gis bsgrub par bya'o snyam du dam bca' zhing / thugs bskyed pa dang / smon lam yang de kho na mdzad/ sbyin la rtag tu sems spro ba/ /de yi grags pa rlung bzhin ldang / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin mchod 'os kyi yul du gyur pa'i dam pa dang dge 'dun rnams la bkur sti/phongs pa dang nad pa mgon med pa rnams la byams skyong / ji lta ji ltar rje dpon gyis/ /'khor la drin gyis bskyangs gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar g.yog 'khor rnams/ /rje dpon nyid kyi bya ba sgrub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'brel thogs kyi zham ring dang gnyen bshes sogs kun la/ g.yo med pa'i drin gyis legs par bskyangs pas snyan grags kyis phyogs thams cad khyab cing / ji ltar 'brel che ba/ bzhin gyi gus pa mi lhod pa'i ngang tshul du bsgyur bar nus pa 'di yin la/ 'on kyang nam par ma brtags pa dang / ngo tsha med pa dang /chags sdang gis mig ldongs pa dag gi blo la ji ltar 'char ba dang skur pa 'debs pa la nges pa med de/ bdag nyid che la skye bo rnams/ /skyon 'tshol 'gyur gyi dman la min/ /'phan zel rin chen la blta yi/ /mgal dum la ni su zhig dpyod / /ces dam pa rnams la skyon rtog gi blo 'char ba smra zhing / skur pa 'debs pa yang mang bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phan pa chung ngu'ang mi brjed 786—150

pa / /bdag nyid chen po'i che rtags yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byas pa gzo ba dang / skyes bu dam pa rin chen bzhin/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gyur ldog med / /skye bo ngan pa sung mda' bzhin/ /cung zad tsam gyis mtho dman byed/ /ces pa dang / lhun po cis kyang mi bsgul ba/ /de bzhin bdag nyid chen po brtan / /shing bal chung ngu g.yo ba ltar/ /dman pa'i spyod pa 'gyur ldog che/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin du/ sngar zhal 'dris yod pa'i shin tu dman pa rnams la'ang stobs kyis 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur kyang bsnyengs pa mi mdzad par bka' 'dri bslab bya dbugs dbyung gnang cha sogs/ sgo du mas brtse bar mdzad de 'gyur ldog med par skyong ba'i gzhung bzang ba dang / phra ma la sogs pas 'byed par mi nus pa'i mi g.yo ba dang / skyes mchog rnams la dman pa rnams / /khro yang lan du ga la khro/ /ce spyang dregs pa'i skad 'byin yang / /ri dwags rgyal po snying rje skye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sgo sna tshogs pas glags blta zhing mtho mtshams par 'dod pa dang / bar skabs su bya ba ma yin pa mang po'i rgyu la zhugs te skur 'debs dang / gnod sems lhur len pa'i skye bo rnams la yang mkhyen bzhin du byams pas bskyangs te bde legs su mdzad/ bdag nyid dpon du bskos gyur na/ /de yi bya ba shes pa dkon/ /gzhan la lta ba'i mig yod kyang / /rang nyid lta na me long dgos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bla dpon chen por gyur pa phal cher/ rang gi bya ba la legs par rtog pa shin tu dkon na'ang 'di nyid ni nyin re bzhin du bdag gi bya ba ni ci lta bu snyam ste so sor rtog cing dpyod la gzu bor gnas pa dang / gzhung ngan gzhan gyi bka' drin las/ /byung ba rang gi che bar bsgom/ /klu yis 'bad nas phab ba'i char/ /zhing pa 186—151

rang gi dpal du brtsi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde skyid kyi dpal 'byor ji tsam thob kyang dkon mchog rin po che'i 'phrin las su go ba'i bka' drin rjes su dran cing gzo ba shin tu dka' yang / /rtag par thugs nas mi g.yel ba'i rjes su dran pa dang / mi mkhas pa dag gnyen bcoms nas/ /'brel med gzhan dag gso ba mthong / /mgo bo bcad nas mjug ma'i rgyan/ /smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ btsad po sngon ma phal cher/ gzhan gyi zhu phyogs dang khug brngan dang ngo bsrung la brten pa'i/ 'os pa las 'phrogs te mi 'os pa la ster ba sogs ci rigs su mdzad pa la 'di ni de ltar mi mdzad/ rtag tu byams pas skyong ba yi/ /rje bo bran g.yog rnyed par sla/ /padma'i mtsho la ngang pa dag /ma bsdus par yang ngang gis 'du/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gang gi rnam thar bzang po rnams mthong ste bsngags par 'os pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams dang / rigs dang stobs 'byor gyis mtho ba'i skye dgu blo gros dang dpa' tsal gyis khengs pa'i skye bo sogs thams cad kyang zham ring du btud nas ngang gis 'du/ chen po rnams la brten bcas pa/ /dman pa rnams kyang chen po thob/ /ljon shing che la brten pa yi/ /'khri shing rtse mor phyin la ltos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dam pa 'di nyid la snying thag pa nas blo gtad bca' ba thams cad nges par mi bslu zhing 'dod don rnams ngang gis 'grub pa zhig sngar nas da lta'i bar du mchis/ mdor na chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan gyis dge ba bcu'i khrims kyi steng du dkon mchog la gus pa dang gcig /dam chos bsgrub pa dang gnyis / drin can gong du bkur ba dang gsum/ pha ma la bkur ba dang bzhi/rigs mtho ba dang rgan par phu dud byed pa dang lnga/ mdza' bshes la gzhung 106—152

rgyud ring pa dang drug /yul mi la phan 'dogs pa dang bdun/ yid drang ba dang brgyad/ mig ya rabs la lta ba dang dgu/ zas nor la spyod shes pa dang bcu / drin can la phan lan 'jal ba dang bcu gcig /bre sung la g.yo sgyu med pa dang bcu gnyis/ spyi snyoms shing phrag dog med pa bcu gsum/ bud med kyi kha la mi nyan pa dang bcu bzhi/ ngag 'jam zhing smra mkhas pa dang bco lnga/theg pa che zhing blo khog yangs pa dang bcu drug ste rnam thar gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims bcas pa ltar mi chos kyi yon tan byed pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pas khyad par 'phags pa ni legs par brtags pas shes so/ /'ga' zhig gi bsam par ngo bstod kyi mdzes mtshon kho nas 'di ltar bsgrag cing sgro btags pa las mi bden no snyam du sems pa'ang srid mod/ ji skad du/ ngan pa ji ltar bcos gyur kyang / /rang bzhin bzang po 'byung mi srid/ /sol ba 'bad de bkrus na yang / /kha dog dkar por mi srid do/ /zhes pa ltar gzhi nas yon tan khyad par can dang mi ldan na/ sgro brtags dang bcos ma'i rnam thar ni gtan la phab pa na rdzun par 'gyur te/ dman la spyod pa bzang byung yang / /de ni bcos ma'i rnam par yin/ /shel la nor bur kha bsgyur yang / /chu dang phrad na rang mdog ston/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /bal yul gyi mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor du grags pa/ sngar mkhan slob chos gsum gyi sku 'phreng sngon ma zhig tu bskrun par mdzad pa'i byin rlabs can de nyid dus dbang gis rim gyis nyams te zhig ral du gyur cing / bang rim 'og ma rnams sa 'og tu nub pa'i tshong ba rnams kyi zhag sa byed pa'i gnas su gyur pa la sngon gyi dam bca' rjes su dran pas longs spyod la phangs pa med par gtong ba'i sgo nas gsar bzhengs lta bu mdzad/ de 111—153

yang / sdig pa dang ni mthu rtsal las/ /byung ba'i longs spyod longs spyod min/ /khyi dang byi la bgrangs na yang / /ngo tsha bor ba'i rnam thar yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gzhan nor 'phrog bcoms dang g.yo sgyus bsgrubs pa'i zang zing ma 'dres pa'i sgo nas 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gsung par rin po che sngon med gsar bzhengs/ bka' gdams bstan pa'i rtsa lag ra sgreng gi gtsug khang gsar bzhengs lta bu'i zhig gso 'gran zla dang bral ba mdzad/ sngar ra sgreng gi shug pa ming can rnams kyang skams pa zhig gso mdzad pa nas bzung sngon med kyi shug gsar ldem bu du mas gang bar gyur pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags kyang shin tu gsal/ 'jig rten dbang phyug rgyal ba'i dbang po bdun pa chen po/ 7gong ma bdag po chen po'i bkas mi nyag gi yul du gdan drangs/ dus dbang gis mtha' dbus kyi las sgo thams cad je zhan du gyur/ sngar gong ma lnga pa chen po'i dus gsar du bskrun pa'i gzhung gi bang mdzod chen po rnams kyang / bar skabs kyi dus 'gyur rnams la brten pa'i rim par zad/ se 'bras dge gsum gyis mtshon te/ grwa sa chen po rnams kyi zhabs tog sogs kyi gzhung nas gnang dgos kyi gtong sgo sngar 'jags kyi steng bod 'bangs bde thabs/ rgyal ba yab sras dang gong ma chen po'i zhabs brtan gyi rnam dkar sngar bas bldabs 'gyur gyis 'phar ba'i gtong yong kha mi 'thab pa'i dus 'dir thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul la brten nas/ tshogs mchod smon lam la sogs pa'i zhabs tog dga' ldan pho brang grwa rgyas pa'i mthar thug pa'i skabs las gzabs pa/ lo re bzhin yar rgyas su gnang thub pa dang / slob dpon ma ti tsi tras mdzad pa'i rtsod pa'i dus kyi gtam las/ tshul khrims las nyams thos pa'i nor bral 'dod pas 'di nyid 186—154
