cung zad mchod par byed/ /nyes med tshul khrims ldan la yon tan ro la rgyab phyogs zhe sdang cung zad nyes pa dgod/ /rab byung rnams la khyim pas las bsgo de nas rab byung des kyang khyim pa mgu bar byed/ /ci spyad 'gro ba 'dir ni 'gro ba'i khyim du ma lus dus kyi smyigs ma zhugs pa yin/ /da ltar legs pa ldan pa'i skye bo ngo tsha sdig pa can bsngags dga' bar 'byung / /slob dpon nor rnams mchog tu sems pas 'joms phyir slob ma rnams ni zhum par gnas/ /'di na byis pa'i nye du'i 'khrul 'khor gyis bcings pa ni sun 'byin byed pa bzhin/ /da ltar rtsod pa'i dus na 'jig rten rnams la g.yo sgyu'i mtshon drag stobs dang ldan / /bcud rnams sas 'thung dngos rnams stobs chung lha rnams char ni 'bebs mi byed/ /rlung rnams rab tu drag ldang lo tog rnams ni mi smin skye mi 'gyur / /skyes la ser 'bab sa rnams rtsod pa'i dus kyi dbang bsgyur 'bras bu med / /dngos rnams mthu med dgos pa sgrub rnams nyams pa thog la brtag /'gro la nad 'phel sa ni de dag 'byung po rnams kyis btang / /ljon pa'i nags tshal bskams pa'i yal ga'i lag pa gyen du 'greng byed de/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyis bcom bya'i bzang po'i dus nub ri bo cho nges 'debs/ /yul bzang chags pa rnams spangs sa rnams su ni dus bzang yongs su zad/ /yon tan mkhas la mi bkur nor ldan rnams ni mchod bya min par mchod/ /skye rmongs mchod byed gshin rjes 'jig rten sdug bsngal des khrid gang gis bzlog /tshul khrims 'chal pa stobs ldan tshul khrims ldan pa bsdigs shing tshar gcod byed/ /sdig pa dga' ba'i stobs ldan g.yo can rnams kyis dam chos bsgrubs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig sdom pa la gnas bstan pa'i mchog la 'jug par byed pa nyung / /the 186—155

tshom yod min drang srong bstan pa ring po mi thogs nub par 'gyur/ /g.yul 'gyed rtsod pa du mas gos ltar sa g.yogs lo tog skyes la 'dod mi 'byung / /rlung rnams mi bzad ldang zhing de bzhin skye bo yang dag mchod mi byed/ /rgyal po 'phrang dang rkun ma'i 'jigs pas mi dag bag phebs nor rnams longs mi spyod/ /da ltar skye bo sdug bsngal bcas 'tshor 'gro ba rnams la 'jigs pa 'byung / /gang zhig dus su char med gang du lam zhugs ser ba mi mthun du ma 'bab/ /gang zhig ba rnams 'o ma mi 'byung dus rnams 'khrugs shing sa las 'bru mi skye/ /sman rnams gang yin nus med de bzhin khyad par rnams ni rab tu nyams/ /yid ni nges bcom chos min rtsod pas dngos po 'di kun nyes dang bcas/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'di chos spangs mi bzad pa la yang dag zhugs pas na/ /gang du dbang pos char phab ljon shing yal ga dag las me tog 'bras bu cung zad snang / /sa gzhi brlan pa dang bcas sa rnams gang yin pa las lo tog smin gyur pa/ /de kun tshul khrims brtul zhugs yan lag sdom ldan chos dang ldan pa'i mthu/ /dus rnams 'khrugs shing sa la bcud rnams nub gyur nyi zla log par rgyu/ /chung ma khyo la gcugs pas 'brel ba'i sems med dman pa rnams ni mthon por 'gyur/ /rgyal po chos spangs nor rnams mchog tu don gnyer bu rnams pha la snang / /kye hud sdug bsngal rtsod pa'i dus ni nyer gnas bsod nams gnyer ba nags su song / /chos dang rab byung dka' thub rnams 'bros bde ba rnams ni ring du song bar gyur/ /sa rnams 'bras bu nyung zhing rgyal po 'khrug byed mtshon gyis rgyal byed rnam par gnon/ /'jig rten bud med la dad bud med kyang g.yem bram ze rnams ni 'dod chen bcas/ /legs pa rnams nub skye ngan stobs ldan 106—156

du ma rtsod pa'i dus su bzang po yi/ /dus song bde ba rnams 'das dus der sbyor ba'i skyes bu rnams kyang 'das/ /'dir yang dus mtha' de rnams mun bcas phug bzhin shes ma yin/ /legs byas brgya phrag dri yis bsgos pa yis /skal ldan nub cing dus ni 'das par 'gyur/ /pad gzhon rtsa ba'i skud pa bzhin / /dkar po'i chos rnams phra bar gyur/ /blo ldan skyes bu gtam mkhas dri mas bsgo/ /'gro 'di dga' med dga' ston zin pa bzhin/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di ni yang dag 'gags/ /gang na yon tan rnams kyi stobs phra la/ /yon tan la bdud babs pa gcod byed cing/ /skye bo smra ba la brten 'tsho bar byed / /ces pa dang / gso ba rig pa'i don ma lus nye bar gdams pa man ngag yon tan gyi rgyud du'ang / lnga brgya dus kyi tha mar gyur tsa na/ /mi rnams 'dod pa'i dbang gis log par spyod/ /sngags pa rnams ni rdo rje nang dme dar/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams ni sde 'khrug byed/ /mu stegs ban bon rnams ni zor kha 'phen/ /skye bo rnams ni mna' thab bshan dmar byed/ /de dus ma mo mkha' 'gro kun 'khrugs te/ /nad kyi kha rlangs sprin du chags pa las/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snyigs ma'i dus kyi rang gzugs mngon du gyur pa'i snod bcud kyi 'byor pa rnams ngang gis 'grib cing / mi 'dod pa'i rgyad pa rlung ltar ldang ba ding sang gi dus kyi chos nyid dang / ratna'i spyi lung sogs mthun par kun mkhyen lnga pa'i skabs lung bstan nas/ de 'dra'i bstan pa mi lo drug cu 'byung: rjes kyis bstan zhabs dang bcas bdun cu 'tsho: zhes gsang sgo'i skabs yan chad kyi bde skyid phal cher rdzogs par gsungs shing / kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po'i gzigs snang rigs gsum mtshan ma'i rgya can gyi nang du/ chu yos 106—157

hor zla dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin/ phyag na rdo rje dregs 'dul bdud sde phyer 'thag gi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs mthar grub chen las kyi rdo rje'i thugs kur bsdus nas/ rang cag dga' ldan bstan pa 'di/ /dar dang 'dra ba cung ma dar/ /chos kyi snying po nub la nye/ /srid byang 'phel ba'i mthar thug yin/ /zhes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi 'phel ka mthar thug pa de skabs yin par dngos su gsungs pa'i shugs la/ kun mkhyen lnga pa mya ngan las 'das rjes nas mar 'grib kyi mgo tshugs par bstan pa dang / gong gi 'phro las/ bdud dbang du song na lo bcu gcig nas bstan par 'pho 'phyugs 'ong / rten 'brel 'grigs na mi lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga bsring thub/ 'on kyang sngon gyi sri dang rten 'brel gyi dbang gis 'tshub 'gyur sna tshogs 'ong / khyad par lo nag mche ba can la 'chags che/ zhes rten 'brel 'grig kyang chos srid kyi bstan pa rgyas pa mi lo lnga bcu nga lnga las mi 'byung bar gsungs/ /de don bzhin chu yos nas me bya'i bar la mi lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga song / lo nag mche ba can ste/ nyi ldog gi dbang du byas pa'i sa khyi shar ma thag hong tha'i ji'i dmag gis lha bzang khang bcoms/ dga' ldan pho brang gi chab srid 'phrogs pas/ lung don thog tu 'khel song ba sogs sgo gang sa nas bde skyid 'byung ba zhig shin tu dka' bar snang na'ang / dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ /don grub pa dang bde skyid thob/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /yul phyogs dge zhes mkhas rnams sgrog /ces gsungs pa ltar 'phags chen dam pa'i thugs bskyed kyi dpung btsan pos bskal pa skad cig dang / skad cig bskal par bsgyur ba sogs kyi sgo nas ngan pa bzang por bsgyur ba dang / bzang po ngan par bsgyur ba la dbang 'byor pa yin pas 706—158

dka' tshegs med par ma zad/ rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i gter byon lha chen gyi lo rgyus las/ spyir snyigs ma lnga bdo sum cu kha ral gyi dus na gnam gyi 'od nyams pas char chu sgang gshongs che: sa'i bcud nyams pas lo tog dang rtsi shing mi smin: skye 'gro'i g.yang nyams pas nad rims dang dmag 'khrugs dar: de'i tshe na nag phyogs kyi stobs rgyas pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi snying la bdud zhugs nas gtsug lag khang dang chos 'khor 'jig: chos byed kyi mnga' thang 'phrog cing srog la brgol bas mtha'i dmag mtsho rdol: khyad par bod 'phung byed kyi che btsan 'gong po snying la zhugs pa dgus/ thabs du ma'i blo drid dang gdug rtsub kyis bod khams su mi bde ba'i duḥkha sna tshogs zings slong ba'i dus su nga'i rjes su zhugs pa rnams kyis de dag 'dul ba'i las bya'o/ /de yang drag po'i las kyis thub pa dka'o: zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i rjes su / des bod 'di re zhig bde bar 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs pa'i lung gsal gyi bod bde bar mdzad pa po ni/ chos rgyal chen po 'di nyid du nges pas de'i dbang gis btsad po 'dis srid bzung ba nas bzung ste stod smad thams cad du tshabs po che'i 'khrug rtsod/ lo nyes nad yams sogs skye 'gro'i bde skyid 'phrog byed stobs dang ldan zhing bzlog par mi nus pa nam yang ma byung / (ma phyi mi gsal )snyigs ma'i dus la ltos pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar du tshes pa lta bu yin pas/ ji skad du/ rgyal po shin tu mang mod kyi/ /chos bzhin skyong ba shin tu nyung / /mkha' la lha gnas mang na yang / /'od gsal nyi zla lta bu med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sgo thams cad nas 'dzoms pa chos rgyal chen po 'di lta bu u dum wa ra'i me tog lta bu dkon/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur khyad par 'phags pa ste/186—159

'byung ba dkon phyir dri med phyir/ /mthu ldan phyir dang 'jig rten gyi/ /rgyan gyur phyir dang mchog nyid phyir/ /'gyur ba med phyir dkon mchog nyid/ /ces mgon po byams pas ji ltar bsngags pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang deng sang mchog dman bar pa'i khrod du rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po (ma phyi mi gsal )zhes smra ba dang /mi gang 'di nyid kyang sngon khri srong gi dus kyi smon lam log pa'i bdud blon gyi skye bar ngos 'dzin byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis 'gong po spun dgu'i sras su dogs pa byed par mchis mod/ de dag gi 'dod pa ltar na yang 'phags chen dam par lung rigs kyis 'grub ste/ ston pa'i spyan sngar lha sbyin legs kur mu stegs ston pa drug la sogs pa/ ston pa rang nyid kyis che ba 'don byed du sprul pa'i thugs rgyud gcig par gsungs shing / de bzhin du 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug chos rgyal gyi rnam par bzhengs pa rim byon rnams dang / sku lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'grogs pa'i bdud blon rnams kyang chos rgyal rang nyid kyi che ba 'don byed du sprul bar lung las gsungs/ rigs pas kyang 'grub ste/ de ltar min par gang zag rang ga ba zhig yin na/ las tshabs po che skye ba re re bzhin de tsam zhig bsags nas dmyal bar mi skye ba mi srid la da lta dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du sdug bsngal myong bzhin par 'dug pa las rgyal ba na rim bzhin gyi sku 'phreng thams cad du 'bral med du 'byung ba dang / da ltar gyi dus su mi yul du stobs ldan gyi rgyal por 'gyur ba'i skabs med pas/ de bas na/ blo gros zhan pa'i 'dod gtam dang / /cang shes min pa'i rta mchog dang / /g.yul ngor lhung ba'i ral gri rnams/ /su yi grogs 'gyur nges pa med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar khyed rang rnams kyis smad pa'i lugs bgyis kyang don du bstod 186—160

par 'gyur bas legs so/ /'jig rten mthun 'jug gi mdo las/ brgya byin tshangs pa'i cha byad dang / /la lar bdud kyi cha byad kyis/ /sems can gyi ni don mdzad ste/ /'jig rten gyi ni ga la rtogs/ /zhes bdud kyi cha byad bzung nas sems can gyi don mdzad par gsungs pa bzhin/ 'gong po spun dgu yang nges pa'i don du bcom ldan 'das nyid yin pas/ mkhas pa rang gis dpyod shes kyis/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brangs/ /khyi rgan ku co 'don pa las//rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug /ces pa'i don thog tu 'bab pas kha rog par sdod cig /skyid bshod sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan pas/ de dang babrel ba byang phyogs sa skyong gi/ /pho brang rgya bod kun gyis btud pa'i gnas/ /dga' ldan khang gsar zhes bya lcang lo can/ /nor ldan dpal mo mgron du bos 'dra yod/ /ces gsungs pa'i lugs brgya'i 'dun sa phun tshogs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i pho brang chen por gser zhal mngon par mtho bar 'tsho zhing gzhes pa 'di ste snying por dril ba'i rtogs pa brjod pa bshad zin to//gsum pa/ gsung par rin po che srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta'i byung ba brjod pa la gsum ste/ gang du bzhengs pa'i gnas kyi byung ba brjod pa dang / ji ltar bzhengs pa'i byung ba dngos brjod pa dang / bzhengs pa'i gsung par gyi go rim mthar chags su bkod pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mi rje khri srong lde btsan gyis/ lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs nas srung ma su bsko mkhan slob chos gsum bka' bgros mdzad pa na/ rgyal po chen po pe har skabs su babs par 106—161

dgongs pa mthun pas lha sras mu khri btsan po lo gsum mtha'i so kha bsrung ba dang rgyal po spyan 'dren par mngags pa na/ lha sras kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin slob dpon chen pos rnam sras rta bdag brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa bkugs nas rje 'bangs thams cad kyi gzigs par lha sras kyi grogs mdzad par bka' bsgos/rnam sras kyi zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas lha sras kyi khang lha bzang klu dpal sogs bod dmag rnams 'khrid te byon nas/ rgya bod kyi mtshams su dmag rtsis bgyis dus / shar bya khra'i rgyal khams kyi dmag yin zer ba lus po mi la khra'i mgo bo can dang / lho phyogs grul bum gyi dmag yin zer ba stod mi la smad rta bong gi rkang ba can dang / nub phyogs byi la'i mjug ma can gyi dmag mi lus byi la'i mjug ma can dang / byang phyogs rna bo che'i dmag mi mi lus bong bu'i rna ba can sogs mgo brnyan sna tshogs pa'i dmag mi bsam las 'das pa byung bas/ gru gu dang rgya'i dpung btul/ bha ta hor gyi sgom gra bcoms te g.yu'i thub pa rang byon / shel gyi sbal lcong za hor rgyal po'i mi rgyud sogs dkor cha'i rjes su pe har gdan drangs/ yar lam rgya bod kyi so kha bsrung ma dmag dpung kha shas byang thang du bzhag pa las/ 'brog sder 'phel ba rnams kyi bdag po dbas rgod ldongs btsan gyi gdung brgyud thog ma'i rus dbas dang / phyi 'brog sde'i bya ba shes su 'jug pa'i lung thob pa las brtags te dbas shes phrug ces rus ming du grags pa de las dbas shes phrug lha seng gis rim gyis dbus su byon/ de'i tshab shes phrug dkon mchog 'bum la 'od zer 'bum zhes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ldan gyi bu mo zhig jo mor bzhes pas sras ljang tsha zhes pa 'khrungs/mtshan rdo rje 'bar du btags/ stod lung tshur phur bzhugs sde dpon du gyur/186—162

kurma pa dang yon mchod du 'brel/ kurma pa'i dbon mo zhig khab tu bzhes pas shes phrug rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ de la sras shes phrug dkon mchog dpal 'khrungs / des pakshi nam mkha' rin chen gyi sras mo skal ldan rgyan jo mor bzhes pas shes phrug dge ba bzang po 'khrungs/ ha cang dpa' drag pas stod lung nas phan yul du 'byon dgos pa byung / sde dpon gyi sa cha rgya che ba zhig bzung /bod chos rgyal gyi gdung brgyud/ lha lcam 'od skyid 'bar gyi sras mo hor skyid khab tu bzhes/ shes phrug dpal ldan 'bum 'khrungs/ de dang lha lcam phra ma 'dus pa las shes phrug dkon mchog skyabs 'khrungs/ 'di yan gdung rabs gcig brgyud du byon/ shes phrug gi zur chag pas/ de phyin chad nas shes phrug ces grags so/ /dkon mchog skyabs kyis dpal ldan skyid khab tu bzhes/bsod nams 'bum dang / shākya 'bum 'khrungs/ shākya 'bum gyis gzhon nu nas la stod sgang dkar khri tshar na dpon chen shākya bzang po'i dpon rgyud dbon chen phyug po khri dpal bzhugs pa'i sar byon pas/ lho bdag tu bskos/bsod nams 'bum gyis phan yul mkhar rtse ba'i bu mo dpal ldan 'bum jo mor bsus pas gzhon nu dbang phyug dang dkon mchog skyabs gnyis 'khrungs/gzhon nu dbang phyug shākya 'bum gyis la stod du bos te bu tshab tu bzung /'jam dbyangs gong mar lo gsar 'bul bar byon/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po che dang se chen rgyal po mjal/ mchod yon gyi la rgyar phan pa'i gtam mang du zhus pas rgyal po dgyes te 'ja' sa tham ka dang bcas gnang dbus su byon / sras 'od zer seṅge 'khrungs/ de la sras don yod dpal bzang dang kun dga' chos skyong 'khrungs/ don yod dpal bzang gis ral bzhi'i nang 186—163

nas khyad par 'phags pa rgyal nor lung pa'i lte ba rin chen spor grong btab pas pho brang rin chen spo zhes grags/ byang bdag ta'i si tu rdo rje mgon po'i sras mo jo mor bsus pas sras dkon mchog bzang po dang chos kyi rin chen 'khrungs/rgya nag tu gong mar lo gsar 'bul bar byon/ las ka thob kyang sku tshe'i bar gcod du gyur te rgya nag rang du gshegs/ de'i shul du kun dga' chos skyong gis rin chen gnas zhes grags pa'i pho brang btab/ gnas thang dang nas lung thang zhing du btul/ rgyal nor gyi phu chu yur du drangs pas so nam legs shing 'bru nor lhag par 'phel/ des kyang rgya nag tu byon pas gong mas lho khri skor la shes su 'jug pa'i 'ja' sa gnang / bod du byon sa skyar phebs kur gshegs/dkon mchog bzang pos kyang rgya nag tu byon/ gong mas 'ja' sa stsal yang rgya nag rang du grongs/ ta'i si chos kyi rin chen ni chos rgyal zla ba bzang po'i rnam 'phrul du grags shing / thog ma'i ring rab byung gi cha lugs mdzad pa zhig mchis dam pa'i mdzad spyod kyis 'da' ba dang / sman bla'i cho ga /sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal la thugs dam gyi mthil du mdzad/ 'bangs gyen ldog gi rnam pas ma rung ba 'ga' zhig gis phyir bdag la zhus te gsang dmag drangs/ rin chen spo blangs / ta'i si chos kyi rin chen mkhar ta phyogs su khrid ste/ chab la gshegs pa'i rtsis bgyis par ta'i sis mkhyen nas sgrol mar gsol ba btab pas/ kun gyis mthong bar nam mkha'i mthongs nas mi dmar rta dmar zhon pa 'khor gsum lus la btags pa zhig gis/ ta'i si bkrongs na mi legs pa'i lung bstan pas dmag mi rnams re zhig lus/ de ma khad byang bdag po'i pho nya yin zer ba'i mi gnyis byung ste ta'i si chab lam gshegs/ bka' shog rjes la 'ong gyin yod zer 186—164

bas dmag mi rnams kyis/ ta'i si chab la gshegs rgyu gshol nas byang du gdan drangs / che la'i rtser phebs pa na byang pa'i bka' shog ngo ma 'byor bar ta'i si gnod pa med par byang du gdan 'dren dgos pa'i bka' byung / dang po'i mi dmar ni 'bar ba spun bdun gyi nang chen lha btsan sgang dmar dang / bang phyin dang po ni sgrol ma'i sprul pa yin par 'dug /phyis byang bdag nyid kyang yid ches te kho rang gi sras mo lha lcam nam mkha' 'bum ta'i sir phul/ sa ris kha shas gnang bas/ ta'i sis byang bdag la zhus te/ ratna'i spyi lung du/ la stod rdo rje'i ri dang de gsum la: zhes lung bstan pa'i rdo rje'i ri ste yongs grags rgyal mo rir grags pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku'i dbyibs can du mchis pa de'i mdun du pho brang btab/ phyis ri rtser pho brang chen po shel dkar mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rdzong zhes pa btab cing / de dang 'brel bar dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang khor yug dang bcas pa rnams bzhengs par mdzad/ de lta bu'i ngo mtshar gyis 'phags pa'i pho brang chen po yul 'khor dang bcas pa'i shar du/ 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po rim par byon pa rnams kyi gdan sa bshad sgrub kun gyis 'byung gnas/ rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho sprin ltar 'du ba'i pho brang dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang chen po/ lhor he ru ma'i rang byon mngon par gsal ba'i gnas chen mtsho'o/ /nub tu dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang shrī parsha ta/ byang du rgyal ba rgod tshang pas zung 'jug brnyes pa'i gnas rgyal phu dpal gyi steng 'gro ste gnas chen bzhi/ shar du lha rgod gangs/ lho ru jo lang gangs/ nub tu rtar kyong gangs/ byang du bu le gangs te gangs chen bzhi / shar du logs lo/ lhor bong gshod/ nub tu gser sgang / byang du 186—165

rgyal khrom ste yul ljongs bzhi/ shar du logs chu/ lhor bong chu/ nub tu gser chu/ byang du rgyal chu ste chu chen bzhi/ nub tu g.yam pa ri 'khor lo'i dbyibs can/ lho nub tu lha btsan rdzong ri nor bu'i dbyibs can/ lhor phug chung ri glang po che/ shar lhor gdong skya ri rta mchog /shar du mgon nag bla ri dmag dpon/ byang shar du bsgrub ri sngo bsangs btsun mo/ byang du lha'u ri blon po rin po che'i dbyibs can te/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun gyi rnam pas bskor ba snod bcud kyi dge bcu ma tshang ba med pa'i rgyal khams 'bangs khyim khri khrag tu nye bas gang ba/ bde ba/ lo legs pa/ bkra shis pa phyogs bzhi'i 'dod dgu thams cad ma tshang ba med pa grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa dang /dam pa du mas zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa/ snyan ngag me long du / 'di ltar sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhir/ /zhes pa ltar/ bzo la sogs par gtogs pa sum cu rol mo'i bye brag bco brgyad/ glu dbyangs kyi nges pa bdun/gar gyi cha byad dgu la sogs pa rnams dang / lo chen thams cad mkhyen pas/skar rtsis snyan ngag sdebs sbyor dang / /mngon brjod zlos gar 'di lnga las/ /rig gnas lnga zhes 'phags yul na/ /grags pa'i ba dan rlung ltar sgrog /ces gsungs pa ltar gyi rig gnas chung ba lnga dang / bzo/ gso ba/ sgra/ tshad/nang rig pa te rig gnas che ba lnga sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa dang / khyad par sor mo'i 'du byed kyi 'phrul la goms pa'i rig byed 'dzin pa du mas dog par gyur pa'i 'jig rten shel dkar zhes pa lho phyogs nor 'dzin gyi thig ler gyur pa der/ gsung par rin po che 'di nyid bzhengs pa yin no//186wa 166

gnyis pa ji ltar bzhengs pa'i byung ba dngos brjod pa la yang gsum ste/bzhengs pa'i tshul bkod pa/ rgyu song gi rab byed brjod pa/ mchog dman bar pa'i skye dgu gzhan gyis bsam sbyor rnam par dag ba'i sgo nas/ tshogs kyi kha skong ji ltar bgyis pa'i tshul bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ gangs ri'i mgon po phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba de yang bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che las/ spyir sems can yongs kyi mgon po yin/ /sgos gangs ri'i mgul du rgyal srid skyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla na med pa'i brtul zhugs kyi bkod pa sna tshogs pas 'gro ba 'dul ba la mchog tu dpa' ba blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dpal bzang pos thugs bskyed rlabs po che'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i bka'i 'khor los khyab par mdzad pa las 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar nyung shas tsam las ma grub cing /de'i rjes su rgyal po khang / stag rtse'i tha'i ji/ rda'i ching la sogs pa rje bo rnams kyis 'phro mthud pa mdzad kyang mthar ma 'khyongs/ de dag gi skabs kyi byung ba'i lo rgyus rgyu song la sogs pa reg zig lag tu ma 'byor pas 'chad par ma spobs/ mi'i dbang po 'di nyid kyi ji ltar bzheng bar mdzad pa'i tshul ni gang gi gsung dri ma med pa nyid brjod na go bde zhing / tshig gi tshogs chung la dgos pa'i khur gyis lci bas de ltar brjod pa ni/ mi dbang nyid kyis bdag la stsal ba'i reg zig shog dril las/ de yang / cha sa spre zla 5tshes 27la nged rang gi dpung chen lha sar 'byor/ bstan 'gro'i don kho na dang srog thon pa tsam las/ rang rgyal gzhan pham gyi bsam pa med rung / bden rdzun dkar 186—167

nag gi dpang por mchog gsum slu ba med pa bzhugs gshis/ ma rungs pa'i skye bo lus med kyis yid brlams pa rnams ma tshang ba med par zhabs su chud/gong sa skyabs mgon mchog la'ang gus 'dud dang bkur bste ma nyams pas pho lha ba'i rigs brgyud gsal bar byas/ skabs der gong ma'i dpung chen sku tshab dang bcas bod du ma phebs/ snga 'byor dmag dpon so sor 'gong bskyod dbus rigs nas mi bden gra sgrigs kyi gleng brjod sna tshogs dang / dngos po'i bug sogs kun rgyab rdzun skyod kyi byed pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs la 'gran zhing /'phung byed ltos por bcas kun re ba'i gnas du ma zhig rta lam du rkyang rgyug rtsis 'dug rung / 'jam dbyangs sa los/ ha cang g.yo sgyu che drags na/ /re zhig 'grub kyang tha mar brlag /gzig lpags bkab ba'i bong bu de/ /lo tog zos mthar gzhan gyis bsad/ /ces pa'i lung don mngon du gyur cing / rang nyid kyi bsam sbyor rnyog pa rang bral ba zla ba ltar dkar po'i ngang tshul gnam skos gong ma chen po'i ye shes kyi gzigs ngor gsal bas/ bdag rkyen gzengs bstod bcas sku tshab a li am pa'i sku mdun phebs pas/ 'jig rten rgan po'i gtan tshigs mi smon rang skyid/ 'dus byas kyi dga' bde'i phul dang rtse mor son kyang / rang nyid rga ba'i rang nyams mngon du gyur cing / dmar nag las kyi 'bras bu nam yang chud mi za ba dang / sdig ltung gi las lam du ma zhig kyang spyad zin pa yin/ /khyad par dal 'byor snying po don dang ldan pa zhig byed dgos zhes chos bzhin gsung ba'i yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las thob cing /rgyal ba bden par gsung ba'i lung gis kyang grub pa bcas/ chos don nyamaso su len pa'i bskal bzang la yid rton pa bzhin/ gong ma'i sku tshab rnams su'ang 786—168

snyan zhu sogs ji snyed cig song rung / bod yul dbus kyi bya ba mtha' dag shes par gyis zhes bka' gnang gser gyi ri bo pang du lhungs pa gyen ldog ma thub par brten / phan bde'i bsam sbyor du ma zhig bdag gi skal bar thob pa las/ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas sam/ gzhi rten ni kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di kho na la rag lus te/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu / /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bsti dang / /bcas ste yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs so/ /de yang bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum la rag lus shing / de dag sgrub dang bzhed tshul bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig yod 'dug kyang / skyes mchog dam pa rnams kyi gsung la dgos pa khyad par can yod pa gzhir bcas pas/ rnam pa thams cad du phyag bya ba'i yul yin la/thams cad kyi phyi mo'am rtsa bar gyur pa rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di nyid la thug pas na gna' bo'i dus nas bzung / gser dngul sogs rin po che sna tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab brjod kyis mi lang rung 'phrul chen par gyi grub pa ni bod 'dir ma byung / rgyal mchog drug pa chen po'i thugs rje las sher phyogs gtsor gyur pu sti nyi shu rtsa brgyad skor bsod nams kyi skal bar (ma phyi mi bsal ) lo bdun tsam 'gor zhing gtsang khul yong sgo phal mo che phogs dang / zur gsos/ston mor thim skad dang / mi ser du'ang rkang 'gro lag 'don tshang ma ches rtsis spyi zhus dang / yon tshang ma phyag mdzod rang nas dngul rkyang dgos pas dpon 'bangs gnyis gas nang ma theg par 'phro can du lus/ de rjes rgyal po khang /106—169

rda'i ching sogs nas kyang thugs mos che rung grub pa zhig byung ma song / skabs der mi ser yang rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i mtshan sgras dmag 'khrug mnar spyod med (ma phyi mi gsal )dang / gzhung zhabs su stod dza tidabyug pas bsnun sa nas/smad dar mdo'i bar ma tshang ba med pa de dus kyang ma grub na/ da cha bya byed gang cir dka' nges su ma tshad/ mi ser kyang khral dmag gis mnar spyod bcas tshang mas go shes thog /nged rang la nye ltos drag pa'i ser skya kha shas nas bka' 'gyur par du brko mi tshang mar mi shis pa byung song bas mi 'gab tshul byung bas mtshon / 'di skor la brtsams kyang ma 'grub pa'i dogs gzhi dang gleng brjod ji snyed byung rung / ga re rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che 'di mthar phyin pa zhig byung na bdag gi srog 'gags kyang sla yi longs spyod mnga' thang thams cad song yang phangs pa dang 'gyod pa cha shas tsam yang med/ dka' ba ji tsam zhig thog tu babs kyang 'di mthar phyin par gyur cig snyam du jo shāka gi mtshon rten gsum rnams la mchod pa dang bkur bsti mang du bgyis te gsol ba btab bo/ /bstan pa dam pa'i chos skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i sung ma rnams la'ang /bskang ba bskul ba bcas/ re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i 'phrin las kyi gnyer gtad ༈ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che yang chad med du bklags par brtson/mdor na/ 'di'i ched du mtha' na rang srog kyang phangs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyis gzhi bzung / sngan chad kyi skyon yon thams cad rna bar lang gcig min par yang nas yang du nyan/ (ma phyi mi gas la )las byed kyang yin yin dang che che tsam min pa snga phyir drin gyis bskyangs pa'i rang g.yog lhag bsam can bskos/dngos por yang / gser dngul gos dar za ma la sogs lag tu yod tshad yod 706wa 170

sprugs su bskur/ der ma zad shel dkar rang gi sger chos sgrub pa mtha' dag gi rkang 'gro lag 'don yong 'bab yang bsdus nas khu ba sha thim yong ba'i bkod 'doms bcas las byed rnams kyi mgron du bkug cing / de yang bar skabs su mtha' dbus nges med kyi sde gzar mang bas/ par brkos kyi nyer mkho/ rdzong gi chas rigs sogs than sprin ltar song gshis/ par pa'i sdod gnas/ gdan gos / yol ba thab cha sogs dang / gnyer tshang gi dgos cha sogs gra 'grig dang / par brkos grub zin ji tsam yod/ yon sogs ji ltar song / da dgos ji ltar dgos bcas pa bzhig 'brel du dpon slob mnga' bdag pa btang bar / nyi shar du slebs nyin shel rdzong gsar rnying spor dpang bcas rta pa nyi shu skor rtsis sprod du yong ba dang 'grigs pas/ rta bsu rang babs su byung ba'ang rgyal gsung rin po che'i mthur mngon/ shel dkar rdzong du 'byor pa'ang zla ba drug pa'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa'i dus chen dang rang 'grig byung 'dug /mi ring bar don gtan la 'bebs pa'i yi ge yang yang du 'byor skabs rten 'brel gyi la nye shin tu bzang zhing / nub gcig rmi lam du/ rgyal srid dbang ba las kyi 'phen pa ste/ /thams cad chos la bskul zhing bde bas skyong / /de tsam rang dbang thob pa'i las byas te/ /da lta yid rab ma zhum spro ba soms/ /zhes pa'i tshig bcad kyang rmi lam du bud med zhig gis gleng ba sogs chabs gcig par dga' ba dang spro ba ches cher brtas/skabs der dbus gtsang so sor par pa tshang ma shel dkar du rdzong dgos pa'i yi ge btang / shel dkar rdzong du'ang jo rig thu kho shor che bar bskos dgos cha dang mnyam du 'byor gshis 'go ba gnyis mol bsdur bgyis/ legs pa'i 106—171

phyogs la rten 'brel zab mo bsgrigs/ /phun sum tshogs pa rang gis byas pas mchog /ces par blo 'don gtam gyi thog ma'i las gra'i rten 'brel sgo 'byed du/lcags khyi hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer bzhi'i nyin/ rgyal bur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor bzang po la/ shel dkar mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rdzong gi 'dabs rol par khang bden bzhi'i chos 'khor khang du 'go ba gnyis/ sdod dpon zung / shel dkar du yod pa'i par pa/ zhus dag pa shel chos grwa pa gnyis bcas/ zhus dag /gzhar gri/ shog sbyor/ brkos kyi dbu btsugs/ sdod gnas so sor gdan bshams shing / dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo dang shis brjod bcas byas / nam mkha' shin tu dngas shing nyi 'od kyang gsal ba mtha' skor 'ja' sprin dkar pos khor yug tu bres/ rlung dang bser bu ye med cing las byed rnams kyang dga' zhing spro nyams ches che/ de nyin ma sgrigs rang 'grig tu e nas yongs pa rnams rdzong mdun du slebs shing / rgyu mtshan 'bul mi yi ge mkhas dag thog mtha' bar 'khyongs lha mo dar rgyas 'byor/ sang nyin chos skyong rab brtan sogs yig mkhan bcu/ blo bzang kun thub sogs par pa nyer drug /yon bdag a khu sogs shog las pa lnga bcu bcas 'byor zhing / tshes nyer drug la rdzogs sprad/ de'i sang nyin par pa sogs la sa skya'i 'gag pa dbang po'i no bos zhabs tog byas thog /phun gling par snying gas sum cu skor logs lor 'byor zhes dbu mdzad bde legs bkra shis dang / spyi gnyer lcang shar lhun grub bcas 'byor pa'ang ming gi rten 'brel lhag par 'grig cing las shogs kyang che nges su byung / 'on kyang las gra pu ti'i grangs kyang ches mang zhing / re rer kyang par shing lnga brgya tsam dgos pa dang / las byed brgya phrag tu 'ang longs 106—172

par brten snga sor gyi babs yul ltar na/ lo grangs nyi shu'i khong du'ang 'grub regs min 'dug ces dpon slob 'byor par brten/ spyir sa phyogs kun tu bde ba'i skabs mi rnyed cing khral dmag bar ma chad kyi sdug bsngal myong dgos la sems gcong dang blo 'khol bzod du ma mchis kyang / 'khor chos ldog tu med gshis rnam dkar du bsgyur thub pa zhig nyin mtshan khor yug tu sems pas par pa stong du nye ba zhig gsar slob brtsams pa na yi ge'i sbyang ba sngon du song khyad e snye so so nas nyis brgya re rdzong bkod/ de mtshungs mdzad med par gyi legs byas bod yul du khyab pa zhig byung na bsam lhag bsam rma med pas dbus gtsang dwags kong dang bcas pa'i rdzong sgo che chung la sbyar ba'i mi grangs skabs thob par slob tu bcug /mthun rkyen thams cad gzhung rang nas sbyar te shel dkar du btang / gsar slob rigs kyang ring por ma thogs par shes shing las grar tshud pas sngar gyi slob rgyun dang bslab lugs la nem nur du gyur/ las grar tshud pa nas gzhan bskul la ma ltos par/ dad brtson g.yel ba med pas rnam g.yeng du skad cig kyang ma gyur te/ dper na rang gi khams gseng sogs su 'gro skabs kyang shar mar 'gro ba ma gtogs lab gleng kyang mi byed/ las byed mkhas mgyogs phal cher gyis ni/ gung tshigs kyang dgongs mo las byed mtshams gshol nas za ba dang / nyin mo sha phran bu re mdun du bzhag nas za ba dang brko ba spel ba sogs so skye'i ngang tshul las 'gongs pas na/ don dam par sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rnams so so'i bstan pa spel slad dang bdag gi bsod nams kyi mgron du shel ri dkar po'i mdun du phebs pa gor ma chag 'on kyang tshur mthong thun mong gi snang ngor gsar slob mtha' dag la/ smyug lcag /'gram 186—173

lcag sbu khag ha gad/ spyo ba sogs las gnag chos su bkar ba'i rnam 'gyur med mod/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter mdzod las/ mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug /bde bar sdod la mkhas ma yin/ /bde ba chung la chags pa na/ /chen po'i bde ba thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes ma gsungs sam/ nges pa'i don tu 'phags pa 'ba' zhig bzo'i ra bar zhugs pa'i rtags su las byed tshang ma rang rang gis las kyi bgo skal dad brtson gyi shugs ches che ba gzhan rkyen gyis bzlog tu med pa bskal chen gyi me lta bu/ rgyun chad med pa mgal me'i 'khor lo bskor ba lta bu/ skyo dub med pa zhing pa so nam byed pa lta bus dpyod ldan mtha' dag dgyes pa bskyed pa ma gtogs/ phan tshun 'khon 'dzin dang phyogs lhung gi rnam 'gyur dang rtsod tshig sogs zur tsam yang mi mdzad pa sogs brjod kyis mi lang / gzhan yang lcags khyi lo 'dir 'tshub 'gyur gyi bsam brjod mang zhing dgun thog yul bshis shin tu ngan pa zhig sa phyogs kun tu byung song rung / dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /zhes pa ltar spyir dus bde zhol 'jags dang / sgos shel dkar khul nam mkha' 'jam zhing sa yul kyang shin tu dro ba byung 'dug /phyogs kyi las sgo skyid grong / gnya' nang / rong shar/ mkhar rta / gzar/ phag ri/ lha khang bcas nas par shing bzhi stong lnga brgya re bton par rong rigs 'khos nus gang yang med pa'i ri dwags lta bu yin 'dug kyang ༈ kla klo'i rang bzhin mi khom pa'i yul du gyur pa rnams la dge sdig gi blang dor ni mi shes// dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan ni ma thos rkang bzhi bas kyang snying rje bas/ sgyu lus la brten nas yu/na tu phan res bskul 'debs rus thon 106 —174

pa byas shing / sne mo ba byings nas bkod 'doms gang cir lto chud mi za ba'i las rjes ngo thon byung mod/ shel la tshon gyis kha bsgyur kyang / /chu dang phrad na rang mdog ston/ /zhes pa'i don la mngon par bstod pa ni phag rdzong 'brong skyid dang lha khang ri shod pa sogs su zad do/ /lam thogs mi ser yas mas su'ang bsun khag yod pa gzhir bcas/ 'on kyang kha drag gi bla dpon/ rang don gyi rtsod pa/ shed spyod kyi hor 'dra sogs don med zin med kyi ngos nyin mtshan khor yug tu skyel dgos kyi tshul la bsams na/ rgyal ba'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis/ rang sdug gzhan sdug 'dir sdug phyi mar sdug /dgra bo 'dul la nges pa brtson byed na/ /rang bde gzhan bde 'dir bde phyi mar bde/ /dam pa'i chos la kun tu 'bad par rigs/ /zhes pa ltar 'di phyi'i phan bde'i 'byung khungs su bsam pa'i hur bskyed dang / nged du'ang bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i dga' mgu dang / byas shes drin du bzo dgos pa mngon sum du grub mod go shes nyin skar tsam du mngon/ rang nyid nas 'dir brten lus ngag yid gsum gyi 'brel thogs tshang ma chabs gcig tu rdzogs byang tshom bu gcig tu thob pa dang / thob nas kyang dag zhing gcig tu 'gro don lhun grub tu bgyid par snying thag pa nas smon cing / de don ji bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyas 'debs skyabs 'jug kyang ris med skyes chen rnams la yang yang gsol ba btab cing slad nas kyang 'debs rgyu/ dngos po yang de gong shel khul yong sgo tshang ma'i steng du gtsang khul phal mo che spungs par gzhibs na shel khul nas/'dengs min mdang skyes kyi bus pas kyang shes mod/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje las dngos po rnams 'dod dgu'i gter chen por grub pas/186—175

rtsam nas/ sha mar/ 'bru spus/ gser dngul rta nor/ gos dar sogs gang la'ang spyad bzhin du da dung yang ches cher 'phel bas byed bde byung zer/lar nas dngos rigs gang la'ang chags zhen dang dga' tshor gyi rigs cher med cing / de yang mchod sbyin la da lta gtong snyam pa las/ 'di dgos/ 'di phangs / 'di 'jog snyam ba'i 'dun pa gtan mi yong gshis dngos po 'phral dag tu 'gro ba las ma mchis rung / dgos gal tsha skabs gang yang 'bad rtsol la ltos mi dgos par 'grub pa mthong chos su grub pas/ sngon bsags sbyin pa'i las la gus pa mi lhod par gyur/ par pa sogs rig byed pa stong du nye ba dang /lag g.yog kyang brgya skor tshogs pa bcas/ mi tshogs shin tu che rung so so'i gzhi nad lta bus dus las yol ba re gnyis byung 'dug rung / cham pa tsam las 'go nad kyi rigs gtan ma byung / 'go pa las byed zhal ngo ju rig tu kho shor che yang g.yog gi 'gor song ba dang skye bo phal mo che rang rgyal gzhan pham 'ba' zhig la goms pas na/ phyi nang gi dmag 'khrug zam mi chad pas rang srog thon dka' gshis / lus khams gcong gis zin ches lnga langs bcu nyal kho nas khams lus mi bde ba'i mu yin rung / re ltos snying nas bgyis pa mtha' dag 'phral yun phan bde la sbyor ba zhig nged rang gi dam bca' gtso bo yin pa bzhin/ sdig ltung gi khur ches che ba blos ma bzod pa'i sbyong thabs su/ rnam dkar 'di'i byed por bskos pa'ang rang bzhin gyi khams bde ngos las/ zhag gcig kyang las gshol ma dgos par mthar phyin pa'ang ngo mtshar ba'i gnas su mngon/ snga sor las gra chen po tshugs nas lo bdun song 'dug rung ston mo zhu mi ngam rings chos sde / ru thog rgyal po gnyis las drag zhan sus kyang zhus skad mi 'dug rung /106—176

da lam bkra shis lhun po rang nas kyang ston mo thengs gnyis/ gzhan yang sa skya sogs zla med kyi bla chen/ shel chos/ rdzong kha 'phel gling / gnya' nang 'phel gling / gze mkhar chos sde sogs chos sde khag /spong rong sgang chen pa/sde ma lung pa/ gling nub pa/ shel rdzong rmu phu ba/ 'go pa mnga' bdag pa/yar 'brog /chu bzang sprul sku/ lha shing chos sbug sogs nas kyang mang ja sogs ches mang / lag rjes kyang sngon dus zla ba rer par shing lnga drug byung ba tshad bral/ bzhi gsum 'bring / gnyis gcig phal che ba yang thas re re yang ma phul ba yod skad la/ 'di lo yang rtse gras mi grangs lnga drug gis zla ba rer par shing nyer gsum nas bcu drug bar/ 'bring gras bzhi bcu skor nas bco lnga nas bcu'i bar/ 'bring smad brgya skor gyis bcu bzhi nas brgyad kyi bar/byings ches bdun nas lnga'i bar chag med/ ti thug res nas kyang gsum la nyung mtha' / na ba re gnyis nas srid mtha' ma bkag cing / mgyogs dar legs cha rang gi thog tu 'ang dngul bal ṭaṃ la bskor ba'i dngos po song bas mtshon/byas byung lag rjes yod rigs la gzengs bstod dang bya dga' phangs med/phyag rgya lto len gyi rigs la/ rang rang gi lag rjes la sbyar ba'i dma' 'bebs skabs thob rtsag bu rnag 'gel byed pa la gzhan rkyen gyi bcos bslad/ kha drag zhan / gdong skya snum sogs kyi dbang du spu tsam yang mi gtong ba gtsang rtags 'gog pa med pa'i rang gzugs su mthong / zhal 'debs kyi rigs kyang che phra tshang ma dngos po spams mtho min la ma ltos par yi ger bkod nas skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan dang / 'byor ldan bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa zhes kha skad skam po gtam du ma lus pa byas/ zhes gsung pa don la gnas shing 106—177

'khrul ba dang bral ba yin no/ /'di lta bu'i mdzad bzang rlabs chen gyi bya ba la zhugs pa'i bzo bo yang / sambu ṭa las/ dul zhing dad ldan lang tshor 'bab/ /dbang po rnam gsal rnam rtog med/ /khro med lkog 'phyas mi byed cing / /shing tu mkhas la spro ba che/ /bzod ldan snying rje chen po can/ /zhes pa dang / sdom 'byung las/ dul zhing bzo rnams kun shes la/ /cho ga mthong zhing mnyam gzhag pa/ /zhes pa dang / smra ba'i seng ge stag tshang lo tsā bas/ 'dod pa chung zhing bkur bsti sla/ /mkhas shing khengs med mkhas la nyan/ /bzo la gzob cing rkyen ngan bzod/ /lha la gus shing spyod legs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yon tan rnams yongs su rdzogs pa dang / khyad par du 'bad rtsol chen pos ched du bskul mi dgos par las la ngang gis 'jug pa sogs dam pa'i ngang tshul can sha stag gis bsgrubs/ dus 'khor 'grel chen gyi mdor bsdus bzhi pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa 'phags pa'i yul 'dir bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das par gyur pa na/ sdud par byed pa po dag gis theg pa gsum glegs bam la bris te de bzhin gshegs pa'i nges pa'i sde snod gsum ma ga dha'i skad kyis bris so/ /mdo sde ni sint+ra'i skad kyis so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul dang sngags kyi tshul ni legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis so/ /rgyud dang rgyud gzhan dag ni legs par sbyar ba'i skad dang tha mal pa'i skad dang / zur chag gi skad dang / legs par sbyar ba ma yin par ri khrod pa la sogs pa kla klo'i skad kyis te/ de lta bu la sogs pa thams cad mkhyen pas bstan pa'i chos rnams sdud par byed pa po dag gis bris so / /de bzhin du bod kyi yul du theg pa gsum bod kyi skad kyis bris te/ rgya 186 —178

nag tu rgya nag gi skad kyis so/ /rgya nag chen por rgya nag chen po'i skad kyis so//par si ku'i yul du par si ku'i skad kyis so/ /chu bo si ta'i byang du tsam pa ga'i yul gyi skad dang / spre'u'i yul gyi skad dang / gser zhes bya ba'i yul gyi skad kyis so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bod kyi yul 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rnams bod kyi skad dang yi ger bri bar 'os shing / de yang thun mi sasto ṭas bod yig srol btod nas bstan bcos chen po brgyad mdzad/ chos blon chen po de'i yig rgyun khyung po g.yu khri dang / sum pa gnod sbyin sogs kyis dar rgyas su mdzad / de la gzab chen dang / gzab chung / 'bru chen dang / 'bru chung /'bru chen la li lugs/ ldan lugs/ shar ma/ dkyus yig /'bru tsha/sgong zhabs ma/ phyis brtsams kyi yi ge'i rigs sna tshogs bcas rnam grangs mtha' yas pa las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab chen po dag la gzab che chung / rgya gar mkhas pa'i gzhung 'grel rnams la 'bru chen/ bod gzhung rnams la 'bru chung 'dri ba'i tshul dar ba bzhin/ gzab chen rnam par dag pa'i lugs su bgyis te gzhan du lo grangs kyi tshogs shin tu lci bar sgrub dgos pa dus kyi thung ba shin tu myur ba 'di la rten 'brel gyi 'grig sgo phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te legs par grub/ lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga la sogs pa mtha' rgyas su mdzad de ye shes rdo rje nus ldan du bsgrub/ bstan 'gro thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi sman yon gcig tu gyur pa 'di'o/ /de yang gong du bshad pa bzhin 'jig rten thams cad kyi bde skyid rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la rag lus shing de nyid yun du gnas pa la/ lung gi chos dkon mchog rnams 'jig rten du bzhugs dgos shing / deng sang gi dus su bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa thams cad 186 —179

kyi 'byung gnas gcig tu gyur pa ni gangs ri'i sman ljongs 'di nyid las gzhan pa 'dzam bu'i gling du ma mchis/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir gsung par rin po che 'di nyid gsar du phebs pa la brten nas/ gsung rab rin po che'i bang mdzod mdzad pa med pa'i chos sbyin gyi sgo 'byed par 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas/de'i phyir 'di la brten nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mang po'i 'khor 'das kyi legs tshogs thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pas srid pa gsum po thams cad kyi rgyan gcig pur gyur pa de'i phyir de skad ces bya'o/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir chos rgyal gong ma sus kyang ma 'grub pa mi dbang 'di nyid kyis/ lo phyed gnyis kyi khongs su legs par grub cing 'di'i 'phrul gsang la brten nas/ yi ge'i ris su bzheng ba gzhan dag ltar dus ring por bsgrub par dka' ba/ yun ring po'i tshegs la mi ltos par/ gsung rab rin po che'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur ba'i dngos grub 'dren par byed pas na/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shing rta lta bu ste de skad ces bya'o/ /de'i phyir srid gsum rgyan gcig rdzu 'phrul shing rta 'di nyid bstan pa'i bdag po shākya'i rgyal po nyid slar yang gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'gro ba'i don la dngos su gshegs pa dang chos mtshungs te/ dgra bcom pa chos kyi tshong dpon gyis 'dul ba la bstod pa las/ rgyal ba ston pa de yi bstan bcos ni / /mdo dang chos mngon yin gsungs 'dul ba ni/ /ston dang bstan pa dngos yin de yi phyir/ /gnyis gyur phyag bya'i sangs rgyas chos gcig yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mtshungs shing rgyal ba dngos su bzhugs kyang blang dor ston pa lung gi chos dkon mchog pa ltos pa dang / 'phrin las gtso bo yang gsung gi 'phrin las yin pa'i phyir ro//186—180

gnyis pa rgyu song gi rab byed brjod pa la/ gsung par rin po che par yig dang bcas pa'i rgyu song gi rnam bzhag 'chad pa dang / bzo ba rnams rnyed bkur gyis ji ltar mchod pa'i tshul bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang la brko ba'i gzhi par shing phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de yang mang yul skyid grong /gnya' nang / rong shar/ mkhar rta/ gting skyes/ phag ri/ lho brag lha khang sogs 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas las sgo bdun nas drangs pa'i stag spang /lu gas/ 'chus rul sogs ma yin pa'i legs pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa rnams shing bzo dbu mdzad/ par pa'i 'go pa bcas nas ldom pa'i yang tig par brkos rgyur 'os spang lebs ngo grangs nyi khri bdun stong bzhi brgya sum cu so drug dang / par shing gi logs rer par shog re sbyar dgos par bkar rgya nas bton pa'i spang dkar rnying pa spus legs re dang / phag shog legs pa gre kha re lto sbyar ba'i shog bu gas chog ma chig khri brgyad stong nyis brgya go gcig la rer dpe shog gsum re thon pas 'grig cing / der ma zad de dag la'ang smar zhus/skyar zhus/ yang tig gzigs 'bebs bcas tshar bzhi re med thabs med par gang du phag shog lto sbyar la/ kha shog spang dkar gnyis sbyar bcas bzhi sbyor gras chog ma bre kha gsum khri drug stong lnga brgya gya gnyis dang / sngon du brkos grub ci rigs la'ang tshang min sna tshogs kyi kha skong la rgyu 'gro gong ltar phag shog dang spang dkar gsar thon spus 'bring bzhi sbyar dang / slob shog gras chog ma sbyor kha med pa bcas/ yang tig bzhi stong sum brgya bdun snag tsha par bzhengs la dgos nges gang yin khyon bsdoms par sgron dreg ru'i khal bzhi bcu zhe gcig /shog sbyar gang yin gyi rgyur gro zhib rtsags ma ru'i khal sum brgya dang bcu tham pa 106—181

bre bcu bcas song zhing / rgyu 'gro bka' 'gyur byings las che tsam song rung gro spus shin tu mi dag par ma zad gzhan 'dres kyang ci rigs pa'i skyon du go/shog sbyor dang bka' 'gyur tshar bzhi bcas kyi snag tsha'i gogs/ 'dzugs rgyag /gas bsdoms sogs (ma phyi mi gsal )dgos gang yin phyogs gcig tu bsgril bar/mkhar rgya'i 'dregs khal nyis brgya nyi shu tham pa dang / nyag bcu bzhi sgor phyed gsum / snum gyis par shing 'dul sbyong dgos par shing sra snyi dang nyi ma grang dro'i dbang gis 'gro che chung sna tshogs las mtha' gcig du ma nges kyang lag yod dgos nges gang yin/ mig bstar gyis btang ba 'bring por cha bzhag par shing rer snum phul do re'i rtsis khyon bsdoms/ snum ru'i khal bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu nga bdun dang bre lnga phul do/ rjes sor so sos rtsol sgrub khur len byas gshes lcags sprod ma dgos kyang / thog mar par pa so sor lag cha tshang 'grig re btang ba'i lcags la bal lcags 'dregs khal lnga dang nyag brgyad sgor do/mkhar rta'i lcags rdzog 'degs khal bco brgyad nyag bzhi spor gsum/ lcags bzo ba 'od gsal la sol ba snga phyir btang ba phyogs gcig tu bsdoms par sdud rgya'i rgya ma bdun brgya dang bcu/ yig mkhan/ par brkos/ 'dzug pa bcas la lag cha (ma phyi mi bsal )'jam rdar 'ol khog spus legs che chung sna tshogs bzhi brgya dang brgyad/ rtsub rdar shin tu rno ba la stod byang nas thon pa ngo grangs dgu bcu go bdun/ gzhan yang rgyal gsung rin po che 'di nyid sgrub par byed pa la phyi nang 'gal rkyen gyi rigs su gtogs pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing / mthun rkyen bzhed pa'i don mtha' dag 'bad med du 'grub pa'i ched du dmigs te/shel dkar chos sder bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar bzhi dang gzungs bsdus brgya 111—182

rtsa gcig gi gsung sgrog /mngon dga'i chos sde dang gzi mkhar par sher snying bdud bzlog dang bcas pa 'bum ther tshar bzhi/ bla ma rab zhi dpon slob gsum gyis ma mo'i mdos dang / nad bdag stobs 'joms zhag bdun/ de mtshungs chos sde nas dge slong bzhis gsung sgrog /yang dge slong bzhi gras rnam 'joms kyi yum (ma phyi mi gsal )gsum/ bon g.yung drung gling pas yul lhar bsangs mchod zla rer zhag bcu re byas pa bcas la dngos po gang song yul thang ltar bur bkug par mkhar khal nyis stong zhe brgyad bre bcu drug phul gsum (ma phyi mi gsal )la rgyu song khyon gcig tu bsdoms gshor 'bo mkhar nyag gi gro zhib rtsags ma khal bzhi brgya dang drug cu re lnga bre bco lnga/ snum khal drug brgya dang brgyad cu gya lnga bre bco brgyad/ sgron dreg khal drug cu re gcig dang bre bcu/ spyin 'degs khal nyis brgya dang nyi shu tham pa nyag bcu bzhi spor phyed gsum/ bal lcags 'degs khal lnga dang nyag brgyad spor do/ lcags rdzog 'degs khal bco brgyad dang nyag bzhi spor gsum/ sol ba 'degs khal bzhi stong brgyad brgya dgu bcu go dgu/ stag spang ngo nyi khri bdun stong bzhi brgya sum cu so drug /shog bu nyis sbyar gras chog bre kha tshig khri brgyad stong nyis brgya dgu bcu go gcig /bzhi sbyar gas chog bre kha bzhi khri brgyad brgya brgyad cu gya dgu/ 'jam rdar 'ol khog spus legs che chung ci ris ngo bzhi brgya dang brgyad/ rtsub rdar ngo dgu bcu go bdun/gegs sel sku rim du song ba nas khal sum stong dang bdun cu don gsum bre lnga rnams la ri gong yul thang ltar rtsis pa bsdoms dngul rdo tshad brgya dang nyi shu tham pa srang nyi shu rtsa lnga zho drug skar dgu la srang rer gshor khal nyi shu re rtsis pa 'bum phrag gcig dang / khri tsho gnyis lnga brgya dang bcu gsum bre bcu drug rnams thob 106—183

pa lags//gnyis pa bzo bo rnyed bkur gyis mchod tshul bshad pa la sogs yon ji ltar stab pa'i tshul dang / mgyogs dar la sogs pa bya dga'i sgo nas tshim par bgyis pa'i tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ gang gis brko bar byed pa'i gang zag phun sum tshogs pa ste/ de yang las gra 'dir med du mi rung ba'i 'go pa/shing bzo/ shog las/ yig mkhan/ zhus dag pa/ mgar ba/ par pa rnams kyi mtshan dang phogs yon go rim bzhin bkod pa la/ par brko 'go pa dpon slob sku mched gnyis dang jo rig thu kho shor che/ spyir g.yog bcu gcig bzhon khal bcu bzhi bcas kyi lcags khyi zla brgyad pa'i nyer drug gi gza' skar legs pa'i nyin las gra tshugs pa nas phogs mtshams bzung / chu byi zla ba dang po'i nyer drug gi bar la shol zla gcig dang bcas las rgyun lo gcig zla ba drug song bar/ ngo bor zla rdzogs bar zhib khal lnga re/ tshwa snum so so nas bre do re/'o rin nas bre lnga/ bzang ja nyag lnga/ mar nyag bco lnga/ rgyar lug khog gsum / skam thal 'debs nyag do spor gang / phyur ba bre gang phul phyed do/g.yog bcu gcig so sor rtsam khal bzhi re/ chang nas khal gcig bre bcu re/tshwa bre re rdor yug 'go re/ rgyar chung bzhi gling / sha shan spor gsum/ mar nyag gang spor do/ shag snum spyir bre do phul gsum re/ gtong mtshams nas bzung ngo bo'i zhon rtar chu chag so so nas bre re/ de phyin zhon khal rer chu rtsam bre re dang thob rtsis gzhi ltar/ dmar zhus/ skyar zhus/ yang tig /gzigs 'bebs 'khyil bde bcas kyi glegs shing bzo mi rgyun sdod star chags dang / glo bur ba bcas mtha' gcig du ma nges kyang / yang tig song yod 186—184

dbu mdzad mtshar grong pa pha bu/ e dpon tshang / snyan dar rgyas/ snye mo padma tshe ring / tshe 'dzin/ dgra sta/ thon rab brtan/ zhu rab brtan/ dpon chung / e mgon po/ sum dga'/ mchim chos dar/ mi pham/ g.yang khang pa/ o rgyan lhun grub/ mthong smon pa'i g.yog /sa la dbang rgyal/mgon po/ ste sa rab brtan/ blo bzang rgyan mtshan/ dge legs/ grags bzang / gnod sbyin tshe ring / lha mo tshe ring / o rgyan tshe ring / byams pa phun tshogs/ shar rtogs phun tshogs/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ nam mkha' dar rgyas / nas lung dpal 'byor/ lha mo mgon/ bkras 'dzom rgyal/ g.yang khang pa/ phur pa/ nor bu/ bsod nams/ sos snga shing bzo ba/ smad shang dbang rgyal rnams kyis dbu mdzad mtshar grong pas lo gcig dang / byings kyis las rgyun khyon bsdoms mi gcig gis lo zlar brkyang lo bcu drug zla ba gnyis/khag nyi shu rtsa lnga song bar/ dbu mdzad la zla phogs rtsam shor khal bzhi/ chang nas khal gcig bre bcu/ rgyar chung khog /khog gcig dod spus/ spre tshwa phul phyed / nyin gla shor bre bcu / byings la zla phogs rtsam shor khal bzhi/ chang nas khal gcig bre bcu/ rgyar chung khog la bzang ngan byed khyer/ sha phyed dod la spus/ spre tshwa phul byed/ nyin gla bre bzhi phul phyed bzhi bzhi cha re thob cing /shog bur sbyor brdungs/ gas ur/ thig 'debs sogs shog las byed mi yon bdag a khu/ rdo rje/ bzhi dga'/ rgyal mtshan/ snye mo dbang 'dus/ lha mo tshe ring / dgos tshings rnams kyis las rgyun bsdoms mi gcig gis lo zlar brkyang lo drug zla ba gnyis zhag bco brgyad song bar/ zla phogs rtsam shor khal bzhi / chang nas khal gcig bre bcu/ rgyar chung khog /khog gcig la spus/186—185 ri

spre tshwa phul phyed/ nyin gla dbu mdzad la bre brgyad dang byings la bre gsum phul do rnams song zhing / yig mkhan la ji skad du/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i don ni ma rtogs na/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don dam rtogs par byed pa'i thabs sam lam gyi 'jug sgo phul du byung bar grags shing grub pa ni yi ge'i sbyor ba 'di nyid yin te/ de ltar yang 'jam dbyangs thu mis/ bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing / /rig byed smra ba rnams kyi rgyu/ /ming tshig brjod pa kun gyi gzhi / /yi ge'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /zhes so/ /de la'ang don dang rtags gnyis las phyi ma rtags kyi gnas la sbyangs shing / mkhas pa'i rtsen son mang du 'dus pa'i dbu mdzad bstan 'dzin bag gro/ chos skyong rab brtan/ lha sbyin rdo rje/ nor bu dar rgyas/ tshe rings bag gro/ lha mo dar rgyas/ bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ dngos grub tshe ring / nor bu chos mdzad/ tshe ring bstan pa/ lha mo mthar phyin/ bsod nams phun tshogs/ khrom steng bag gro/a bar nor bu/ sri thar/ mer don grub/ tshe brtan/ chos bsam grub/snye mo bkra shis dbang phyug /bsod nams lhun grub/ rgya mtsho/ lha skyabs/dpal 'byor bzang po/ dbang rgyal/ bsod nams rgyan mtshan/ tshe brtan rnam rgyal/ blo bzang tshe brtan/ kham pa/ bsam pa/ padma/ tshe ring nor sgrub / dpal 'byor/ g.yang dar/ dbang 'dus/ lha sbyin/ tshe dbang don grub/ don grub/ bstan 'dzin rgyal po/ em chi/ tshe ring rdo rje rnams kyi las rgyun khyon bsdoms mi gcig gis lo zlar brkyangs lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ zla ba gnyis zhag nyi shu rtsa brgyad song bar zla rdzogs rtsam shor khal lnga/ chang nas khal 106—186

gcig bre bcu/ rgyar ngo sprod chung khog/ khog/ gcig dod spus/ spre tshwa phul phyed / yon shog bu drug rer shor bre bcu re'i rtsis/ par yig gang yin par shing la ma sbyar gong du zhus dag nan tan ma byung na rjes kyi bya ba thams cad kyang sgros mi gtsang du 'gyur gshis/ zhus dag tshar gnyis re dgos pa dang brkos zin la'ang zhus dag tshar gsum dgos pa bcas/ rab 'byams pa skal ldan rgya mtsho dang dge 'dun rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams grags pa dngos grub/ rje drung grags pa bstan srung rnams gtan sdod dang / par zhus sogs la glo bur du 'thogs skabs/ rab 'byams bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ rab 'byams blo bzang tshul khrims/ rab 'byams blo bzang shes rab/ rab 'byams grags pa rgya mtsho/ bka' bcu blo bzang ngag dbang / rab 'byams dge 'dun dar rgyas / rab 'byams ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rab 'byams grags pa phrin las/em chi/ tshe ring rdo rje/ byis pa'i btsun pa/ lhun grub rnams kyis las rgyun sna tshogs bsdoms mi gcig gis lo dgu/ zla ba brgyad/ zhag nyer gnyis song bar zla phogs rtsam shor khal lnga/ rgyar chung khog /khog gcig la spus/ spre tshwa phul phyed/ nyin yon shor bre bcu/ par brkos lag cha bzhar gri/ mig zong /spo zong / gseg gcod che chung gnyis/ 'dzugs zong rnam grangs lnga/ btsab sta / gzhogs sog bcas bzo mir mgar ba gtan sdod re dang / skabs su 'phar ba bcas la/ lho mdzes rdor legs/ rtsa skor tshe ring / rdo rje bzhi dar/lnga ma/ rgyal mtshan/ dbus pa/ mthu stobs/ sngon dpe dar rgyas/ rnam tshe / gram tsho dar rgyas/ khyi lod/ dar rgyas/ kun dga' bzhi dar/mgon po khyi phrug /o rgyan rdo rje/ mgon po tshe ring / byams pa rnams kyis 186—187

las rgyun khyon bsdoms/ mi gcig gis lo gnyis zla ba gcig zhag gnyis bcas song ba'i zla phogs rtsam shor khal bzhi/ chang nas khal gcig bre bcu/ rgyar chung khog la bzang ngan phyed khyer/ spre tshwa phul phyed/ gla thob nyin rer bre drug phul bzhi rtsis pa rnams/ rig byed par gyi mchod sbyin mi zad pa'i gter brgya lhun par 'grol ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo par brkos pa/ bi shwa kurma'i spun zla shel ri dkar po'i mdun du dus gcig tu 'dzom par/ bzo rig rgya mtsho'i 'byung khungs e chos lung dkar po nas 'byor ba par rnying gi gras/ dbu mdzad blo bzang kun thub/ dbu chung brgya byin/ rta mgrin/ bsam grub/ padma bstan 'dzin/ sum 'dzom/ blo bzang / rgya mon dar rgyas/ slob dpon nor bu/ dgos skyes sri thar/ chos dbang bsam grub/ gsum dga'/ tshe dbang / stod sri thar/ bsod nams dbang phyug /klu btsan/ mdo dngos grub / o rgyan rdo rje/ bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin/ dgos dgos bstan 'dzin/ kun bzang / tshe brtan/ klu byin bzhon pa/ bzhi dga' / g.yang 'dzin/ tshe ring don grub/ bu mo sri chod/ rgya dpon blo bzang / bsam grub/ chos 'phel/ tshe dbang / rnam rgyal/ lha mgon/bkra shis dar rgyas/ gnyis dga'/ ser gnyis dga'/ smin drug /chos dbang bsam grub/ stod bzhi dga'/ sri thar dgos pa/ spun drug /tshe 'phel / sri thar dgos skyes/ dpon bstan 'dzin/ sprul sku dar rgyas/ a drug /blo bzang mkhas btsun/ bkra shis phun tshogs/ phyag rdor/ blo bzang rgyal po/ chos skyong nor bu/ snyan klu byin/ lha mgon don grub/ ngag dbang rnams dang / yi ge'i 'du byed la mngon par byang chub kyang par gyi 'du 186—188

byed shel dkar rang du byas shing mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob pa e pa'i gras/bstan skyid dngos grub/ dpal ldan/ sprul sku rta mgrin/ mdo chen phyag rdor/dngos grub nor bu/ nor bu dar rgyas/ zhi ba klu rgyal/ bag gro/ lha mo dar rgyas / bstan 'dzin/ bsod nams/ sri thar/ g.yang 'phel/ zhing skyong lha rgyal/ chos yang 'phel/ blo bzang dkon mchog /mkhar rgya sri thar/bsod nams tshe rings/ zhi ba tshe rings/ dgos dgos phun tshogs/ gong stod o rgyan/ dngos grub tshe rings/ sum dga'/ zhi ba phun tshogs/ gong stod tshe brtan/ zhi ba bstan 'dzin/ bsam grub/ a bar bkra shis/bsod nams chos 'phel/ dgos skyes/ bsod nams rab brtan/ bsod nams chos skyong / tshe brtan/ bsam grub tshe rings/ bsod nams don grub/bkra shis don grub/ 'jam dbyangs/ tshe rings bstan pa/ lha mgon bsam grub / lnga 'dzom/ phun tshogs/ chos sri thar/ zhi ba nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin tshe ring / zhi ba sri thar/ a bar tshe brtan/ bsod nams bag gro/ bu mo lha mgon / a par dgos dgos/ zhi ba bu/ lo rgyal/ lha mo sri thar/ don grub hor rgyal/ lha mgon/ bsod nams phun tshogs/ zhi ba bkra shis/dkon mchog /zhi ba bstan 'dzin/ zhi ba rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams dbang po / chos nyid/ drug 'dzom/ sa sngon bzhi 'dzom/ rgya mon bag gro/ sri thar tshe rings/ phru bzhi bzhi 'dzom/ rtsa ri/ ze dkar don grub/ a bar tshe rings/ phrin las rab brtan/ 'jam dbyangs kun thub/ bsod nams phun tshogs/ rgya mon rdo rje/ nor bu lha dar/ rdo rje/ tshe ring bsam grub/dgos skyes/ rgya mon dbang phyug/ zhi ba tshe rings/ bsod nams bag gro/106—189

bstan 'dzin/ rgyal bsam pa/ dbang po/ zhi ba bag gro/ dngos grub tshe rings / ser dbang po/ rnam rgyal/ tshe rings phun tshogs/ zhor tu 'brel sna tshogs/ nor bu don 'grub/ zhi ba sri thar/ rmer zhi ba bkra shis/ nor bu / bsam 'grub tshe dar/ bsod nams dbang po/ tshe rings bsam 'grub/bsod nams dpal 'byor/ tshe dbang / zhi ba phyag rdor/ blo bzang dngos grub / rgyal bur/ zhi ba tshe ring / bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ rgya mon zhi ba / mthar phyin 'gyur med/ rgyal bkras/ dpal 'bar/ bsod nams dgos pa/ lnga 'dzom/ phun tshogs/ dgos bsam/ lha 'phel/ gnyis yags rgan pa/ rgya mon dar rgyas/ bsod nams nor bu/ rgya mon tshe rings/zhi ba dar rgyas/ rtsa ri/ nor bu dar rgyas/ gnyis yags/ a khu tshe bi me/sum 'dzom/ bkra shes don grub/ zhi ba dngos grub/ tshe brtan rdo rje/mgon po bstan 'dzin/ zhi ba sri thar/ sgo zhi ba/ chos 'dzom/ bzhi dga'/dmag zhi ba/ bu mo lha dar/ smyon pa/ chos 'phel/ a mi dgos skyes/ lha mgon bsod nams/ bsam grub/ zhi ba lha mgon/ dgos pa don grub/lha mgon tshe dbang / bsod nams tshe rings/ gong lha skyabs/ 'dzom phrug /nyi zla a bar/ lnga yags/ legs pa/ zhi ba lha mgon/ khri phrug sri thar/rta mgrin bsam grub/ padma/ zhi ba bstan 'dzin/ rgyal bzang bsam grub/dgos dgos bstan 'dzin/ 'jam dpal/ bsod nams dngos grub/ zhi ba dgos dgos/ zhi ba lhun grub/ blo bzang mtshon grol/ lha mgon tshe rings / u rgyan tshe brtan/ zhi ba dgra 'dul/ rdo rje/ bsod nams rab brtan / don grub/ bsam grub tshe rings/ chos skyong dar rgyas/ dgos 786—190

phun tshogs/ bzhi nor/ bsod nams phun tshogs/ nor dbang / bkra shis / bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ tshe ring dbang 'dus/ zhi ba dgos skyes/tshe brtan/ dgos dgos rdo rje/ tshe rings dngos grub/ lhun grub/ sri thar/bsam grub tshe rings rnams/ gzhan yang mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba/ rje btsun kun dga' snying po'i dag pa'i thugs bskyed dang 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa phul du byung ba kun du bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i rtag brtan dam pa chos kyi gan mdzod dam/dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi par pa mkhas mgyogs mtshungs pa med pas dpyod ldan kun dgar byed nus dbu mdzad tshe bdag /dbu mdzad bde legs bkra shis / skyid dbang ldan/ chos dpal 'byor/ lhun grub/ dpal mgon/gtsang rta mgrin/ mtsho skyes/ tshe rings rgyal po/ bkras rab/ bre srang /'byor rgyas/ sa nor/ phyag rdor/ tshe dbang rdo rje/ dpal rgyas/ chos 'phel / 'om sbug padma/ bkra shes/ 'jam dbyangs/ bla ma kun bzang /mkhas mgyogs aṅgi dang po res lod/ sgrol bstan/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs/dpal khang tshe brtan/ dar rgyas tshe rings/ rtsag padma/ zam phun/ chos 'phel / rdo rje/ bsod nams nor bu/ rta mgrin/ mgon po btsan skyabs/tshe rings/ blo bzang / mkhas mgyogs aṅgi dang po bre srang / dar rgyas/mgon po bstan 'dzin/ dbang 'dzin/ sangs rgyas/ dbang ldan/ phyag drug /bzhad pa/ phun tshogs/ o rgyan/ don grub/ pa sangs/ nor 'phel / chod bkra shis/ g.yag dgos slebs/ tshe dbang bkra shis/ don grub / tshe brtan/ mgon po/ bstan 'dzin/ mgon skyabs/ nor bu 186 —191

dpal tshong / bstan 'dzin nor bu/ o rgyan bkra shis/ lnga dar tshe rings/tshe rings don grub/ chos skyabs rdo rje/ bzhi dar phun tshogs/ bsod nams phun tshogs/ ngag dbang rab brtan/ g.yu rtse tshe brtan/ gru ba pad dkar/chos skyong dar rgyas/ bsod nams bkra shis/ don grub rgya mtsho/ dgos skyes/lnga 'dzom/ tshar chung / phun tshogs/ tshangs chen/ pad tshing / phun tshogs dang po/ bsod nams nor bu/ tshe brtan lhun grub/ tshe brtan rgyal po / skyor sme ba/ tshe dbang rta mgrin rnams rnying gras dang / snye mo nas yi ge'i 'du byed la mkhas pa'i mthar son gtsang dbus thams cad du grags shing grub gras la/ slar yang mgon po byams pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhas par ma sbyangs na/ /'phags mchog gis kyang thams cad mkhyen nyid mi 'gyur ste/ /de lta bas na gzhan dag tshar gcod rjes 'dzin dang / /bdag nyid kun shes bya phyir de la de brtson bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ par gyi las grar gsar bzhugs snye mo nas 'byor pa/ tog dkar blo bzang rnam rgyal/bsod nams nor bu/ nor nor/ tshe dbang / rtsag rdo rje/ rtsag nyer lnga/chib thang sras/ phun tshogs/ dar rgyas/ yags yags/ tshe ring bkra shis/dbu chung bu/ chos rgyal mag pa/ bkra shis dbang po/ phun tshogs rgyal po/dngos grub/ bsod nams rab brtan/ bag gro/ bkra shis don grub/don grub phun tshogs/ tshe dbang phun tshogs/ dbon po chog pa/ kurma lhun grub / bkra shis tshe dbang / o lo chos dbang / rdo rje dbang ldan/ phrin las / ngag dbang rab brtan/ ber ka mgon po/ bsod nams rgyal po/tshe brtan nor bu/ chog pa/ bsod nams lhas sbyin/ tshe dbang nor bu/111—192

bsod nams dngos grub/ bkra shis/ bag gro/ ye shes/ mgon skyabs/lnga 'dzom/ chos 'phel/ bsod nams tshe 'dzin/ nor bu don grub/ bu legs / lnga lung dbang 'dus/ tshe rings nor bu/ o lo nang pa/ bsod nams rab brtan/ bstan pa dar rgyas/ bsod nams don grub/ dpon dar skyid/ gu ru dar bo/ lnga lung dbang ldan/ 'dzom pa dar rgyas/ bkra shis don grub/ lo legs/ tshe dbang bzang po/ tshangs dkar brtson skyid/bya nyi shar rdo rje/ dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ rab brtan dbang phyug /o rgyan/lnga lung tshe dbang / phun tshogs rdo rje/ ka ne dngos grub/ bag khrid skya skya/khyung tshang bkra shis/ bkra shis yar 'phel/ tshe dbang bstan 'dzin/ dgra lha/rgyal mtshan/ dpon lnga lung / rdor grag /ngag rdor/ o rgyan rdo rje/bstan 'dzin dbang phyug /snyan dbang phyug /bu tshe rings/ dgos ching /lha dar/ rab brtan/ skya lug /bstan 'dzin rab brtan/ rgyal po/ rdo rje nor bzang / rdo rje rab brtan/ snyan rdo rje don grub/ dbon rab/'od kurma rab brtan/ dbang rgyal bong tshe dbang / dge bsnyen/ brtan ma gnod sbyin gyi bu/ bstan 'dzin rgyal po/ lnga 'dzom/ blo bzang tshe rings/phun tshogs/ skal bzang don grub/ skal bzang dbang phyug /bra skor bzod pa / zhu rdor ching / rdo rje phun tshogs/ lnga lung nor bu/ gzhu dbang phyug /mgon po lha srung / dmag dbang phyug /rdo rje tshe rings/ bsod nams bkra shis / ra tsa rdo rje/ tshangs chung rdo rje tshe rings/ padma tshe rings/ brtan ma tshe rings/ zhu dpon bsam/ rdo rje bsod nams/ o rgyan rta mgrin/dpon bsam bu/ nar rdzong lha dar/ nor nor/ dkon mchog tshe dbang /106—193

dkon mchog tshe rings/ dgos yags/ dkon mchog rab rgyas/ dbang phyug /tshe ring bkra shis/ brtan dar/ zangs shing nor bu/ lha bris nor dbang / dmag bsod rab/ bcu dpon bag gro/ tshe dbang rab brtan/legs ldan dpal 'byor/ bsod nams don grub/ mi 'gyur/ bsod nams lhun grub/ lnga lung don grub/ dar rgyas tshe rings/ brag 'og bsod nams / nor bzang / lnga lung lha sbyin/ dkon mchog tshe rings/ rdo rje rnam rgyal / tshe brtan rgyal po/ tshe rings nor 'phel/ chos drug dkar po/legs rtsa mchog /dkon mchog tshe rings/ don grub rgyal po/ tshe rings don grub / tshe dbang tshe rings/ blo bzang / bstan rgyal/ bsam pa/ tshe dbang rab brtan/ nor bu rab brtan/ phun tshogs/ bsod nams nor bu/nyi shar/ rdo rje phun tshogs/ dbang ldan lhun grub/ dge bsnyen/ sri thar tshe rings / ngag dbang tshe rings/ bcu dbon skal bzang / padma rgyal po/ rdo rje tshe rings/ blo bzang / 'gyur med/ dbus chung / der ma zad rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam srol mtha' dbus thams cad du 'gyed pa'i slad du sngon bsags bsod nams kyi sgo skal ches mchog tu bzang pa'i skye bo'i tshogs dbus gtsang dwags kong lho brag dang bcas nas 'byor pa gting skyes ngag dbang dar rgyas/ tshe brtan rdo rje/ 'gyur med/ rdo rje/ bsam grub/ gzhis rtse rgyal po don grub/ zla ba/ phun tshogs/ tshangs dkar/ nor bzang /mgon po sri chod/ rdo rje rgyal po/ sri thar dpal bzang / pho lha gu ru bon grub / gu ru tshe rings/ tshe dbang dgos skyes/ tshe rings dar rgyas/ nor bu tshe rings/ rgyal rtse mgon po/ lha bu tshe brtan/ 'brang legs/ sri thar tshe 706 —194

rings / tshe rings legs pa/ lnga 'dzom/ phun tshogs/ dbang ldan/ zla ba tshe rings/ rdor legs bkra shis/ bsod nams dar rgyas/ padma rdo rje/shangs nas rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs tshe ring / sum dar/ tshe rings lhun grub / mgon po/ lha bu don grub bkra shis/ blo bzang sbyin pa/ tshe dbang bsam grub/ dgra lha/ rnam gling kurma don grub/ sum pa/ 'jam dbyangs/o rgyan tshe dbang / pa rnam ri kha ba/ zur khang pa/ spel gsar ba/ ltol dkyil khang pa/ rnam gling pa/ 'du 'byung gdong zhol pa/ 'bri lung pa/khang gsar shar pa/ po ta la nas rgya mon dar rgyas/ chos skyong bag gro/ bu yags / thang stong rdo rje tshe dbang / nyang bran bkra shis dngos grub/ bkra shis tshe rings/ dan phag dpon po/ dan phag dbang po/ grib shes rab/grib drung rtog /kun dga' tshe brtan/ bde chen skya 'bal/ lha ldan tshe rings / phun tshogs/ rgyal rong bsam grub/ bkra shis phun tshogs/ nor nor / sne gdor nor bu dgos skyes/ tshe sgrub/ bkra shis rgya mtsho/ gnod sbyin / 'bras bzang / sum yags/ tshe dbang dngos grub/ 'byong rgyas nor bu dbang 'dus/ rgyud 'dzin/ tshe dbang rta mgrin/ dgra 'dul/phun tshogs rab rgyas/ 'gyur med bde mchog /nor bu 'khrung yags/bsod nams yar 'phel/ o rgyan rdo rje/ rin spungs 'gyur med rnam rgyal/tshe brtan/ tshe rings don ldan/ tshe rings don grub/ 'gyur med skal bzang / g.yag sde nor bu tshe 'dzin/ bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ 'dus bzang / dge bsnyen lhun grub/ bsod nams dbang po/ sri gu tshe brtan nor bu/ sangs rgyas/ skal skyid/ skal bzang dbang po/ sum dar/ /106—195

bkra shis phun tshogs/ bzhi dar/ phan za dam bzhi dga'/ phun tshogs/padma lha srung / lhun rdzong bsam rdor/ shes rab/ bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/rta mgrin rgyal po/ phan lha khang rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ mkhar rtse tshe brtan/ bsod nams/ stag rtse dpal bzang nor bu/ phun tshogs bkra shis/ dge bsnyen lha srung / bsod nams dar rgyas / sri thar/ mtshal bde tshe rings/ phun tshogs/ bag gro/ blo bzang tshe rings/ tshe ring don ldan/ tshe brtan/ dbang skyid/ mgon po/ dgra 'dul / snye mo lhun grub bzang po/ bkra shis dar rgyas/ smon mkhar sum dar / don grub/ la khang bu chung / dpal 'byor tshe rings/ bsod nams rgyal po/ kurma rdo rje/ chu shur bsod nams rgyal po/ lo yags/ khra 'bor/gling rdo rje dgra 'dul/ dpal ldan phun tshogs/ padma dbang rgyal/ rnam rgyal nor bu/ nyi ma tshe rings/ seng ge rdzong dgos dgos bstan 'dzin/ bkra shis dar rgyas/ nor 'phel/ tshe dbang rnam rgyal/ dar rdzong padma rnam rgyal/don yod/ 'gyur med rab brtan/ lha khang rgya mtsho/ sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin / rdzong dga' phun tshogs/ bstan 'dzin/ ma me bstan 'dzin/ drung 'jam dbyangs/ mkhas pa ngag dbang / ngag dbang chos 'phel/ drung o rgyan / rgya mtsho/ padma don grub/ gnya' nang sgrol skyabs/ bkra shis/ blo bzang / lnga dar/ khyi lod/ don grub/ bsod nams bkra shis/ ngo rdzong blo bzang dpal ldan/ kurma rnam gzigs/ sangs rgyas chos 'phel bkra shis chos 'phel/ kun bzang dbang po/ 'ol kha dar rgyas/ phun tshogs/bzhi 'dzom/ g.yul lhun nor bu khang gsar/ dgos pa don grub/ nor bu 106—196

don grub/ rdo rje/ o rgyan bkra shis/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin/ shag lho nor bu dbang 'dus/ sri thar/ bkra shis don grub/ em chi dbang 'dus/rgyal em chi/ bsod nams rdo rje/ lha gsol sri thar rdo rje/ ngag dbang bsod nams/ ku rnam bsod rnams phun tshogs/ skyid grong slob dpon nor 'phel / 'gyur med rig 'dzin/ tshe rings rdo rje/ legs ldan rgya mtsho/dgos 'byor/ nam mkha'/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ la smad blo bde/ rdo rje rgyal po/ bu yags/ nor bu don grub/ tshe rings dar rgyas/ dngos grub/lnga 'dzom/ dgos grub/ tshe brtan/ bsam grub/ nyi zla/ sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ bsam bkra shis/ o rgyan mkhas dbang / blo bde/ nor bu bsam grub/ bzang skyabs/ padma tshe brtan/ 'chi med phun tshogs/ bkra shisal/ o rgyan sri thar/ bkra shis chos 'phel/ 'dzom don grub/ bkra shis dpal 'byor/ jo rdzong 'jam dbyangs legs pa/ ngag dbang thos bsam/blo gros 'byung gnas/ brtson 'grus rgya mtsho/ zho kha chos skyong tshe rings/ o rgyan dar rgyas/ rgya mda' ngag dbang phun tshogs/ dbang rgyal/ sri thar/bsod nams tshe rings/ o rgyan tshe rings/ rin chen rtse tshe dbang nor bu/pa sangs rdo rje/ nyi ma tshe rings/ dar chings/ padma tshe rings yar 'phel/gong dkar padma rgyal po/ ngag dbang rig grol/ yar 'phel/ bsod nams lhun grub/ tshe rings dar rgyas/ lha chung / mgon skyabs/ rtse sgang blo bzang don grub/ bstan 'dzin shes rab/ ngag dbang rin chen/ padma rin chen/'jam dbyangs/ 'o yug bstan 'dzin dbang po/ zla ba tshe rings/ mgon dar / pad rdor/ mal gro bsod nams/ byams pa/ nor bu don grub 106—197

rnams kyis las rgyun khyon bsdoms/ mi gcig gis lo zlar brkyangs lo drug brgya dang lnga bcu nga bzhi/ zla ba brgyad/ zhag bzhi (ma phyi mi gsal )byings khyad med kyi mi rer zla phogs/ rtsam khal lnga/ chang nas bal gcig bre bcu/ rgyar ngo sprod chung khog /khog gcig dod spus/ spre tshwa phul phyed/ yon par shing rer ru'i khal gnyis bre brgyad phul phyed do/ (ma phyi mi gsal )gcig rnams ngo thog sgang 'dril kyi thob dang / lag gsar rnying gras su mi 'dre nges pa'i rigs par shing nyis stong gsum brgya nga gcig la byas byung rnam dbye'i slad du par shing 'bring smad kyi yon bre brgyad/ phul gyi bzhi cha dang / zhe brgyad cha gcig /'dzugs dang gdong brkos la las rgyun dang mi grangs mtha' gcig tu ma nges kyang / khyon bsdoms mi gcig gis lo zhe gcig /zla ba bdun song bar par pa mkhas nges sha thang dgos shis par shing rab yon/ gong smos bzo bo tshangs ma'i las zhag dril bar mi gcig gis lo bdun brgya dang bzhi/ zla ba lnga/ zhag bcu gcig song bar nyin ltar ja nyi shu spor/ rdor bzhi bskor/ tshwa this gzhi ltar gyi sbyor bzhi dang sgril jar kyang rdor gong mtshungs/ zhus dag pa mi gcig gi lo dgu/zla ba brgyad/ zhag nyer gnyis song bar 'dab ja la/ snga dgongs kyi thug par mi rer thug thengs rer thug thal rtsam phul phyed dang lnga cha phyed dang bre gnyis/tsha phul gyi nyi shu cha gcig snga thug rdor rus rdzogs spor gyi lnga cha gcig /dgongs thug la phyur ba phul gyi bzhi cha gcig dang brgya nyi shu'i cha/ stong dang nyis brgya'i cha gcig rnams dang / der ma zad las gra 'di'i ched du par slob gsar 'byor gyi rigs la'ang / e snye nas 'byor pa gang yin la lam chas rdzong gzhis so so nas btang ba dang / rdzong 'go'i par pa'i rigs la lam chas gong bzhin 186—198

thog rdzong 'go so sor zla ba bzhi re'i phogs song 'dra yang zhib tig 'dir bkod 'os ma rnyed/ e snyer las grar ma tshud par thog mar phyed phogs dang / de rjes nad mi theg tshul la brten spar ba/ rdzong 'go'i rigs la'ang las gra dngos la ma tshud par song ba bcas la rgyun ring thung sogs mtha' gcig du ma nges pas rtsis gzhir bkar ba'i dkrig sbyar ma bde rung / yang tig song ba gang yin so sor bsdoms pa la rtsam shor khal cig stong / lnga brgya/ nyi shu rtsa gsum/ bre dgu phul lnga/ chang nas bzhi brgya dang drug /chung khog brgya dang phyed gnyis/spre tshwa khal gcig bre bcu gsum phul lnga/ las gra dngos la ma tshud ring nyin rer ja gsum re gtang bar bzang ja 'dregs khal bzhi dang nyag bzhi/ mar khal bcu bzhi dang nyag bcu bzhi/ spor gang / thab shing / sbyor shing / bzhes spro'i me shing bcas la lci ba/ gla chal/ gla 'dab/ rta sbang sogs bsdud rgya'i rgya ma nyi khri/ lnga stong / lnga brgya dang dgu song zhing / par brkos gegs med mthar phyin nas bzo bo rnams rang gnas su log skabs ja mar lta la 'khyol song ba dril mi gcig gis lo sum cu so lnga/ zla ba dgu/ zhag lnga la nyin thob ja nyi shu sgor dang rdor phyed gsum bskor gyi sbyor gnyis/ chas byings mtshams rdzong gzhis par gtang par mi gcig gis lo bcu gcig /zla ba brgyad/ zhag nyi shu'i rtsis la nyin thob rtsam mda' bzo/ rgyar chung bzhi bcu grangs/ thug thal phul phyed drug tshwa phyur ba phul gyi nyi shu cha gcig /thug rdor lug mgo'i sum cu cha/tshwa phul gyi nyer bzhi cha gcig /gzhan yang ja ma gnyis/ em chi/ mig lta ba gcig /yig mkhan rnams kyi las rgyun mgo pa dang cha mtshungs dang / par shubs 'tshems mi bsam gtan dang / rgyal mtshan gyis las rgyun zla ba dgu song 186—199

ba bcas la phogs thob sger g.yog dang dpe 'dre'i thob/ 'tshems bu bar nyin gla bre bzhi phul phyed bzhi/ bzhi cha gcig /rta zam gsar btsugs gtan sdod bzhir dgun dpyid zla ba drug gi ring nyin rer chu ldur bre re dang bzan pa bsdud brgya re'i rtsis gong gsal rnams so so'i gnas su bsdoms pa gshor 'bom par nyag gi bar zhib nyis brgya dang bdun cu/ rtsing khal bzhi khri dgu stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe dgu bre bcu gnyis phul gang lnga cha gnyis/ chang nas khal chig khri gsum stong lnga brgya lnga bcu nga bdun bre drug phul do/ tshwa khal bzhi brgya dang lnga bre bcu dgu phul gsum bzhi cha gcig /snum khal brgya dang bcu gsum phul do bzhi cha gcig /phyur ba khal drug brgya dang lnga/ bre gang phul gyi bcu gnyis cha gcig/sum cu cha gcig lnga bcu cha gcig /gral chab khal zhe brgyad bre bco lnga/ chu sdur khal nyis brgya dgu bcu go gnyis bre bcu/ rgyar ngo sprod chung khog brgyad stong brgyad brgya nyi shu phyed rtsa bzhi dang / lnga cha phyed gnyis/ sha bzang ngan phyed 'khyer gyi chung khog nyis brgya dang phyed nyi shu lnga cha gnyis bzang ja 'degs khal drug brgya dang dgu bcu go gsum/ nyag dgu sgor phyed gsum cu cha phyed gnyis / mar 'degs khal nyis stong dgu brgya drug cu re gnyis nyag brgyad sgor phyed gsum nyi shu cha gcig /sha skam rus rdzogs 'dregs khal drug brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad nyag bcu drug sgor phyed bzhi/ yon 'bru dngul ngo thog tu sprad pa khal dgu khri dgu stong bzhi brgya drug cu tham pa bre bzhi phul lnga so gnyis cha gcig /sha dod phogs 'phros/ gla yon bcas spus khal sum khri sum stong nyis brgya brgyad cu gya lnga bre bcu bdun phul do/ bcu cha gcig dang brgya nyi shu'i cha gcig /bzan pa 'degs khal chig khri bdun stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu/ lci ba 'degs khal 106—200

chig 'bum brgyad khri brgyad stong dgu brgya don gnyis nyag do rnams kyi rin gong yul thang ltar brtsis pa khyon bsdoms dngul rdo tshad nyis brgya don lnga dang /dngul srang sum cu so gsum zho bdun la/ srang rer gshor khal nyi shu rtsis khal 'bum tsho gnyis bdun khri lnga stong drug brgya bdun cu don bzhi rnams thob/gnyis pa ni/ ji skad du/ lnga brgya tha ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /nga nyid yi ge'i gzugs su gnas/ /nga yin snyam du mchod par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa skal bzang gi rna bar thos shing rgyu mtshan dpal be'ur 'khyil ba'i rigs nas bka' 'gyur rin po che mchod bzhengs dang bkur stis mchod pa ches mang zhing rnam pa thams cad du phyag bya ba'i yul yin mod/ mi zad par gyi 'phrul sgo brgya dus gcig tu 'byed pa'i byed po ni/ mi'i dbang po pho lha tha'i ji bsod nams stobs rgyas kyi khyad chos su grub pa la/ mkhas mkhas dang snyan snyan gyi zol sbyor ma dgos par mchog dman bar mar bcas pas btan la phebs pa 'di'o/ /de yang / 'di nyid kyi ngang tshul srid sgrub rgan po'i nyag phran la 'gran bzod pas legs nyes kyi spu ris nam yang mi 'dor zhing / legs par byas kun 'phral yun du rjes su gzung nas gzeng bstod pa dang 'gal bar spyod pa gtang snyoms su mi 'bor bar tshar gcod pas gdol spyod mi bsrun pa'i lugs ngan je 'phel du mi 'gyur ba'i rdzogs ldan gsar du 'gugs pa'i pho nyar grub pa bzhin/'dir yang gzhung las rnam dag byed mir byas byung ma 'dres rjen char gyi reg zig mthar chags su bkod pa la/ de yang thog mar par pa rnams la par shing mgyogs rim gyi/ mgyogs dbul (ma phyi mi gsal )e gras ang dang gcig la mdzod thags che legs dang / bal ṭam/ ang gnyis bdun la bsod btags re 106—201

dang / bal ṭam/ ang gsum gras bdun la bkras btags re dang bal ṭam phyed re/ ang bzhi gras gsum la bkras btags/ ang lnga gras gnyis la sman kha / yang ang dang gcig la mdzod btags che legs dang / bal ṭam/ang dang gcig la mdzod shar dang / bal ṭam bzhi/ yang ang dang gcig la bkras btags/ yang ang gnyis gcig la mdzod btags chung ba/ yang ang gnyis bdun la bsod btags che ba/ ang gsum drug la sman kha/ ang dang gcig la mdzod btags dkyus shar/ bal ṭam gnyis/ ang gnyis gcig la bkras btags dang / bal ṭam phyed gnyis/ ang gsum mi lnga la kha btags re dang / bal ṭam re/ yang ang dang gcig la kha btags mdzod shar/bal ṭam/ phun gling gras ang dang mi bzhir mdzod btags re dang / bal ṭam re/ ang gnyis mi dgu la bsod btags re dang / bal ṭam re/ ang gsum gas mi bcu drug la bkras btags re dang / bal ṭam phyed re/ ang bzhi gras mi gsum la bkras btags re/ ang lnga gras mi lnga la sman kha re/ang dang gras mi bzhi la mdzod shar re/ ang gnyis gras mi bdun la kha btags re/ ang gsum mi gsum la sman kha re/ par brkos dbu mdzad gsum / shing bzo dbu mdzad gcig /bris pa dbu mdzad gnyis bcas la bkras btags re/ ang dang mi gnyis la bsod btags dang / bal ṭam re/ang gnyis mi gcig la bsod btags 'bring dang dngul zho gang / ang gsum mi bzhir bkras btags dang / bal ṭam phyed re/ ang bzhi mi drug la bkras shar / ang lnga mi dgu la rgyal btags re/ ang drug mi drug la sman kha legs pa ༈ ang bdun mi gnyis la sman 'bring / 'di yan zhogs slong gi ched yang 111—202

yang btang ba las zhib cha med cing / 'di nas bzung zla ba re'i 'tshams par zhing blangs pa zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyer lnga la/ ang dang gcig la mdzod btags srang do ri ba/ ang gnyis gcig la mdzod btags srang gang ri ba/sang gsum drug la rtags brgyad re/ ang bzhi mi bcu gcig la bkras btags re / ang lnga nyi shu rtsa brgyad la kha btags dkyus shar/ dbu chen bzhi la kha btags che ba re/ dbu chung bzhi la kha btags chung ba re/ zla ba gsum pa'i nyer lnga la mgyogs dar ang dang mi gcig la kha btags 'dom 'khor che ba dang /gos kha do/ sman yug /ang gnyis gcig la kha btags che legs dang /sman yug /gos kha phyed do/ ang gsum mi gcig la rtags brgyad dang /sman kha bdun 'brel/ gos kha phyed do/ ang bzhi mi gcig la bkras btags che ba dang / gos kha sman kha bzhi 'brel/ ang lnga pa drug la rtags gsar re/ang drug pa dgu la bkras btags re/ ang bdun gnyis la bkras shar re/ang brgyad pa nyer gnyis la srid zhib bde skyid ma re/ ang dgu so gcig la kha btags dkyus shar re rnams/ zla ba bzhi pa'i nyer lnga la/ ang dang gcig la gos rgyan bzhi'i la ba sha dngul sung bdun ri ba/ ang dang gcig la mdzod gos sprin ris ma'i la ba sha dngul srang drug ri ba/ ang gnyis gcig la gos mtshon pa me tog ris kyi la ba sha dngul srang lnga ri ba/ ang gsum gcig la gos phug ron mdog gi la ba sha dngul srang phyed bzhi ri ba/ ang bzhi gcig la gos sngon gyi la ba sha srang phyed bzhi ri ba/ ang lnga pa nas ang bcu'i bar la ming gsham gsal thun mongs su mdzod gos sngon po gser gyi 'khor brgyad ma'i slog pa nang khi mi ri/ o ro su'i sum skud/ dngul gyi thob chi gnyis yod kha gsar 186—203

gcig la dngul srang nyi shu rtsa brgyad byas/ de thog nas ang lnga drug la bal ṭam dgu re/ ang drug lnga la bal ṭam bdun re/ ang bdun brgyad la lnga re/ang brgyad bcu la bal ṭam gnyis re/ ang dgu nyi shu rtsa gcig la bal ṭam re/ang bcu zhe gsum la 'ja'u re'i rtsis rnams/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer lnga la/ang dang gcig la mdzod btags che legs/ ang gnyis gcig la kha btags 'dom 'khor che legs/ ang gsum gnyis la 'dom 'khor dkyus ma re/ ang bzhi gnyis la rtags brgyad re/ ang lnga mi lngar bsod rtags re/ ang drug mi drug la bkras btags re/ ang bdun mi dgu la bkras shar/ ang brgyad mi nyi shu rtsa lnga la bkras dkyus re/ de nyin par pa dang yig mkhan mkhas nges gnyis la kha btags re yang song / zla ba drug pa'i nyer lnga la/ ang dang mi gcig la gos slog sngon po srang bzhi ri ba dang / kha btags 'dom 'khor/ang gnyis gnyis la 'dom 'khor re dang / mdzod gos sngon po'i phor shubs re/ang gsum gcig la 'dom 'khor shar tsam dang gos dmar kha/ ang bzhi gcig la rtags brgyad dang / gos kha/ ang lnga gnyis la rtags shar re/ang drug gsum la bkras btags re/ ang bdun brgyad pa bkras shar re/ang brgyad nyer bdun la kha btags re rnams/ yang zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga la / ang dang mi gcig la gos ljang gi rtsag rdzus dbyar ldan dmar po'i mtha' 'jag /sum rgyan sor bzhi yod pa dngul srang bcu bdun ri ba/ ang gnyis mi gcig la gos sngon gyi rtsag rdzus dbyar ldan dmar po'i mtha' 'jag /sum rgyan sor bzhi yod pa dngul sung bcu ri ba/ ang gsum mi gsum la gos chen gyi la ba sha srang drug ri ba re/ ang bzhi mi gcig la gos ljang gi rtsag pa srang 186—204
