bzhi ri ba dang / gos kha bzhi/ ang lnga mi bzhir gos chen gyi la ba sha srang bzhi ri ba re/ ang drug mi gcig la gos kha bcu tham pa/ ang bdun mi gsum la gos kha dgu re/ ang brgyad mi gnyis la gos kha drug re/ ang dgu mi bzhi la gos kha bzhi re/ ang bcu mi nyi shu rtsa gnyis la gos kha phyed gsum re/ang bcu gcig pa bcu bdun la gos kha re dang / kha btags re/ ang bcu gnyis pa lnga bcu nga brgyad la kha btags re rnams song / zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du / mgyogs dar gtad pa ang dang mi gcig la gos rgyan bzhi smug po'i lding slog dbyar ldan dmar po'i rgyan ldan sum skor ma dngul srang bcu bdun ri ba/ang gnyis mi gcig la gos slog dngul srang phyed lnga ri ba/ bal ṭam bcu tham pa / ang gsum mi gcig la gos ljang nag gi la ba sha ga dngul sung bzhi ri ba/bal ṭam brgyad/ ang bzhi mi lnga la gos slog srang bzhi ri ba re dang / ang gnyis la gos slog sung bzhi ri ba re/ ang lnga mi lnga la gos kha phyed bdun re/ang drug pa mi bcu gcig la gos pa lnga re/ ang bdun pa mi gnyis la gos kha bzhi re/ ang brgyad pa mi gnyis ma gos kha gsum re/ ang dgu pa mi bzhi la gos kha do re/ ang bcu pa mi drug la gos kha re/ ang bcu gcig pa mi bco lnga la bal ṭam re/ sang bcu gnyis pa mi grangs nyer brgyad la dngul zho re/ang bcu gsum pa mi grangs nyer gnyis la kha btags re dang / sman kha re/ang bcu bzhi pa mi grangs so bdun la bkras rtags re/ zla ba dgu pa'i mgyogs dar spus shin tu zhan rigs la ma dgos kyang / spus tshad mi zhan pa'i rigs la gtang snyoms su bzhag na ma 'thus pas ang dang mi gcig la gos kha lnga/ang gnyis mi gcig la gos kha bzhi/ ang gsum mi gcig la gos kha gsum/106—205

ang bzhi mi gnyis la gos kha do re/ ang lnga mi dgu la gos kha re/ ang drug mi dgu la kha btags che legs re/ ang bdun mi gsum la kha btags 'bring re / ang brgyad mi gcig la bkras rtags legs pa/ ang dgu mi gcig la bkras 'bring / ang bcu mi bdun la bkras dkyus re/ ang bcu gcig pa mi gcig la bkras bzher/ ang bcu gnyis pa mi gsum la bkras chung re/ ang bcu gsum pa mi dgu la rgyal rtags re/ ang bcu bzhi pa mi gsum la bsam 'phel re/ ang bco lnga pa mi nyer gnyis pa sman kha legs pa re/ ang bcu drug pa mi so gnyis la sman 'bring re/ ang bcu bdun pa mi lnga bcur sman dkyus re rnams/ mkhas dar la/ par brkos las grangs snga phyi bar gsum la mkhas nges su bud aṅgi dang po phun gcod rta mgrin/ chos dpal 'byor/dpal 'byor rgya mtsho/ dbu mdzad blo bzang kun thub rnams sgang thob dang /mkhas kyang lag rjes nyung ba rjes 'byor med rdzong slob dpon dgos dgos bstan 'dzin rnams la mi mda' ring ba re dngul srang gsum/ thung ba gnyis so sor dngul srang phyed do byas pa sprad cing / bka' 'gyur rin po che'i par brkos gegs med grub zin nas grol ston dga' ston nyin byas byung tshar kha 'os pa zhu dag pa gra pa thog mtha' 'khyongs pa bzhi la gos ling gi chos gos legs pa dngul srang bcu ri ba gcig dang / yang dngul srang drug ri ba gsum/ kha btags re/dbu chen gsum la gos slog dngul srang bdun ri ba re dang / zhwa mo 'bog tho re/kha btags 'dom 'khor/ dbu chung brgya byin la gos slog dngul sung lnga ri ba gcig dang / zhwa mo/ kha btags/ slob dpon thog mtha' bar gsum du byas shing lag rjes gtsang ba chos dpal 'byor la gos slog dngul srang lnga dang zho 106—206

lnga ri ba gcig dang / kha btags/ slob dpon byed mi byings mi nyi shu rtsa gnyis la rgya zam gyi la ba sha dngul srang gang dang sho do ri ba re dang / kha btags re/ dbus gtsang gi rgan po gnyis la zhwa mo 'bog tho re dang / slar yang slob dpon byed mi bcu la rgya zam cha re/ byings bzo bo mi grangs bdun brgya dang bdun cu/ las byed bdun bcas par bkra shis pa'i kha btags re rnams / las gra tshugs ma thag nas ma 'grig kyang / phag lo zla ba dang po nas ma grol bar lo gcig gi ring mkhas mgyogs ang thob rigs dang / dbu mdzad re skor gyi mi bcu skor la nyin ltar ja bcu spor/ rdor gsum skor/ tsha rtsis gzhi ltar gyi sbyor re dang / par yig rnams grub nas yig mkhan/ shog las pa bcas phyir log mi e pa mi grangs nyer gnyis/ snye mo ba gong mtshur/ phun gling pa gcig bcas la so sor spag rag 'gag sha chung nyi shu gras/ bkras shar gyi spa dar/ chang tig brgya dang nyi shu rnams dang / snga phyir mkhas dag 'dzom pa gcig la mdzod 'bring gi spa dar/ bka' 'gyur par brkos grub nyin phye mar mkhar 'bo gsum/ mar zhogs mar nyag bcu/ dmar rgyan chung khog /chang phud tig bdun cu/ mang ja gcig /gnang cha spyir mdzod rtags che legs / bal ṭam brgya thum/ gos gser gzhi ma yug chen la dngul srang sum cu ri ba/ dbu mdzad che chung bzhi dang / shags ram par kha btags re/zhus dag zin pa'i nyin phye mar mkhar 'bo/ mar zhog nyag gsum/ chang tig bcu / bcu spor gyi 'bar ja gcig /gra pa bgres pa gnyis la mdzod btags/byings bcu bzhi la bkras btags re/ gsham gsal grol ston mi the ba'i ston thengs lnga song bar thengs re la dbu mdzad bzhi so sor bar spag rag 'gag /186—207

za sha chung rtsos bcu bzug /skya thung nyis sgroms/ lug sha skam po brgyad bzug tshag sha skam smug so so nas chung bzhi gling re'i rtsis/ kham star sder re/gzhes spro snum btsos/ 'bu dkar/ 'bu smug /skya thung / smug thung /bzhi skor phra ma rnams sder re/ skyed lhas dkar po sder do/ 'dzugs lug khog/tshag lag rnams dang / byings ston thengs re la mi grangs 'phar chag gis gcig tu ma nges pas/ khyon bsdoms mi grangs su brkyangs par mi sum stong drug cu re gnyis la ston thengs gcig gi rtsis mi re rtsing spag rag 'gag /za sha nyi shu gas/khur ba 'bri lce'i dod bcas gzhes spro lag dogs lnga re/ 'dzugs chung gzhi gling / ja bcu sgor/ rdor bzhi skor/ tshwa 'o rtsis gzhi ltar gyis 'phar ja sbyor gnyis / 'bras thug gcig /chang tig re/ ston thengs lnga so sor ston rgyab bzo bo spyi khyab tu gnang cha mdzod rtags/ rten khebs rgyan ldan/ sman kha bcu gnyis yod pa'i yug /gos kha bcu gcig yod pa'i yug /'chor kha bco lnga yod pa'i yug /ru thi 'khor drug /khyab gcig /bu ram ltang rtse/ mdzo pho/lho ras yug /lcob ras yug rnams dang / sngon chad gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ma grags pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che par bzhengs lo gcig zla ba gsum gyi khongs su grub nas grol ston dga' ston rin po cher dbu mdzad bzhi/ bzo bo mi grangs bdun brgya lnga bcu nga drug bcas par spag dang / ja sha gong bzhin la/bu ram re/ mngar kham bye ril rgyan 'bru bcas gsum bsres kyi sder re/ lag dogs dgu/ 'dzugs gzhi gling / dbu mdzad la 'dzugs 'da' 'phar/bar ja gnyis dang / 'bras thug gcig bcas thob gong 'dra/ mi rer char tig bdun re rnams dang / zur bsos thengs lnga so sor do dam pa gnyis la 106—208

bar zhib gshor khal gsum/ rtsing khal drug /lug khog gnyis/ tshag sha bzhi gling / rta tshang 'u zi so so nas hag lnga re/ mar 'dregs khal gnyis re dang /dbu chen gsum so sor rtsing khal gsum re/ chung khog gcig /yā ju 'degs nyag bzhi/ mar 'degs khal gcig nyag bzhi/ dbu chung gcig la rtsam khal gnyis / lug khog gcig /yā ju 'degs nyag gsum/ mar 'dregs nyag bco brgyad/ byings par rnying zur bsos rgang thob thengs lnga khyon bsdoms mi grangs su rkyangs byings drug brgya lnga bcu nga lnga la mi rer rtsam khal gnyis/ chung khog phyed/ yā ju 'degs nyag gsum/ mar 'dregs nyag dgu re dang /gsang slob mi grangs dgu brgya lnga bcu nga lnga la/ slob ma'i thob mi rer rtsam khal gnyis / tshag zug re/ sha phing 'degs nyag do/ mar 'degs nyag drug /lcags phag gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston la/ mgo pa dpon slob sku mched gnyis dang ju rig thu po shor che so sor bcu gcig sder la bar spag dang / ja sha gong bzhin/ bu ram lcug gnyis bshibs/ kham bu sder/ gzhes spro smug thung sum rtsegs/ 'bri lce spos skya lag dogs bcas sum rtsegs sder re/ slang kha gnyis rtsegs sder re/ bzhi khra gsum rtsegs sder re/ 'dzugs lug khog re/dbu chen bzhi la lug mgo phyed kha re/ kham bu dang / bu ram bcas sder re/gzhes spro smug thung sum rtsegs kyi sder re/ 'bu ril nyis rtsegs kyi sder re/lag dogs nyis rtsegs kyi sder re/ slang kha re/ 'dzugs sha phyed/ dbu chung gsum dang / zhus dag pa bzhi la spag dang lug mgo bu ram kham bu gong bzhin/lag dogs 'bri lce spo skya bcas nyis bshibs kyi sder re/ slang kha re/ 'dzugs sha bzhi gling / bar rnying las yang gas brgya dang sum cu so bdun la rtsang spag 106—209

dang lug mgo bu ram kham bu gong bzhin/ lag dogs nyis bshibs sder re/slang kha re/ 'dzugs bcu gzug /gsar slob sum brgya bzhi bcu zhe bzhi la/rtsing spag rag 'gag /za sha nyi shu gras/ lag dogs gnyis/ slang kha re/em phyir dbu chung dpe 'dre/ las byed drug la par rnying dpe 'dre/ mgo pa'i g.yog bcu gcig la slob gsar dpe 'dre/ spyir chang tig chig stong dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ chu byi gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston la mgo pa gsum/dbu chen gnyis/ zhus dag pa bzhi/ /byings par rnying mi grangs brgya dang bcu gsum / em phyi/ las byed drug /g.yog bcu gcig bcas la thob gong dang 'dra / mi rer chang tig re/ dbyar thog stan mo dang dus mtshungs byas gshis thob byings dkrig bcar ma dgos shing / chang nyin gnyis kyi ring gang 'thungs lhug par btang zhing / de lhag kyang so sor sprad pa bcas chang rgyu gshor khal nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe bzhi bre lnga rnams/ gong gsal 'gyogs dar sogs bya dgar song ba'i dngos po la ri gong rgyab khung yod rigs de don dang / med rigs rgyu 'gro 'bebs 'os rtsis gzhi ltar phab par gong yul thang rtsis pa dang ngo thog bcas khyon bsdoms dngul rdo tshad bzhi bcu zhe gnyis dang srang drug zho drug skar bdun la dngul sung rer 'bru gshor khal nyi shu re rtsis khal bzhi khri nyis stong brgya sum cu so gsum bre bdun phul gsum/gsum pa mchog dman bar pa'i skye rgu rnams kyis bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas tshogs kyi kha skong ji ltar bgyis tshul bshad pa la yang / bzo ston gyi byung ba bkod pa dang / zhal 'debs kyi 'brel pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul bshad pa'o / /dang po ni/ las byed so sor ston mo zhu mi byung ba la/ thog mar zla ba 106—210

brgyad pa'i tshes nyer bdun gyi nyin sa skya'i 'gag pa dbang po'i no bos/ mang ja gnyis/ chang tshod nyi shu/ do dam mgo pa gnyis rdzong bzhugs gnyis/dbu mdzad drug bcas la kha btags re/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin dpon slob byams pa'i sku zhabs nas/ mang ja lnga/ sha khog brgyad/rtsam ru'i khal bcu/ chang tshod bzhi bcu zhe gcig /mgo pa gnyis dang rdzong bzhugs gnyis la kha btags che shar/ par pa yig mkhan/ shing bzo/lcags bzo/ zhu dag pa/ ja ma gnyis bcas khyon mi grangs brgya skor la bkras btags / zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin sngo ma lung pas mang ja lnga la mkhar 'degs kyi nyag bcu/ mar gsum skor/ rtsam ru'i khal lnga/ lug khog dgu/'bras thug gnyis/ chang tshod sum cu so gnyis/ dkar spro/ 'go pa/ rdzong yongs la kha btags/ dbu mdzad drug la spa dar/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu drug la rdzong dga' 'phel gling nas mang ja gsum/ rtsam ru'i khal drug /lug sha khog bcu gnyis/ chang tshod bzhi bcu/ 'go pa dang rdzong yongs la kha btags / dbu mdzad drug la bkras btags/ byings mi grangs dgu bcu go lnga la sman kha re/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la shel chos nas mang ja bdun/'bras thug gnyis/ rtsam ru'i khal bdun bre bcu/ sha khog bco lnga/ chang tshod bzhi bcu/ 'go pa gnyis la spa dar dang bal ṭam bzhi re/ rdzong yongs rnams la kha btags dang bal ṭam gnyis/ dbu mdzad drug la bkras thag /par pa sogs mi grangs dgu bcu go brgyad la sman kha re/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la bkra shis lhun po nas mang ja lnga/ thug pa gnyis/ chang tshod drug cu re drug /'go pa gnyis so sor mdzod shar/ sha khog gsum re/186—211

dngul srang gsum re dang thun mongs su dgu tshan/ rdzong bzhugs sogs la kha btags / sha khog /dbu mdzad bdun la bsod thags re dang / sha khog gnyis re/ bal ṭam gsum re/ dmar zhus gra pa gnyis la kha btags/ sha khog /bal ṭam gsum re/ byings dang las byed bcas brgya dang bcu bzhir kha btags/ sha khog /bal ṭam gnyis re/ 'go pa'i g.yog bcu gsum la kha btags bal ṭam re dang / lto skor 'tshoms rdzong g.yog rnams la kha btags dang skor 'tshoms/ par pa spyir ston rgyab tu gos thon thi ser po yug /byus dmar yug /gos skyer yug bcas kyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan gsum/ lag g.yog bzhi bcu zhe gnyis la sha bzhi gling dang / kha btags re/ bal ṭam re rnams / gong gsal tshang mar spag rang 'gag /sha nyi shu gras che/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum la mtsho sgo bas mang ja lnga/ nyung ja/ thug pa gsum/chang tshod drug cu/ 'go pa gnyis la bdun sder dang 'dzugs khog /kha btags / rnam bubs/ ṭam bcu bzhi re/ thun mongs su sran zhib gshor khal bzhi/ par pa las byed sogs brgya nyi shu skor la spag rang 'gag /lag dogs gsum re/ sman kha re/ 'go pa'i g.yog so sor gong stengs kha btags/lag g.yog rnams la rtsam gshor bre bzhi/ sha brgyad cu gras/ rdzong yong gsum la zhib do/ dmangs rtsa mdo/ mgul dar/ chang tshod gsum re/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la lcags byong mo nas mang ja drug /nyung ja/bzhes thug gnyis/ rtsam gshor khal brgyad/ lug khog phyed bcu gsum/lug mgo nyer gnyis/ chang tshod bzhi bcu zhe gnyis/ 'go pa gnyis la so sor bsod btags/ bal ṭam bzhi re/ rdzong bzhugs gnyis la bkras thags/106—212

bal ṭam re/ dbu mdzad/ zhus dag pa/ mkhas mgyogs bcu gsum la bkras btags/ byings la sman kha brgya dang sum cu so gnyis/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer brgyad la spo ngor rje dpon nas mang ja bdun/ nyung ja lnga/'bras thug gcig /skya 'jam gcig /rtsam gshor khal bco lnga/ chang tshod brgya dang gnyis/ lug khog bzhi bcu zhe gsum/ tshag rkang bdun bcu don gsum dang tshag lag gnyis/ bzhes spro lag dogs lnga brgya/ bur bcugs lnga bcu / thud skya ser/ 'go pa gnyis la bsod btags/ bal ṭam dgu/rdzong yongs la bsod btags chung ba/ dbu mdzad bdun/ zhus dag pa/mkhas mgyogs bcas mi bco lnga la kha btags/ byings la sman kha brgya dang zhe dgu dang 'ja'u re/ dbu mdzad rnam la 'dab 'phar rnams dang / yang ston thengs gcig gi dod du g.yag pho mo che chung 'dres pa nyis brgya dang lnga bcu/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du gze mkhar chos sde nas mang ja gnyis/ nyung ja/'go pa gnyis la bal ṭam brgyad re dang kha thags/ mi grangs gong gsal la bal ṭam phyed re/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer drug la gnya' nang 'phel gling bla spyi dang gnas po blo bzang nas mang ja lnga/ 'bras thug /ston dod khyon sgril bal ṭam nyis brgya dang go gcig 'go pa thun mongs su bal ṭam drug cu re gnyis dang / dgu tshan gsum/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer brgyad la 'go pa mnga' bdag pas mang ja bzhi/ nyung ja gcig /rtsam ru'i khal sum cu so drug/sha khog bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/ chang tshod brgya dang bco lnga/ ang dang gnyis la mdzod btags che legs/ ang gnyis gcig la mdzod shar/ ang gsum drug la rtags brgyad/ ang bzhi bcu gcig la bkras thags/ ang lnga nyer brgyad 186—213

la kha btags dkyus ma/ dbu chen bzhi la bkras thags/ dbu chung bzhi la dkar chung / par pa byings la shan ja 'khor drug bzhi/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gcig la sa skya nas mang ja lnga/ nyung ja/ bzhes thug /chang tshod brgya dang sum cu/ rtsam mi rer mkhar khal re/ rgyar dod rta pho mo drug /mi nyi shu rer ja sbag re dang / rdor do bskor lag sprod/ 'go pa gnyis so sor mdzod thags / rtas gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ dpon slob gzhon par bsod thags dang dgu tshan/ mgo bar ston dod rtsam ru'i khal brgyad/ sha dod bal ṭam bcu drug /ja sbag rdor bcas/ byings la ston rgyab dgu tshan lnga'i dang po'i mgo tshan / dkar shal gcig la spos shel drug cu dang byu ru drug yod/ yang dkar shal gcig la ngo grangs brgya dang brgyad yod/ spos 'bring ngo grangs bdun cu don bzhi la byu ru bcu bzhi/ mu men lnga/ dngul gyi 'bu sgril drug /spos nar gyi 'phreng ba grang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yod pa/ dmar shal ngo grangs brgya bcu drug yod pa/ kong rna dngul rkang phang bskong ma che ba/ kong rna dngul phom ma cha gcig /mu tig gi mdun chung gser pad g.yu khra gnyis/ yang mu tig gi mdun chung spus legs gser pad g.yu khra ma gnyis/ g.yu che chung gsum/spral g.yu gnyis/ dngul spyi gsum/ nya gcibs kyi 'phreng ba/ lugs shel gyi phreng ba rnams kyi gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ pho rta dkar po res gtsos pa dgu tshan gnyis / gos yug gi gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ gos yug gi gtsos pa'i dgu tshan rnams / zhus dag pa bzhi la bdun tshan/ dbu chen bzhi la dgu tshan/ /dbu chung bzhi la lnga tshan/ mkhas mgyogs ang dang la bdun tshan/ ang gnyis la lnga tshan/ ang gsum drug la bdun tshan/ ang bzhi bcu gcig la bdun tshan/186—214

ang lnga bzhi bcu bskor la bcu gcig tshan/ e phun so so'i slob dpon rgan bcu la bdun tshan re/ dbu chen bzhi/ mkhas mgyogs ang dang / ang gnyis / ang gsum drug /ang bzhi bcu gcig la spa dar/ bla sman par lnga tshan / 'go pa'i gnyer par bdun tshan/ g.yog spyir bdun tshan/ /rtsa gnyer la kha btags/ ja sbag rnams/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la rtsa gnyer zha lu pas mang ja gcig /sro thug gcig /nyung ja/ 'go pa rnams la kha btags re dang / rtsam ru'i khal gnyis/ sha khog /spyir chang tshod brgyad cu gya gsum/zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nas bzung bde chen chos 'khor dgon lag chu bzang sprul skus nyin gsum gyi ring mang ja bdun re dang / 'go pa so sor kha btags re / spyir kha btags che ba/ gser zho gang / bal ṭam bcu gnyis/ par bris brgyad brgya nyi shu/ las byed drug /g.yog bco brgyad bcas la mi gsum rer bal ṭam re/ drug dbang du kha btags dang sman pa/ par g.yog brgya dang dgu la mi rer 'ja'u re dang sman kha/ rdzong dpon so sor bal ṭam gsum res gtsos pa'i 4lnga tshan/ rdzong las byed/ spar g.yog gad pa bcas mi nga drug la 'ja'u re/ mang ja rdor bcas/ nye gnas 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las kyi mang ja gcig zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyer drug la lha shing mchod sbug nas mang ja gsum / 'go pa so sor kha btags/ dbu mdzad sogs la kha btags bdun/zla ba bdun pa'i tshes la shel rdzong skyong nga nas kyi mang ja gsum/ 'bras thug gcig /nyung ja bzhi/ mgo pa so sor mdzod btags/ dbu mdzad dang mkhas mgyogs bcu bdun la kha btags/ byings la gos brgyan bzhi sngon po'i la ba sha nang ling gi byas pa kha gsar/ bur ltang / rtags brgyad kha btags/106—215

chang tshod nyi shu rtsa gsum/ mgo pa'i g.yog spyir lnga tshan/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gnyis nyin bkra shis lhun po nas mang ja lnga/ 'bras thug gcig /chang tshod nyis brgya/ rtsam 'go pa gnyis la khal gsum/ dbu mdzad rnams la rtsam khal gnyis/ byings la rtsam khal re/ sha 'go pa rnam la khog gsum re/dbu mdzad rnams la gnyis re/ byings la sha khog re/ 'go pa gnyis la kha btags che ba/ dngul sung gsum/ spyir rta/ khor drug /khyab kyi gtsos pa'i dgu tshan gsum/ dbu chen gsum la bal ṭam gnyis re/ dbu chung gsum la kha btags re/ byings la dngul bal ṭam/ mkhas mgyogs slob dpon bcas la kha btags che shar re/ byings la ston rgyab gnang tshar bcu gcig tshan bzang ba lnga/ lag g.yog rnams la gnyis dbar du rtsam ru'i khal re/sha lug khog /par pa sogs bzo rigs tshang mar spag rang 'gag /rgyar nyi shu gras rnams/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgu la brgya dpon gling nub pas mang ja lnga/ nyung ja lnga/ mgo pa so sor kha btags re dang / thun mongs su kha btags dang bal ṭam bcu/ g.yog spyir kha thags bzhi dang sman kha bcu drug /mkhas mgyogs nyer gcig la kha btags/ byings la sman kha bdun brgya dang bdun cu don bdun/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu bzhi la brgya dpon bkra shis bde ldan pas mi dbang chen por kha btags dang dngul srang gsum/ mang ja lnga la chung chug bar khag gnyis/ mar khal brgyad/ skya thug gcig la rtsam khal bzhi / phyur ba bre bcu/ 'bras tshwa gcig la 'bras khal bzhi/ rdor lug khog gsum / tshwa bre bco brgyad/ dbu mdzad mkhas dar sogs la kha thags drug cu re gcig /sman kha bdun brgya dang bco brgyad/ mgo par bsod btags re 186—216

dang / thun mong du dngul sung gsum/ zhib do bzhi/ rtsing khal bco lnga/'go pa'i g.yog spyir bal ṭam brgyad kha btags/ sman bar rnams/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin gnya' nang sho sbrel nas/ mang ja bzhi la bzang ja skyed bcad/ mar khal brgyad/ 'bras thug rgyur 'bras gshor khal lnga/rdor lug khog bzhi/ tshwa bre bcu dgu/ par pa spyir 'bras ru'i khal bzhi bcu/dbu mdzad bzhi dang zhus dag pa bzhir kha btags re/ 'go par mdzod btags re dang / thun mongs su bye tang gi gcos pa'i dgu tshan/ 'bras do gcig /'go pa'i g.yog spyir 'bras do dang kha btags rnams/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la sman khab smad pas mang ja bzhir bzang ja skyed bcad/mar khal brgyad/ 'bras thug rgyur 'bras gshor khal lnga/ rdor lug khog bzhi/tshwa phyur/ byings mi re spag rang 'gag /rgyar nyi shu gras/ chang tshod che chung brgya dang brgyad cu/ lag dogs bzhi re/ 'go pa so sor bsod btags re/thun mongs su dngul bal ṭam bzhi bcu/ ja sbag dang / bzo pa byings dang 'go pa'i g.yog bcas la bkras thags re/ dbu mdzad sogs la bal ṭam/lag g.yog brgya skor la sbag rgyar bcas dang sman kha/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyer gsum la ka thog rig 'dzin chen pos mang ja bzhi la bzang ja skyed bcad/mar phyed bzhi bskor/ tshwa bre bcu rnams/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes drug la sgor thong smon pas ston dod bal ṭam brgya tham pa/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin 'bras ljongs padma yang rtse mkhan pos mang ja gnyis la bzang ja sbag /mar khal bzhi nyag brgyad/ tshwa gshor bre bcu rnams/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis la sman khab stod pas mang ja khal gnyis nyag bzhi/ mar khal brgyad dang nyag bcu 106—217

drug /tshwa gshor khal gcig /byings mi grangs don bdun la 'ja'u re/ dbu mdzad bzhi la bkras btags/ mkhas dar sman kha nyer gcig /'go pa so sor kha btags re/ thun mongs su kha btags dang bal ṭam nyi shu/ nyung ja lnga rnams dang / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig gi nyi ma lha rtse 'og min chos sde nas ston dod dngul bal ṭam lnga brgya dang gcig gnang ba bka' 'gyur par brkos grub pa'i rten 'brel bcu gcig tu rang 'grig byung ba lags/gnyis pa zhal 'debs ji ltar byung ba ni/ skal bzang gtong ba la goms pa'i 'phags lam la gnas pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams tshur mthong dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi skur bzhengs pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rigs/ thugs dgongs gcig tu gyur cing chos kyi rgyal po'i bzhed don dbu'i gtsug tor du mchod pa'i gnam sa'i bdag mo nyi zla zung 'brel/tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i 'jings las 'khrungs shing / chab 'bangs gling bzhi'i ri gnas lha sras lcam sring ltos bcas/ dkar nag las kyi rgyu ba chud mi za zhing dkon mchog rin po che skyabs kyi phul dang rtse mor mchod pa'i (ma phyi mi gsal )mchog dman bar mar bcas nas zhal 'debs byung bar/ zhwa ser gyi bstan pa gtsor mchod cing bstod pa dang / rgyal bstan ris med thugs su bcags pa'i khal kha do lo kho gong nas/ rje btsun dam pa sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs thabs dang / mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bskal brgyar 'tsho gzhes kyi slad du dngul srang chig stong / gos yug lnga bcu/ kha btags chig stong /sman yug sum brgya/ srad zhabs drung sku zhabs nas mdzod btags che ba/dngul srang lnga bcu/ pho rta gro sen legs pa/ gseb gro shur phyugs gcig pa/106—218

gtsang snam dkar po bubs lnga brgya/ 'bri g.yag nyis brgya/ lug pho mo gsum stong / pho lha'i yum sku zhabs nas gos kha dog sna tshogs yug sum cu/ tha ma kha sngo rtsid ko khra/ chibs gseb gro dmar nag gsum pas mtshon rta lnga bcu/ lha sras 'gyur med tshe brtan sku zhabs nas dngul rgya ṭam gyi rdo tshad gcig /lha sras 'gyur med rnam rgyal sku zhabs nas/ gseb sngo nag na bzhi pa/ rgod khra so sangs khod song rgad 'ol 'dzin gsum ma/ tsam khra mo legs pa/ rgod gro dmar na lnga ma/ lcam nor 'dzin sku zhabs nas/ kha btags che chung sna tshogs lnga bcu/ dngul srang bco lnga/ pho rta dkar po rgan song / lcam chung sku zhabs nas / gos bdog sna tshogs yug sum cu/ pho rta gro dkar na drug pa/ gro sngon na gcig pa/ pho rta gzag shur na drug pa/ pho rta gro dmar na brgyad pa/dre'u sngon mo na gsum ma/ dre'u chal ma sga pa gcig /dre'u rgya mo sga pa gcig /lcam sku zhabs nas/ kha thags 'dom 'khor/ mdzod gos sngon po yug /rgod dkar mo na dgu ma/ smin grol gling nas/ kha btags che legs/ gos 'o kha yug /ar rti mtha' dmar/ hub ja 'khor drug /gzhung ja 'khor drug /pho rta dkar chen rgan song / pho rta smug po na bdun pa/ pho rta gro dmar so sangs / ma khyab spung sa 'khor ma/ mgron gnyer smu khu bas/ pho rta gra bo rgan song / bka' blon mdo mkhar bas mdzod btags che ba dngul srang sum cu so gcig /na bza' phyi gos sngon 'khor brgya ma nang khi mi ris byas pa/ hor ping ko khra gcig /mdo mkhar gnyer bas bal ṭam gnyis/ rtse sa dang dga' ldan bkra shis chos 'khor mkhan rin po ches/ kha btags ju sa ljang kha bcu/nag chu mkhan pos kha btags/ sman yug bcu/ gos dmar gser gzhi ma 106—219

yug phyag mdzod rab brtan shar pas kha btags/ pad 'dab dngul srang drug cu ri ba/ bya yul nas 'brug pa sprul sku rin po ches dngul srang lnga bcu/rdzong chung spug drag bla mas kha btags/ dngul sung gsum/ nor che chung 'dres pa nyi shu/ dben khang bla ma rgan pas kha btags che 'bring chung gsum brgya dang sum cu so gnyis/ dben khang bla ma gzhon pas/ rta rgod ma dkar mo rgan song gcig /mtshan sgrog mkhan rin po che nas/ mdzod thags che ba/gos u si yug /kha btags che chung nyi shu rtsa lnga me mda'/ sman gsar kha drug 'brel / kha tha dkar sngo leb re/ 'bras spungs tshogs chen dbu mdzad nas/kha btags che shar lnga bcu/ gos kha dog sna tshogs kha lnga bcu/ gos ling ser po'i rnam sbyar/ yum sku zhabs kyi zhal ta ma su mchog gi bal ṭam bdun/lcags sprag pas bal ṭam bdun/ ju rig thu kho sho'u ches kha btags che chung sna tshogs brgya dang bcu/ dngul bal ṭam nyi shu tham pa/ sman gsar kha bdun cu/rgya mda' spus 'bring mtho lnga sor gsum yod pa cha 'brel/ dpa' dam brag gsum lag long shubs bcas/ bya btang kun bzang klong grol gyi bal ṭam bdun / rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sems dpa' sprul sku rin po che nas/ mdzod thags/ bzang gos yug /rta pho mo nyi shu rtsa gsum/ nor pho mo shad yan nyis brgya tham pa/ dngul rta mig ma/dred bla ma gnyis nas bal ṭam brgya tham pa/ bla ma rdo dmar bas bal ṭam brgya tham pa/ la mo chos rje sku rten pas mdzod thags/ gos mang sdug ser po mngags btags gos ldangs/ dngul bal ṭam gyi rdo tshad gsum/ dga' blo'i yang srid bla ma 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rjes/ mdzod btags/ mdzod 106—220

dgos yug /dngul rta mig /khri pa gung thang pa'i sku skyes bsod thags/sman yug /rgya dngul srang bcu/ shel rdzong sman khab smad pas bsod btags 'dom 'khor/ dngul bal ṭam gyi grangs bco lnga/ mgo rnam ser po'i dbu zhwa/gos ljang gi la pa sha /rgya dkar me mda' lcags sbug la tho bzhi yod cha 'grig /gtsang spyi khyab mgo pa pad tshal pas bsod btags/ pho rta gro dkar na dgu pa spus 'bring/ tshwa nas so so nas ru'i brgya re/ gtsang mda' dpon che chen no yon nas/ dngul bal ṭam nyis brgya tham pa/ skyid sbug dbang drung gi dngul bal ṭam gyi srang sum cu so lnga/ bla ma mkhas grub rin po ches dngul sung nyi shu yod pa'i maṇḍal/ gos yug /dga' ldan rab 'byams thogs med kyi mdzod btags / bon grong bsod lhun gyi rta gcig rdzong dkar rdzong sdod mthong smon pa dang gnyer lha btsan nas bal ṭam brgya tham pa/ dga' bzhi nas bal ṭam brgya tham pa/ sman khab stod pas kha btags che ba/ rta rag pa rgan song /bsam gling sprul skus pho rta rag nyams zhan/ shel rdzong skyong nga'i gnyer ba dbang rgyal nas/ kha btags bal ṭam bzhi/ rgya zam sngo skya'i la pa sha /shel long bo ra bas kha btags/ rta drug zho bcad gzeg shur legs pa/ dbus gtsang hor sog gi dmag mi lhor phyin gras la/ gong mas gsol ras su stsal pa zhal 'debs la phul pa dngul srang phyed sum stong dang / gos yug nyi shu/ gtsang spyi'i zhal 'debs thog /bkra shis lhun po nas chos gzhis gsar rnying tshang mas dngul rdo tshad bcu drug dang / sung bco lnga zho lnga/ chos kyi rgyal po pho lha tha'i ji yab sras la pas se/ pas li gung sogs gong ma bdag pos bdag rkyen je mtho je bzang du stsal pa dang / 'brug pa cha zhabs su chug pa'i legs 'bul du/106—221

gtsang drung gzim spos phul ba mi dbang nyid nas/ par brkos zhal 'debs su zong thebs pa dngul rdo tshad bzhi bcu zhe bdun dang / dngul srang sum cu so gcig sgang lnga sgar gyi drug cha gcig dang / 'brong rtse bas bal ṭam nyis brgya dgu bcu tham pa// //sa bcad gsum pa/ bzhengs pa'i gsung par gyi go rims mthar chags su bkod pa ni/ theg pa'i mtho dman gyi dbang du bgyis nas rgyud sde'i skor rnams dang po bkod de/ rim par theg pa che chung gi sde snod rnams go rim gyis 'god pa'i lugs dang / chos 'khor gsum bskor ba'i rim pa dang mthun par bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi nang tshan 'dul ba lung sde bzhi dang por bkod de/ 'chad pa'i lugs gnyis su mchis pa las/ gsung par 'di nyid 'go 'dzugs gnang dus tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang phrigs mthun par ljags bkod gnang zhing /dus phyis mi dbang chos rgyal chen pos 'phro mthud mdzad dus/ shar phyogs ma hā tsi na'i rgyal khab chen po nas rje btsun brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i rang gzugs gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos mi rje 'di nyid la stsal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshal pa'i bka' 'gyur dang phrigs mthun par snang btsu/ de nyid dang go rims mthun par bsgrigs/ tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi nang du thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa'i cho ga zhib mo ma bzhugs pa 'dir gsar 'jug mdzad/ snga sor par dbu 'dzugs kyi dus mdo sde'i nang nas myang 'das pu sti gnyis zur du bzhugs pa dang / nyi khri pu sti bzhi gsum du bsgril par mdzad kyang don khog la khyad par med/ des na rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i skor dang / 'bras bu 106—222

gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i skor gnyis las/ dang po pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i skor la/ gtso che ba'i dbang du bgyis na chos 'khor rim pa gsum du mchis pa'i dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi nang tshan du 'dul ba lung la/lung gzhi/ so thar gyi mdo dang rnam 'byed/ phran tshegs/ gzhung bla ma'am gzhung dam pa ste sde bzhi las/ dang po'i skor la/ka par/ rab byung gi gzhi/ gso sbyong gi gzhi/ dgag dbye'i gzhi/dbyar gnas kyi gzhi/ ko pags kyi gzhi'i stod cha rnams bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya brgyad/kha par/ bam po lnga bcu rtsa bzhi yan la/ ko pags kyi gzhi'i smad cha dang /sman gyi gzhi'i stong cha bzhugs par shog grangs lnga brgya re gsum/ga par/ bam po brgyad cu rtsa gnyis man la sman gyi gzhi'i smad cha/ gos kyi gzhi/ sra brkyang gi gzhi/ kau shambhi'i gzhi/ las kyi gzhi/ dmar ser can gyi gzhi/ gang zag gi gzhi/ spo ba'i gzhi/ gso sbyong bzhag pa'i gzhi/gnas mal gyi gzhi/ rtsod pa'i gzhi/ dbyen gyi gzhi'i stod cha rnams bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya don brgyad/nga par/ dbyen gyi gzhi'i smad cha ste gzhi bcu bdun sho lo ka sum khri nyis stong bdun brgya bam po brgya dang dgus rdzogs pa paṇḍi ta sarba dzñā de wa/ bityā ka ra pra bhra/ dharma ka ra/ bod kyi lo tsā ba bande dpal gyi lhun po rnams kyis bsgyur ba la/ slad kyi paṇḍi ta bityā ka ra pra bha dang lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis yang bskyar zhus dag mdzad pa rnams bzhugs pa'i pu sti 'di nyid la shog grangs bzhi brgya bdun cu/106—223

gnyis pa so thar gyi mdo dang rnam 'byed kyi skor la/ ca par/ dge slong gi khrims nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum mdor bsdus te ston pa so sor thar pa'i mdo sho lo ka bdun brgya bam po gnyis pa/ kha che bye brag tu smra ba'i slob dpon dzi na mi tra dang / lo tsā ba klu'i rgyas mtshan gyi 'gyur/ de rgya cher ston pa'i rnam 'byed bam po nyer gcig pa yan la bam po bzhi lhag ma bcu gsum gyi bcu pa dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa'i stod cha yan bzhugs par/ shog grangs bzhi brgya so dgu/cha par/ bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis yan la/ dge 'dun dbyen gyi smad cha dang / ma nges pa gnyis/ spang ltung sum cu/ ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa dgu bcu'i bcu gcig pa skye ba 'jig pa yan bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya so gcigaja par/ bam po re gnyis yan la bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa nyi shu ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i ltung byed yan bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya zhe druganya par/ sa brko ba'i ltung byed man dang so sor bshags par bya ba bzhi bslab pa'i chos mang po rnams dang / rtsod pa zhi byed kyi chos bdun rnams te sho lo ka nyis khri bzhi stong dgu brgya/ bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum gyis rdzogs pa/sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong 'dra/ pu sti la shog grangs bzhi brgya bcu bdun/ta par/ dge slong ma'i khrims sum brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi bsdus nas ston pa so thar gyi mdo sho lo ka brgyad brgya/ bam po gnyis pa dang / rgyas par ston pa rnam 'byed sho lo ka brgyad stong bzhi brgya/ bam po nyer brgyad pa sgyur byed kyi lo paṇa gong 'dra shog grangs bzhi brgya gya gsum/106—224

gsum pa lung phran tshegs skor la/ tha par/ phran tshegs bam po nyer bdun pa yan bzhugs par shog grangs sum brgya nyer dgu/da par/ bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgus rdzogs pa sho lo ka tshig khri bdun stong brgyad brgya pa/ bibyā ka ra pra bha/ dharma shri pra bha dang lo tsā ba bande dpal 'byor gyis bsgyur bar shog grangs bdun brgya brgyad/bzhi pa gzhung bla ma'i skor la/ na par/ zhu ba ma rdzogs pa sho lo ka chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya bam po bcu gnyis nas/ zhu ba rdzogs pa sho lo ka chig khri lnga stong dgu brgya'i bam po nyer gnyis pa yan bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya nga brgyad/pa par/ zhu ba rdzogs pa bam po nyer gsum pa nas bam po lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa yan bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya don gsum/ de ltar lung sde bzhi gcig tu dril pa'i gzhung tshad bam po sum brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bam po'i sum cha gcig /sho lo kur phye na tshig 'bum bzhi stong brgyad brgya la bzhugs par sgyur byed lo tsā ba klu'i rgyal mtshan gyi dus su bsgyur zhes pa tsam las lo paṇa gyi gsal kha ma byung /gnyis pa bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor gyi nang tshan las sher phyin bye ba phrag brgya pa la sogs pa ni bod du ma 'gyur mod/ deng sang yongs su grags pa 'bum du brjod pa'i sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa bam po sum brgya dang le'u don gnyis/ sho lo ka chig 'bum gyi bdag nyid can du bzhugs shing dkar chag 'ga' zhig nas bam po sum brgya dang gsum/ le'u bdun cu rtsa 106—225

lngar bshad pa'ang yod/ pu sti bcu gnyis su byed pa dang bcu bzhir byed pa sogs mchis pa las/ 'dir snga ma'i dbang du bgyis te bzhugs par/ka par/ bam po dang po nas nyer bzhi bar la shog grangs lnga brgya zhe gnyis/kha par/ bam po nyer lnga nas lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi bar la shog grangs lnga brgya so gnyis/ga par/ lnga bcu gnyis nas bdun cu rtsa brgyad bar la shog grangs lnga brgya don gsum/nga par/ bdun cu rtsa dgu nas brgya gsum pa'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya bcu dgu/ca par/ brgya bzhi pa nas brgya nyer dgu'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya so gnyis/cha par/ sum cu tham pa nas brgya nga gsum bar la shog grangs lnga brgya so gnyis/ja par/ brgya nga bzhi nas brgya don lnga'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya so lnga/nya par/ brgya don drug nas nyis brgya gnyis pa'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya zhe bzhi/ta par/ nyis brgya gsum pa nas nyis brgya nyer brgyad bar la shog grangs lnga brgya nyer brgyad/tha par/ nyis brgya nyer dgu nas nyis brgya nga bzhi'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya zhe gcigad par/ nyis brgya nga lnga nas nyis brgya don bdun bar la shog grangs lnga 186—226

brgya so gcigan par/ nyis brgya don brgyad nas sum brgya tham pa'i bar gyi rdzogs par shog grangs lnga brgya so drug /yum rgyas pa 'di la rlangs khams pa go cha/ bai ro tsā na/ lce khyi 'brug /zhang ye shes sde la sogs pa'i 'gyur byang drug yod par grags pa tsam las/ dpe phal cher la mi 'dug go/yum 'bring po'i rgyas pa stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa pu sti gsum gyi/ ka par/ bam po dang po nas nyer bdun bar la shog grangs lnga brgya zhe bdun/kha par/ nyer brgyad nas nga gnyis bar la shog grangs lnga brgya zhe lnga/ga par/ nga gsum nas brgyad cu rtsa gsum gyi rdzogs par shog grangs lnga brgya zhe gsum/ nyi khri yongs su rdzogs par bam po brgyad cu rtsa gsum/ sman lung pa'i gsan yig dang tshal pa dkar chag sogs su/ bam po bdun cu rtsa brgyad du bshad / gong sa lnga pa'i gsan yig tu sho lo ka brgya zhes gsungs na'ang stong phrag nyi shu lnga pa zhes pa sho lo kur 'jog dgos pas nyi khri lnga stong yod cing/le'u bdun cu rtsa drug 'gyur byang ma rnyed/'bring po'i 'bring po khri brgyad stong pa pu sti gsum gyi/ ka par/ bam po dang po nas nyer lnga bar la shog grangs lnga brgya bcu bzhi/kha par/ nyer drug nas lnga bcu tham pa'i bar la shog grangs lnga brgya zhe bzhi/ga par/ nga gcig nas drug cu tham pa'i bar gyi rdzogs par shog grangs nyis brgya bcu gsum/ sher phyin 'di la bam po drug cu le'u brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/brje ye shes sde sogs kyis bsgyur/ le'u brgyad cu rtsa gnyis dang brgyad cu rtsa bdun du bshad pa'ang yod/186—227

'bring gi bsdus pa/ shes rab khri pa/ ka par/ bam po sum cu rtsa bzhi/le'u so gsum/ sho lo ka brgya pa paṇḍi ta dzi na mi tra/ pradzñā warma/ lo tsā ba ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ bam po sum cu par bshad pa'ang yod/ 'ga' zhig tu pu sti gnyis su byed kyang / 'dir gcig tu dril bar shog grangs drug brgya bcu gsum/yum bsdus pa'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi dbye ba ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba mang na'ang / 'dir btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa/ ka par/ bam po nyer bzhi/ le'u so gnyis/ sho lo ka brgyad stong / paṇḍi ta shākya se na dang / dzñā na sirnyi/ lo tsā ba dharmā tā shī las bsgyur bar slad kyi paṇḍi ta su bhā ṣi ta dang lo chen rin chen bzang pos 'grel pa dang mthun par bsgyur/ lo chen de dang jo bo a ti shas dbus kyi 'grel pa dang bstun nas 'gyur bcos mdzad/ snye thang na mo cher jo bo yab sras kyis brgyad stong pa 'chad skabs che long zhig gtan la phab/ slar 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rgya dpe gsum dang gtugs nas/ ra sgreng du zhus dag lan gnyis mdzad/ phyis rngog lo blo ldan shes rab kyis kha che dang yul dbus kyi rgya dpe du ma bsags nas zhus chen mdzad/ slar yang zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang pos shin tu dag par bcos te/ gtan la phab pa'i shog grangs bzhi brgya re gnyis/ brgyad stong pa la phreng ba can dang / bzo sbyangs/ sde can te gsum du byung ba/ mi gcig la ming mi 'dra ba gsum byung ba lta bu yin zhes snga rabs pa dag 'chad kyang de ltar na/ phreng ba can yang bzo sbyangs dang / sde can yin dgos par 'gyur mod/ 'dir ni de ltar khas mi blang ste/ phreng ba 186—228

can du lha'i me tog dang / lha'i bdug spos zhes pa lta bus mtshon tshig sna rgyas pa dang / gzhan gnyis su lha'i me tog dang / bdug pa zhes pa lta bus mtshon te tshig sna bsdus par yod pas/ tshig sna ring thung gi khyad par dang / zha lu lo chen gyis se niṣka zhes byung na sde can/ sha niṣka byung na bzo sbyangs/ pra niṣka byung na phreng ba can du bsgyur gsungs pa ltar/ mgo bo'i mtshan yang mi 'dra ba gnyis ka tshogs pa'i sgo nas der 'dogs shing / 'bum/ nyi khri/ khri brgyad stong pa/ shes rab khri pa sogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum kur phreng ba can la sogs ba'i dbye ba yod ces gsungs so//sher phyin sna tshogs pa'i skor la/ rab rtsal rnam gnon gyis zhus pa bam po bdun pa/ sho lo ka drug cu/ le'u bdun pa shi lend+ra bo dhi dang dzi na mi tra/bande ye shes sde rnams kyis skad gsar bcad kyi sgo nas bcos pa/ sher phyin bdun brgya pa dkon brtsegs kyi 'dus pa zhe drug pa las byung ba 'gyur gong 'dra/sher phyin lnga brgya pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ sher phyin sdud pa bam po gcig dang /sho lo ka nyis brgya pa khri brgyad stong pa'i le'u tha ma las byung ba/ paṇḍi ta birya ka ra sidha dang lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ sher phyin sum brgya pa'am rdo rje gcod pa bam po gcig pa shi lend+ra bo dhi dang ye shes sdes skad gsar bcad kyis bcos te bsgyur ba/ sher phyin tshul brgya lnga bcu pa rgyud 'bum gyi khongs su bzhed kyang 'dir ma phyi bzhin bkod/ sher phyin mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/sher phyin lnga bcu pa/ sher phyin yi ge gcig ma/ sher phyin ko'u shi ka /sher phyin yi ge zhung ngu / sher phyin sgo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa rgyud 'bum gyi khongs su bzhed kyang ma phyi bzhin bkod/ shes rab snying po sho lo ka nyer lnga pa/ paṇḍi ta bi ma 186—229

la mi tra dang / rin chen sde'i 'gyur/ bi ma las dag par mdzad nas bsam yas dge rgyas kyi dkor khang gi gdong la gleng gzhi'i bkod pa dang bcas bris pa las gtugs te bkod pa/ sher phyin nyi ma'i snying po/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po / sher phyin kun tu bzang po/ sher phyin lag na rdo rje/ sher phyin rdo rje rgyal mtshan rnams la pu sti gcig tu dril bar shog grangs nyis brgya bdun cu/gsum pa tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i nang tshan las byung ba sangs rgyas phal po che'am/ snyan gyi gong rgyan dang padma'i rgyan dang / shin tu rgyas pa'i mdo'am rma ga chad dang / rmag chad dang smad chad sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma'i sgo nas bsnyad pa pu sti drug tu longs par/ka par/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi rgyan gyi le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i le'u/ kun tu bzang po'i ting nge 'dzin dang rnam 'phrul gyi le'u dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i le'u/ gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i yon tan gyi le'u/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho 'khor yug gi rgyan bstan pa'i le'u/ sa gzhi'i rgyan bstan pa'i le'u/ zhing gi rgyud bstan pa'i le'u / 'jig rten gyi rgyud dgod pa'i le'u/ rnam snang gi le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa phal po che'i le'u/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bstan pa'i le'u/ 'phags pa'i bden pa'i le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer las sangs rgyas pa'i le'u / byang chub sems dpas bris pa snang ba'i le'u/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa'i le'u/ bzang po'i dpal gyi le'u/ ri rab kyi rtse mor gshegs pa'i le'u/byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'i le'u/ byang chub sems 106—230

dpa'i rnam par dgod pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u rnams bzhugs par/ shog grangs sum brgya gya bzhi/kha par/ tshangs par spyod pa'i le'u/ sems dang po bskyed pa'i bsod nams ston pa'i le'u/ chos snang ba'i le'u/ mtshe ma'i gnas kyi le'u/ der byang sems 'dus pas tshigs bcad bstan pa'i le'u/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ gter mi zad pa bcu bstan pa'i le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gshegs bzhugs bzhud gsum ston pa'i le'u/ dga' ldan du byang sems 'dus pa'i le'u/ 'di yan la bam po sum cu rtsa gcig bzhugs/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i le'u las/ bam po sum cu rtsa gnyis pa nas bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa yan bzhugs par shog grangs sum brgya gya lnga/ga par/ de'i 'phros las bam po bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa nas bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa yan la bam po sum cu/ sa bcu pa'i le'u/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ ting 'dzin bcu'i le'u/ mngon shes kyi le'u/ bzod pa'i le'u / grangs la 'jug pa'i le'u/ tshad kyi le'u/ byang sems kyi gnas kyi le'u rnams bzhugs par shog grangs sum brgya go gcigang par/ sangs rgyas kyi bsam mi khyab bstan pa'i le'u/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor rgya mtsho bstan pa'i le'u/ dpe byad kyi 'od zer bstan pa'i le'u/ kun bzang gi spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba dang 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u rnams bzhugs par shog grangs sum brgya don lnga/ca par/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u'i 'phros dang sdong pos brgyan 186—231

pa'i le'u'i stod cha/ phal chen gyi bam po brgyad cu rtsa drug pa nas bam po brgya pa yan bzhugs par shog grangs sum brgya go bdun/cha par/ de'i 'phro las bam po brgya dang bcu bzhi yan gyi bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam dang bcas pas phal po che yongs su rdzogs pa paṇḍi ta su rend+ra bo dhi dang lo tsā ba chen po bai ro tsa na rakṣi tas bsgyur ba/ bam po brgya dang sum cu bzhugs par shog grangs sum brgya bzhi bcu/ phal chen 'di la 'ga' zhig nas bam po brgya dang bco lnga/ sho lo ka sum khri dgu stong sum cur bshad pa yang mchis so/ /bu ston chos 'byung dang / gsung rab gzhan dag tu/ snyan gyi gong rgyan sogs sngar phal chen gyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs su bshad pa de dag 'chad par (ma phyi mi gsal )/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang / rgyal ba lnga pa chen po la sogs pa tshad ldan gyi dam pa du mas bshad ma thag pa ltar bzhed do//'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa pu sti drug tu 'dus pa 'phags yul du le'u stong phrag brgya bzhugs pa las bod 'dir le'u bzhi bcu rtsa dgu 'gyur ba'i/ka par/ sdom pa gsum bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra bo dhi / ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ la lar bam po phyed bzhi/ sho lo ka bcu zhes bshad pa'ang mchis/ sgo mtha' yas pa rnam par sbyong ba'i mdo bam po bzhi pa su rend+ra bo dhi dang / dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u nyer lnga pa dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ mu ne warma / ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ 'ga' zhig tu bam bo bcu gcig /shlau ka nyis brgyar bshad pa'ang mchis/ rmi lam bstan pa bam po gsum pa dkar chag ldan dkar mar shlau ka stong dang / rig ral gyis shlau ka brgya/ gong sa lnga pa'i 106—232

gsan yig tu bam po so gsum zhes byung bas bstan no/ /'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod kyi mdo bam po gsum pa dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde rnams kyis bsgyur ba bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya zhe brgyad/kha par/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod kyi mdo bam po lnga dang le'u drug pa/shlau ka bzhi bcu/ dzi na mi tra dang / su rend+ra bo dhi/ ye shes sde rnams kyis bsgyur ba/ go cha'i bkod pa bstan pa'i mdo/ bam po drug pa/ 'gos chos grub kyi 'gyur/ mdo rang la bam po lnga las med gsung bas brtag /chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin dbyer med par bstan pa bam po gnyis dang shlau ka lnga bcu/le'u dgu pa dang / chos bcu pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ 'ga' zhig tu bam po gcig dang shlau ka nyis brgya/ la lar shlau ka lnga brgya/ kun mkhyen lnga pa'i gsan yig tu/ bam po phyed dang gnyis pa/ shlau ka lnga bcu zhes bshad cing mdo rang du bam po gnyis nges par 'dug gsung ste ye shes sdes bsgyur/ kun nas sgo'i le'u bam po gcig pa shlau ka nyis brgya drug cu pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra bo dhi/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ 'od zer bkye ba'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ye shes sde'i 'gyur rnams bzhugs par shog grangs bzhi brgya gnyis/ga par/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod bstan pa bam po nyi shu le'u bcu gcig /'ga' zhig ni bcu gnyis su bshad pa'ang mchis te/ zhang chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ dga' bo mngal 'jug gi mdo bam po gcig pa 'gos chos grub kyi 'gyur/ dga' bo mngal gnas kyi mdo bam po gsum pa ldan dkar mar bam po gnyis dang / lnga pa'i gsan yig tu bam po so gsum par gsungs te bar khyad bong bu'i mgo tsam du che'o/ shog grangs bzhi brgya don bdun/106—233

nga par/ 'jam dpal gyi zhing gi bkod pa'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ tshal pa dkar chag tu phyed bzhi/ chos 'byung rnams su bam po gsum pa/ shlau ka nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhes bshad cing / dpa' bo'i gsan yig tu bam po gsum dang /shlau ka brgya bzhi bcur bshad/ shī lend+ra bo dhi/ dzi na mi tra/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo bam po bco lnga dang / le'u nyer bdun pa/shī lend+ra bo dhi/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/bcom ldan ral gris shlau ka nyis brgya lnga bcu lhag por yod gsung / gang pos zhus pa bam po drug dang / le'u brgyad pa/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa bam po gsum dang / shlau ka brgya/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ mu ne warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyis bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya don brgyad/ca par/ drag shul can gyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po phyed gsum/ ldan dkar mar shlau ka bdun brgya lnga bcu pa/ chos 'byung rnams su bam po gnyis dang shlau ka brgya lnga bcu/ sman lung pa'i gsan yig tu bam po gnyis dang / shlau ka brgya dang bcu/ dpa' bo'i gsan yig tu shlau ka lnga bcu zhes byung / su rend+ra bo dhi dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ glog stobs kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ sgyu ma mkhan bzang po lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig dang shlau ka brgya sum cu pa/ 'ga' zhig tu shlau ka brgyad brgya gya gsum zhes 'byung / dzi na mi tra/ pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur / cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i mdo lha'i bu ded dpon gyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ byams pa seng ge sgra'i mdo bam po bzhi pa/ nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ lhag bsam bskul ba'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/106—234

dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra bo dhi/ pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ lag bzang gis zhus pa bam po gnyis dang / shlau ka brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu shlau ka brgya/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu shlau ka brgya nyer brgyad/ces gsung / dzi na mi tra/ dā na shrī la/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ khyim bdag dpal sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la / ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu 'gyur gong 'drar bshad / bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed kyis zhus pa'i mdo shlau ka gnyis brgya pa/bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ blo gros bzang mo'i mdo bam po phyed pa kun mkhyen bus shlau ka nyis brgyar bzhed/'gyur gong 'dra/ bu mo gaṅga'i mchog gis zhus pa shlau ka brgyad cu pa/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu bam po phyed ces 'byung / dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ mya ngan med byin lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ gong dkar ba'i gsan yig tu bam po phyed/ sman lung ba'i gsan yig tu shlau ka sum brgya zhes 'byung / dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la/ ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'phags pa dri ma med kyis byin pa lung bstan pa'i mdo/ bam po gnyis pa/ tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po phyed gnyis/ ldan dkar ma dang bus bam po gcig dang shlau ka brgya lnga bcu/ sman lung pas shlau ka brgya dang bco lnga/zhes 'chad de/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra bo dhi/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/yon tan rin po che me tog kun nas rgyas pa'i mdo shlau ka brgya bzhi bcu pa/bcom ldan ral gris bam po phyed gnyis/ gong dkar bas bam po phyed ces gsung / dzi na mi tra/ pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas 186—235

kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra/dā na shī la/ mu ne warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyis bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya don gsum/cha par/ lha'i bu blo gros rab gnas kyis zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba/ seng ges zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka drug cu pa/dā na shī la/ mu ne warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas kyi gsang chen thabs mkhas kyi mdo ye shes dam pas zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ dā na shī la/kurma warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ tshong dpon bzang skyong gis zhus pa/dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra bo dhi/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ bu mo rnam dag dad pas zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po gcig dang phyed gdam nga / ldan dkar mar shlau ka brgya lnga bcu/ sman lung pas shlau ka lnga bcur bshad / byams pas zhus pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ mdo rang la bam po phyed de shlau ka brgyad cu rtsa gsum yod gsung / dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra bo dhi/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ byams pas zhus pa'i chos brgyad pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/tshal pa dkar chag tu shlau ka bdun cu/ gong dkar bas shlau ka brgyad cu gya gsum/'ga' zhig shlau ka sum brgya/ la la brgyad cur 'dod pa/ 'ga' zhig 'gyur gong 'drar bshad kyang lnga pa'i gsan yig tu su rend+ra'i tshab tu dā na shī la byung /'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ mdor bam po gnyis yod gsung / dzi na mi tra/ shī len dra bo dhi/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ rin po che'i phung po lung bstan pa'i mdo bam po gnyis dang shlau ka brgyad cu/ tshal pa dkar chag shlau ka brgyad cu/ mdo rang du bam po gnyis kho na las med gsung /186—236

su ren dra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ blo gros mi zad pa'i zhus pa lung bstan pa'i mdo shlau ka nyis brgya pa/ mdor bam po gcig yod gsung / sher phyin bdun brgya pa bam po gnyis dang sho lo ka brgya/ su ren dra dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/gtsug na rin chen gyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa/ ka ma la shī la dang / chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ mdo rang gi nang du/ su rend+ra/ dharma tā shī la/ye shes sde gsum gyis bsgyur/ zhes yod gsung / lha mo dpal 'phreng gi seng ge'i sgra bstan pa bam po gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ drang srong rgyas pas zhus pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sdes bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya gya dgu/ mdo rang du/ dā na shī la'i tshab tu/ su rend+ra yod gsung /'khor lo gsum po ci rigs par gtogs pa'i theg pa sna tshogs kyi mdo sde rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa pu sti sum cur longs pa'i/ ka par/bskal bzang bam po nyer drug pa/ shlau ka bdun stong brgyad brgya/ paṇḍi ta bityā ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba dpal dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba/ ka ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus dag mdzad par shog grangs lnga brgya zhe bdun/ bskal bzang 'di la dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng bas mdor bstan du sangs rgyas stong tshang la rgyas bshad dang thugs bskyed du stong phrag lhag chad du gyur pa yod/ bskal bzang gi mdo dag las mang zhig la brtag dgos yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal tshab grags pa don grub kyis zhus dag nan gyis mdzad par grags pa'i gra skor na bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur dkar chag tu 'di bzhin byung ste/ 'di'i 106—237

phyi mo la glegs bam brgyad dang bsdur te zhus dag thog ma bgyis skabs/ thams cad mnyam chad kyis hor khongs dang tshig zur la/ zhus dag bskyar ma dgos pa mang du byung ba rnams zin tho byas te glegs bam 'di nyid kyi zhus dag gi phyir/'phyong rgyas/ gri gu/ tshar gu rnams kyi bka' 'gyur khrod na bzhugs pa'i bskal bzang sogs slar yang phyi mo brgyad dgu tsam la gtugs pa las/ ji ltar snyed pa dag so sor bcug kyang / da dung tshig zur bsdur dgos dang hor khongs ma gsobs pa la/ bam po gsum par lhag mthong la dmigs pa'i phar phyin drug gi brtson 'grus pu sti gsum nas rnyed pa mthun par bsam gtan dang tshig don bldabs pa las phar phyin gyi ming so sor sbyar ba 'di dag yin nam/cibartson 'grus rang la tshig don khyad par ba zhig yod da dung btsal dgos pa dang /bam po bcu gsum par/ de bzhin gshegs pa padma'i ngos dang gtsug na rin po che'i sku tshe'i tshad ma byung ba btsal zhing / yang bam po bcu gsum par/ de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag med kyi 'khor la byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpag tu med do/ /zer ba'i thams cad ces pa lhag gam brtag rgyu dang de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen spos bzang gi chos gnas tshad la/ mgon po mchog ma mya ngan 'das nas kyang / /mgon po mchog ma'i dam chos gnas par 'gyur/ /gsungs pa las sangs rgyas gzhan gyi rigs 'gre ltar na lo grangs shig yong thang ba ma byung ba dang / bam po bco lnga par de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer chen po'i sku che'i tshad ma byung ba/ bam po bcu drug par/ de bzhin gshegs pa bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sku tshe'i tshad ma byung ba/ bam po bcu bdun par/ de bzhin gshegs pa gser 'od kyi sku gdung dang mchod rten gyi tshul ma byung ba/ bam po 186—238

bcu dgu par/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos sbyin gyi 'khor lo/ 'dus pa ni lan nyi shu rtsa lnga ste thams cad la'ang nyi shu nyi shu'o/ /zhes 'byung ba 'di la sangs rgyas gzhan gyi rigs 'gre ltar na brgya stong khri 'bum lta bu'i 'gyur zhig yong thang ba dang / bam po nyer gnyis par/ 'jig rten dga' dang dga' ba mtha' yas pa'i bar na de bzhin gshegs pa chos (ma phyi mi gsal )rim gyis chad pa rnams da dung phyi mo mang po la gtugs te rnyed na gzhug dgos pa yod cing / gzhan yang bam po nyer gsum pa (ma phyi mi gsal )thugs bskyed kyi skor la/ gong mdo nyid kyi mtshan bshad skabs dang / kha che'i paṇḍi ta shākya shri'i zhal snga nas kyi mdzad pa'i bskal bzang rgyan 'phreng gnyis zhal grangs 'grig par/ sangs rgyas stong dang gnyis la mdo so so'i rnam thar bshad skabs/ bam po bcu drug par/ de bzhin gshegs pa thugs gzhungs dang rgya mtshos byin gyi bar na 'od dpag med ces bgyi ba dang / bam po bcu bdun par/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsod nams 'od zer dang / smrang don gyi bar na 'od zer bzang po zhes pa gnyis so so'i rnam thar dang bcas te lhag por byung ba ltar na stong dang bzhir 'gyur ba de snyed kyi thugs bskyed kyang tshang dgos rgyu la/ skabs gong ma gnyis su mtshan dang rnam thar yod pa la thugs bskyed ma byung ba/ bam po nyer gsum par/ glog 'od dang ye shes byin gyi bar na gser gyi ri bo/ nor 'od dang chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bar na ri bo brtsegs pa'i tog /bam po nyer bzhi par/ dpal 'od dang go bgos kyi bar na bdud 'dul/ bsnyengs bral dang sgra gcan lha'i bar na rin chen snying po/ zla ba'i zhal/ dri med grags pa/ zhi ba'i gzi brjid/dga' ba'i tog ste lnga/ bam po nyer lnga par/ chu lha dang seng yog gi bar na 106—239

'gros mchong / mchod 'os dang nyi ma'i bar na skar rgyal/ 'od zer dra ba dang bai ḍūrya snying gi bar na rnam par bcom pa/ gser 'od dang lha'i yon tan gyi bar na legs byin/ bam po nyer drug par tog ldan dang yul 'khor spobs pa'i bar na bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ thar pa'i rgyal mtshan dang bdud rtsi'i 'od kyi bar na dge ba'i gtsug /'od spyod dang 'khor lo 'dzin gyi bar na glu dbyangs gnyis yod pa'i gcig /chos sgron dang shugs 'dor gyi bar na shin tu gzigs rnams ma byung bas chad pa bcu drug dang / skabs gong ma gnyis su mtshan dang rnam thar med pa la 'dir thugs bskyed lhag po/ bam po nyer drug par / zla dgyes dang seng stobs kyi bar na khengs med/ dag 'od dang yon tan gtsug gi bar na 'od shugs/ dran dbang dang thogs med rgyal mtshan gyi bar na zhal bzang rnams yod cing / gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa snyan pa tog la snyan pa dang tog /chos kyi 'byung gnas don nges ldan pa la chos kyi 'byung gnas dang don nges ldan pa/ bsod nams sgrol ma la/ bsod nams dang chos kyi sgron ma/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs la/ 'jam dbyangs dang mgon po zhes so sor bgrangs pa'i thugs bskyed re re rnams theb tu byung bas/ yongs dril lhag po bdun byung ba rnams gong gi chad pa bcu drug po gang gi zhal tshab tu gang 'jug gi dgongs pa ci lta ba bzhin lon par ma nus na'ang / spyi sdom gyi zhal grangs la brtsis pas kyang / thugs bskyed la sangs rgyas dgu brgya dang go gcig las ma byung ba/ da dung sangs rgyas bcu gcig gam bcu gsum gyi thugs bskyed ma tshang ba sogs kyi hor khongs 'di rnams/ bod 'dir bar skabs shig nas bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis byung bar zad pa las/ ston pa bcom 106—240

ldan 'das dang bka'i bsdu ba bo 'phags pa kun dga' bo dag la 'khrul pa dang bsnyel ba gtan mi mnga' yang / lo pan byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang chos kyi spyan ldan sha stag byon pas/ rgya dpe sogs sngon gyi dpe dag pa rnams cha tshang ba yod nges pas/ gong du 'di chad kyi mtshan smos pa rnams gang gi ji ltar yin / slar yang phyi mo mang po la gtugs shing btsal te rnyed na so sor bcug pas tshang bar bya dgos pa yod pa de'i phyir/ 'di dag bdag gi dad brtson gyis / /ston pa de yi drin gzo zhing / /bstan la phan pa gdags pa'i slad/ /'bad de btsal bar bya 'dod kyang / /lnga brgya tha mar phyin pas na/ /rin chen chos rnyed dkon pa dang / /ston seng thub pa'i nam zla bzhin/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba'ang rdung nye bas/ /ji ltar yong yong ma 'tshal mod/ /de lta na 'ang bcom ldan de'i/ /thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i mthus/ /'jig rten 'dir yang ring 'tsho zhing / /bstan la bya ba byed pa dang / /skye ba gzhan du'ang rdzogs sangs rgyas / /kun la mdo 'di'i don zhus te/ /de la thos bsam sgom byed cing / /sems can rnams la ston par smon/ /de bzhin dad brtson shes rab kyis/ /phyug pa'i skyes bu gzhan gang su/ /rang gi 'ol tshod ma yin par/ /sgra dang nang don rig shes pas/ /'phags pa'i yul dang gangs can gyi/ /glegs bam dag pa las rnyed pa'i/ /tshig dang don gyi mdo sde 'di'i/ /lhag chad skong bar nus pa la/ /bskul zhing rjes su yi rang 'bul/ /zhes kyang smra'o/ /zhes bka' stsal pa bzhin dang / der yang ma thebs pa bam po bcu bdun pa'i mgo'i sangs rgyas gcig gi rjes ma/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyan sdug gi dam chos gnas tshad dang sku gdung mchod rten gyi tshul ma byung ba rnams slad nas blo gros kyi rtsal 106—241

dang ldan pa'i mkhas dbang dag gis dpyad pa gsum gyis dag par mdzad dgos 'dug cing / gong gi bam po bcu gsum par padma'i ngos kyi sku'i tshe'i tshad/bam po bcu drug par bkod pa'i rgyal po'i sku che'i tshad/ bam po bcu bdun par gser gyi 'od kyi sku gdung gi tshul ma tshang ba rnams dpe gzhan nas rnyed pa so so'i nang du bcug yod cing / bam po bco brgyad par spos kyi gzi brjid kyi 'od kyi tshad thog ma'i zhu dag mdzad skabs ma rnyed pa/ phyis dpe gzhan nas rje grags pa don grub de nyid rang gis 'jug par mdzad pa la/ 'od dpag tshad bzhi stong ngo / /zhes 'dug kyang / dpe la lar dpag tshad brgyad brgya'o zer ba'ang 'dug pas zhib tu brtag par bya'o/ /zhes rgyal tshab drug pa dpal nor bu bzang pos chu shur du bzheng bar mdzad pa'i bka' 'gyur rin po che da lta g.yo ru khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang chen por bzhugs pa de'i dkar chag tu byung ngo //kha par/ rgya cher rol pa bam po bco brgyad dang le'u nyer bdun pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ mu ne warma/ ye shes sde bzhi'i 'gyur/ 'jam dpal rnam par rol pa'i mdo/ bam po gnyis pa/ su rend+ra bo dhi dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur / 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul ba'i mdo/ bam po gcig /le'u bdun pa/ shlau ka dgu bcu rtsa bzhi/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu blo ka go gcig ces gsungs / shi lend+ra bo dhi/ dzi na mi tra/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis sems can la gzigs shing zhing kun tu ston pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra bo dhi/ ye shes sde/ klu'i rgyal mtshan rnams kyis bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya nyi shu rtsa drug /mdo rang du bam tshad kyi gsal kha med ces tshur phu rgyal tshab pas gsung ngo / /mkhas pa'i 106wa 242

dbang po kha cig ni/ 'di rgyud kho nar rigs te gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi de dag gang lags/ zhes pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa/ rig sngags 'chang dag par dbugs 'byin par bgyis la sngar bsnyen pa byas la/ zhes dang /ras ris kyang bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs/ga par/ ye shes rgyas pa'i mdo sde rin po che mtha' yas pa mthar phyin pa/bam po nyer lnga pa/ pradzñā warma dang / ye shes sdes bsgyur bar/ slar bi shu dha sidha dang sarba dzñā de wa/ ska ba dpal brtsegs rnams kyis zhus te gtan la phabs pa / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan/ bam po gsum dang shlau ka lnga bcu pa/ su rend+ra dang / ye shes sdes bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya drug cu re drugang par/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo bam po bco brgyad dang le'u bco lnga pa/ pradzñā warma dang / lo tsā ba legs pa'i sdes bsgyur ba/ slad kyi pradzñā warma/ dzñā na garbha/ ye shes sde gsum gyis zhus dag mdzad pa/ 'phags pa zung gi mdo'i chos kyi rnam grangs bam po bzhi pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pas bstan pa'i chos kyi rnams grangs shlau ka nyis brgya bdun cu pa/ su rend+ra dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs phal chen nas zur du bkol bas shlau ma'i grangs dang 'gyur byang mi gsal lo/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs shlau ka drug bcu pa/ su rend+ra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur la shog grangs bzhi brgya bzhi bcu zhe bzhi/ 'di rgyud 'bum gyi nang du yod gsung /106—243

ca par/ 'phags pa dgongs pa nges par 'grel ba'i mdo/ bam po bzhi pa / le'u bcu pa/ gong dkar bas le'u dgu zhes bzhed kyang / le'u bcu pa nyid 'thad de/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ don zab dgongs pa nges 'grel dang /tshul bzhin du kun tu 'dri ba gnyis kyi le'u/ chos 'phags kyi le'u/ blo gros rnam dag gi le'u/ blo gos yangs pa'i le'u/ yon tan 'byung gnas kyi le'u/don dam yang dag 'phags kyi le'u/ byams pa'i le'u/ spyan ras gzigs kyi le'u / 'jam dbyangs kyi le'u rnams su yod pas 'khrul pa med/ mdo rang du bam grangs mi 'dug gsung / lang kur gshegs pa'i mdo bam po dgu dang /le'u brgyad pa/ rdo rje gdan pa dang sman lung pas le'u drug ces gsung /dkar chag rnying pa rnams nas bam po bcu gcig pa zhes 'byung / lang kur gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po'i le'u bam brgyad ma/ 'gos chos grub kyis rgya nag gi slob dpon wen nyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa dang sbyar nas rgya nag nas bsgyur ba/ ga ya go ri'i mdo shlau ka brgya dang brgyad cu gya brgyad pa/ su rend+ra dang ye shes sdes bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya re brgyad/cha par/ rgyan sdug po bkod pa ji snyed pa'i mdo bam po bzhi dang le'u dgu pa / gong dkar bas be'u brgyad pa/ tshur phu rgyal tshab pas mdor dgu pa'i ming med gsung / dzi na mi tra/ shī lend+ra/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ snying rje chen po pad ma dkar po bam po drug dang / le'u bcu gsum 'gyur gong 'dra/snying rje pad dkar bam po bco lnga pa/ le'u drug pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra/pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde bzhis bsgyur ba shog grangs bzhi brgya zhe gsum/ mdo 105—244

rang du le'u drug pa'i tha snyad med gsung /ja par/ dam chos pad dkar bam po bcu gsum/ le'u bdun pa/ su rend+ra dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po shlau ka bzhi brgya pa/ pradzñā warma/ su rend+ra/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ bu sogs dkar chag sngon ma rnams su bam po drug bcas gsung na'ang / phyi rabs rnams dpyad bzhir mdzad do/ /bde ba can gyi bkod pa shlau ka sum cu pa/'gyur gong 'dra/ 'di la lnga pa'i gsan yig tu shlau ka sum cu/ (ma phyi mi gsal )brgya sum cu/ sma na lung pa dang / dpa' bo gtsug 'phreng gis brgya lhag tsam du bzhed/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo bam po phyed lnga le'u gnyis pa/ gong dkar bas bam po bzhir bshad/ dkon mchog gi za ma tog bam po bzhi pa/ratna rakṣi tas bsgyur zhing / 'ga' zhig shākya pra bha dang / lo tsā ba rin chen mtshos bsgyur gsung / rin po che'i mtha'i mdo shlau ka nyis brgya bcu pa/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig nyis brgya bcu gnyis/ 'ga' zhig nyis brgya brgyad cur 'chad/dzi na mi tra/ pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya don bzhi/nya par/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo le'u khri lnga stong las/lha dang mi la sogs pas zhus pa'i le'u/ bam po bcu gsum dang / le'u lnga pa/dzi na mi tra/ dzñā na garbha/ de wa tsand+ra'i 'gyur/ tshal pa dkar chag tu le'u khri zhes pa las ma byung / 'ga' zhig tu 'di'i mtshams 'dir myang 'das chen po'i mdo chung ba/ ka ma la gupta dang / lo chen rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba shlau ka drug cu'i tshad tsam zhig 'ong ste 'dir med do/ /'da' ka ye shes shlau ka bcu pa 106—245

rgya nag nas 'gyur bar ldan dkar mar bshad/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod kyi yi ge bam po bzhi pa le'u bcu gcig pa rgya nag gi 'gyur/ gong dkar ba sogs kyis dpyad gzhir mdzad kyang dkar chag chen mo gsum du tshad mar bzhed/ sman lung pas le'u bcur gsungs/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas kyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ gser gyi mdo dang / gser gyi bye ma lta bu'i mdo shlau ka brgyad cu pa su rend+ra/ pradzñā warma/ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ lnga pa chen po'i gsan yig tu gser gyi mdo zhes pa ljags lung gsan skabs ngo ma 'phrod pas/ gser gyi bye ma'i mdo'i khongs su gser gyi mdo tshang ba yin nam brtag gsung / shog grangs bzhi brgya dgu bcu/ta par/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo bam po bco lnga pa/ le'u dgu pa/ shi lend+ra dang / lo tsā ba chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ 'di'i nang gi zla 'od gzhon nus zhus pa'i mdor deng sang zla ba sgron ma'i mdo'i lung drangs pa rnams 'byung bas/ zla ba sgron ma'i mdo yang 'di nyid yin/ de las logs su zla ba sgron ma'i mdo med ces sngon gyi bla ma dag gsung / chos nyid rang gi ngo bo las mi g.yo ba'i mdo shlau ka dgu bcu pa dang dā na shī la dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/rdo rje gdan pas bam po gsum zhes bshad/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin bam po gsum pa/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu/ le'u so brgyad pa zhes gsung / dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po phyed gnyis/ lnga pa chen po'i gsan yig tu/ le'u dgu par bshad/ su rend+ra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo/ bam po gnyis pa/106—246

shlau ka drug cu/ 'gyur gong 'dra/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu shlau ka med/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo/ bam po lnga/ le'u bcu dgu pa/ shākya pra bha dang ratna rakṣi ta'i 'gyur/ shog grangs bzhi brgya go bzhi pa/tha par/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po bdun pa/ le'u nyer lnga pa/ 'gyur gong 'dra/ tshal pa dkar chag tu le'u nyer drug par bshad/ 'ga' zhig tu dharma pā la/ mu ne warma/ ye shes sde gsum gyis bsgyur bar bshad/ bsod nams thams cad sdud pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po bzhi pa/ le'u lnga bcu pa/ pradzñā warma dang / shī lend+ra/ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ tshal pa dkar chag tu le'u gnyis zhes byung ba yig skyon yin 'dra zhes lnga pa chen po bzhed/ khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po gsum pa/ dzi na mi tra/ pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/mtshams 'dir tshal pa dkar chag tu/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo bam po gnyis dang le'u dgu pa rgya nag las bsgyur bar bshad kyang / rdo rje gdan pas tshad mar ma mdzad pa'i stobs kyis/ de nas brgyud pa'i bka' 'gyur ba thams cad kyis/ tshad mar 'dzin thabs med ces kun mkhyen lnga pas gsung ba 'dir med/ ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ 'dus pa rin po che tog gi gzungs bam po brgyad le'u bcu gsum/ shī lend+ra dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ rdo rje gdan pas le'u bcu gcig dang / tshur phu rgyal tshab pas mdor bam grangs mi gsal gsung / rdo rje snying po'i gzungs bam po gcig pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ sgo mtha' yas par bsgrub pa shlau ka nyis brgya bcu pa/'ga' zhig 'di'i steng shlau ka drug cu lhag por yod par bzhed/ sgo drug pa'i 186—247

gzungs shlau ka bco brgyad par shog grangs bzhi brgya go bzhi/ sgo mtha' yas dang sgo drug pa gnyis rgyud kyi khongs su bzhugs kyang dbyig gnyen gyis mdor bkral bar grags/da par/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs shlau ka brgya nyi shu pa/dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ dpal brtsegs gsum gyi 'gyur/ sman lung pas shlau ka brgya nyer gcig par bshad/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs 'di rgyud kyi khongs su yod kyang dkar chag sngon ma rnams kyi don bzhin ma bcos par bzhag /theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu bsgom pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa/le'u bzhi pa/ gong dkar bas le'u gsum dang / tshal pa dkar chag tu le'u rer shlau ka dgu bcu bshad/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul thabs kyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa bam po lnga/ le'u bcu pa/ pradzñā warma dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/mdor bam grangs mi gsal/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po nges par bstan pa gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa bam po bdun pa/ shī lend+ra dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di la byang sems bcu 'dus so nas ting nge 'dzin la mngon par 'jug pa bstan pa'i skabs/ byang sems kun tu snang ba'i mtshan chad par bzhed/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa bam po brgyad pa/ bi dza ya shī la dang / shi lend+ra/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ byams pas zhus pa'i theg chen gyi mdo chung ngu shlau ka bdun cu pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa'i chos bdun pa'i mdo/ jo bo rje dang / dge ba'i blo gros kyi 'gyur/spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ pradzñā warma dang / ye shes 106—248

sdes bsgyur bar shog grangs lnga brgya bcu gcig /rje zhwa dmar bas shlau ka bcu lhag par gsungs shing / rdo rje gdan pas bam po bzhi par bzhed/na par/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo bam po bcu dang le'u bcu gnyis pa dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ buddha pra bha/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo che ba bam po bdun dang / le'u bcu pa/ dzi na mi tra/ pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ rdo rje gdan pa'i gsan yig tu le'u dgur bshad/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo 'bring po/ dge ba bcu bshad pa shlau ka nyis brgya pa su rend+ra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ngu shlau ka bcu gnyis 'gyur gong 'dra/ la lar shlau ka bcu par bshad / klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde/ yi ge pa mgon gling rnams kyi 'gyur/ 'ga' zhig tu/mgon gling rma zhes pa 'dug pas brtag go/ /mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa'i mdo/ lo tsā ba dpal gyi lhun po dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya brgyad cu/ kun mkhyen lnga pas paṇḍi ta dpal gyi lhun po zhes gsung /pa par/ tshangs pas zhus pa'i mdo shlau ka nyis brgya pa/ dzi na mi tra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ tshangs pas byin gyis zhus pa bam po gcig pa/ su ren dra dang pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa bam po drug pa shākya pra bha/ dharma pā la/ dzi na mi tra/ zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dharma tā shī la/ bar zhus kyi lo tsā ba lha'i dbang po srung ba dang / gzhon nu srung ba la sogs pas bsgyur cing zhus pa/ bu ston gyis bam po bdun dang /106—249

ldan dkar mar yang de ltar bshad mod/ mdo rang du bam po drug ste tha ma zhes gsal bar yod ces zhwa dmar ba chos kyi grags pa bzhed do/ /lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa bam po gsum pa pradzñā warma dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/dpal dbyig gis zhus pa shlau ka brgya dang bco lnga 'gyur gong 'dra/ rin chen dra ba can gyis zhus pa bam po gcig dang shlau ka drug cu pa dzñā na garbha dang / dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ slad kyi lo tsā ba dpal brtsegs kyis zhus dag mdzad pa/rin chen zla bas zhus pa shlau ka nyis brgya nyer bdun pa/ bi shuddha sing ha dang dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur bar slar bityā ka ra sidha dang / lo tsā ba de wa tsand+ras zhus pa 'di la 'ga' zhig tu shlau ka nyis brgya bdun cu dang / la la nyis brgya nyer bdun du bshad pa yod/ bde byed kyis zhus pa shlau ka brgyad cu pa pradzñā warma dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa shlau ka bdun cu rtsa gsum pa 'di chung ba yin zhing / yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa che ba ni dkon brtsegs kyi le'u bco brgyad par ngos 'dzin no/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo bam po gsum pa pradzñā warma dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa bam po bzhi pa/ ldan dkar ma dang chos 'byung du bam po drug tu byas pa nor ba dang / lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od lung bstan pa'i mdo dang /li yul lung bstan gyi mdo yang 'di nyid yin gsung / theg pa chen po'i man ngag bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa bam po bzhi pa dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ mdor bam grangs med/ bram ze mo dpal ldan gyis zhus pa shlau ka dgu bcu pa/ bgres mos zhus pa shlau ka brgya dang bcu pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shi la/ ye shes sdes bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya gya gsum/106—250

zhwa dmar bas mdzad pa'i dkar chag tu brgya bco lngar gsungs/pha par/ 'jam dpal gyi dris pa shlau ka dgu bcu pa/ bam po gcig pa/bdag med pas dris pa ka ma la gupta dang / rin chen bzang po'i 'gyur/'jig rten 'dzin gyis dris pa bam po bzhi pa le'u bcu gnyis pa/ rdo gdan pas bcu gcig tu bshad/ blo gros mi zad pa'i bstan pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa chos nyid tshul khrims kyi 'gyur/ gong dkar bas bam po drug tu bshad/ li tsā bi dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa bam po drug dang le'u bcu gnyis pa/'gyur gong 'dra/ 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa'i mdo sho lo ka phyed dang bco lnga pa / tshal pa dkar chag tu phyed bco lnga dang sum cu gdam ngar mdzad/ dpa' bo'i gsan yig tu sho lo ka sum cu pa zhig logs su yod par bshad kyang 'dir med / byang chub kyi phyogs bstan par sho lo ka dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ dzi na mi tra / dzñā na sidhi/ ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa bam po gnyis pa shākya pra bha dang dzi na mi tra/ lo tsā ba dharma tā shī la rnams kyi 'gyur/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa/ bam po gsum pa rin chen mtsho'i 'gyur rnams la shog grangs bzhi brgya dgu bcu/ba par/ sbyin sogs phar phyin lnga bstan pa'i sbyin pa'i le'u dgu/ tshul khrims kyi le'u bdun/ bzod pa'i le'u gsum/ brtson 'grus kyi le'u gcig /bsam gtan gyi le'u bzhi ste re re la rdzogs so yod pa bam bo drug pa/ dzi na mi tra dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin bstan pa/ bam po gnyis pa / le'u bzhi pa/ pradzñā warma dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'di chos rnams kyi rgyan dang bkod pa dang / spungs pa dang / lhab lhub bkod pa'i mdo'i 106—251

le'u bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa khol du phyung ba yin gsung / kun mkhyen lnga pa'i gsan yig tu/ sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa'i mdo gong du bshad pa'i mdo de'i le'u bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa yin gsung / sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa shlau ka sum cu pa/ su rend+ra dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa sho lo ka nyis brgya nyi shu pa/ dzi na mi tra dang / pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu brgya nyi shu pa zhes 'byung / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa bam po gsum pa/ dzñā na garbha dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'ga' zhig tu sho lo ka nyi shu pa zhes 'byung / sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa bam po gcig pa/ tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po'i steng du shlau ka lnga bcu pa zhes 'byung / sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u bam po gsum pa snyan gyi gong rgyan le'u 'bum pa'i nyer dgu pa yin zhing phal chen gyi dum bur grags/ mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa sho lo ka nyis brgya dang bcu pa bi shuddhā sidha dang / dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur bar dzñā na garbha dang klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bcos pa/ 'ga' zhig tu nyis brgya lnga bcu pa dang / lo tsā ba dge ba'i dpal gyis bsgyur bar bshad/ tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa sho lo ka bzhi bcu pa/ 'gyur gong 'drar bi dhya ka ra sing ha dang de wa tsand+ras bcos pa/ bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa bam po gnyis pa dzi na mi tra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bu mo zla ba mchog lung bstan pa bam po gnyis pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ bde ldan ma lung bstan pa sho lo ka bdun cu pa/ rgyud 'bum na yang yod/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/ sho lo ka brgya pa tshur 186—252

phu rgyal tshab pa 'di rgyud du yod gsung / rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis zhus pa'i mdo sho lo ka bcu gcig pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo bam po gcig dang sho lo ka drug cu pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu sho lo ka med/ 'jam dpal gnas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo sho lo ka brgya bzhi bcu su rend+ra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ byams pa bdud rtsi brjod pa'i mdo sho lo ka brgyad cu pa/ byams pa 'jug pa'i mdo bam po gnyis pa zer yang /mdo rang la bam grangs mi gsal/ pradzñā warma dang / dzi na mi tra/ su rend+ra/ye shes sde bzhi'i 'gyur/ 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi mdo shlau ka brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sdes bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya re gsum/ma par/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ sho lo ka bdun cu / su rend+ra dang ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ lnga pa'i gsan yig tu shlau ka med/ nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ pradzñā warma/ su rend+ra / ye shes sde rnams kyi 'gyur/ chos kyi phyag rgya'i mdo sho lo ka brgyad cu/pradzñā warma dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ mar me 'bul ba'i mdo bam po gcig pa/'gyur gong 'dra/ grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba'i mdo sho lo ka brgya pa/ dzñā na garbha dang / lo tsā ba klu'i dbang pos bsgyur ba las/ bibyā ka ra sidha dang / de wa tsand+ras slar zhus pa/ zas kyi 'tsho ba rnam par dag pa'i mdo sho lo ka sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ glang po'i rtsal gyi mdo bam po gcig dang sho lo ka drug cu/ lnga pa chen po dang / dpa' bo'i gsan yig tu sho lo ka med/ sgra chen po'i mdo sho lo ka re bzhi pa/ bi shuddha sing ha dang / dge ba dpal gyi 'gyur/ slar bityā ka 106—253

ra sing ha dang / de wa tsand+ras zhus pa/ seṅge'i sgra bsgrags pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ bibyā ka ra sing ha dang / lo tsā ba ye shes snying po'i 'gyur/ tshal pa dkar chag tu bam po'i sum cha tsam las ma bshad/ chos rang la'ang de las med gsung bas brtag /sa lu ljang pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya nyer drug /rten 'brel dang po dang / rnam dbye bstan pa'i mdo sho lo ka sum cu pa bande nam mkha'i 'gyur/ 'di theg pa chung ngur grags kyang bu ston dang zhwa dmar ba bzhi pas theg pa thun mong ba'i mdor bshad/ rten 'brel gyi mdo sho lo ka bcu gsum pa sor mo'i 'phreng ba la phan pa'i mdo bam po bdun pa/ shākya pra bha dang /dharma tā shi la/ rgya nag gi lo tsā ba tong a tsa la'i 'gyur/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa dā na shī la dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ bad sa'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa 'gyur gong 'dra/ mdo gong ma dang 'di gnyis ldan dkar ma dang phyis kyi chos 'byung dag tu ma grags zhes zhwa dmar ba gsung / ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba'i mdo bam po lnga pa/ mañdzu shri garbha dang rin chen 'tsho'i 'gyur/ dpal sbas kyi mdo bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra dang / dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ tshal pa dkar chag tu sho lo ka drug cu lhag por yod/ las sgrib rnam par dag pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra / pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ tshal pa dkar chag tu sho lo ka bzhi bcu thol/ las sgrib rgyun gcod pa'i mdo sho lo ka nyis brgya sum cu pa/dzi na mi tra/ dā na shrī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyis bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya re lnga/tsa par/ tshul khrims 'chal pa tshar gcod pa'i mdo bam po bdun dang /106—254

le'u dgu pa dharma shrī bha dra dang / dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur/ 'ga' zhig las dharma shrī pra bha zhes bshad/ rdo rje gdan pas le'u brgyad ces gsung / rgyal po la gdams pa sho lo ka brgya drug cu pa/ rnga bo che'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ le'u lnga pa bityā ka ra pra bha dang dpal gyi lhun po'i 'gyur/ slar dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ tshur phu rgyal tshab pa bam po lnga par bzhed/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u bam po gsum pa/ pradzñā warma dang / ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ 'ga' zhig tu dzi na mi trar bshad/ lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo bam po gcig dang le'u gnyis pa / su rend+ra/ pradzñā warma/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ dkar chag snga ma rnams su bam po bzhir bshad/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo shlau ka sum cu pa/sarba dzñā de wa dang dpal brtsegs kyi 'gyur/ srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo sho lo ka bdun cu pa/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ rnam par 'thag pa sdud pa'i mdo bam po gcig pa/ dzi na mi tra/ mu ne warma/ ye shes sde gsum gyi 'gyur/ tshal pa dkar chag tu sho lo ka drug cu lhag /sangs rgyas bgro ba'i mdo bam po gsum pa/ chos rang la bam grangs med gsung / de bzhin gshegs pa bgro ba bam po gsum pa/ dzñā na garbha dang dpal dbyangs kyis bsgyur ba las/ dpal brtsegs kyis zhus pa/ tshal par sho lo ka don lnga lhag /tshur phu rgyal tshab pa sum cu rtsa lnga lhag par bzhed/ 'dus pa chen po'i mdo las de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig gi mdo bam po gsum pa le'u bzhi pa/sarba dzñā de wa dang / dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur bar shog grangs bzhi brgya nga lnga/gong dkar bas le'u gsum gsungs/ 'di na las tshogs dang bsnyen pa sogs bshad pas/ phyin chad bya rgyud de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su bzhugs dgos 106—255
